import { useState, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useCallback, useImperativeHandle, forwardRef } from 'react';
import { X, ChevronUp, List } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import NearbyActivityCard from './nearby/NearbyActivityCard';

type CardPriority = 'help' | 'plan' | 'challenge' | 'user';
export type ActivityStatus = 'active' | 'pending' | 'confirmed' | 'expired';

export interface ActivityItem {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  userName: string;
  emoji: string;
  distance: string;
  payment: string;
  actionLabel: string;
  actionType: 'join' | 'help' | 'accept' | 'message';
  priority: CardPriority;
  accentColor: string;
  timeAgo?: string;
  status: ActivityStatus;
  createdAt: number;
  expiresInMin: number;
}

export interface NearbyActivitySheetRef {
  openToItem: (itemId: string) => void;
}

const now = Date.now();
const ITEMS: ActivityItem[] = [
  { id: 'h1', title: 'Flat tire – need help', userName: 'Maria', emoji: '🔧', distance: '200m', payment: 'in_person', actionLabel: 'Offer help', actionType: 'help', priority: 'help', accentColor: '0, 70%, 55%', timeAgo: '2m ago', status: 'active', createdAt: now - 2 * 60000, expiresInMin: 15 },
  { id: 'p1', title: 'Coffee now', userName: 'Alex', emoji: '☕', distance: '120m', payment: 'tokens', actionLabel: 'Join', actionType: 'join', priority: 'plan', accentColor: '30, 80%, 55%', timeAgo: '5m ago', status: 'pending', createdAt: now - 5 * 60000, expiresInMin: 15 },
  { id: 'h2', title: 'Need a ride downtown', userName: 'Lina', emoji: '🚗', distance: '180m', payment: 'in_person', actionLabel: 'Message', actionType: 'message', priority: 'help', accentColor: '210, 95%, 58%', timeAgo: '1m ago', status: 'active', createdAt: now - 1 * 60000, expiresInMin: 15 },
  { id: 'p2', title: 'Walk in the park', userName: 'Sophie', emoji: '🚶', distance: '350m', payment: 'decide_chat', actionLabel: 'Accept', actionType: 'accept', priority: 'plan', accentColor: '155, 70%, 50%', timeAgo: '8m ago', status: 'confirmed', createdAt: now - 8 * 60000, expiresInMin: 30 },
  { id: 'c1', title: '5K run challenge', userName: 'Dan', emoji: '🏃', distance: '500m', payment: 'decide_chat', actionLabel: 'Join', actionType: 'join', priority: 'challenge', accentColor: '265, 85%, 60%', timeAgo: '12m ago', status: 'active', createdAt: now - 12 * 60000, expiresInMin: 15 },
  { id: 'u1', title: 'Available for coffee', userName: 'Radu', emoji: '⚡', distance: '90m', payment: '', actionLabel: 'Message', actionType: 'message', priority: 'user', accentColor: '265, 85%, 60%', timeAgo: 'Live', status: 'active', createdAt: now, expiresInMin: 60 },
  { id: 'u2', title: 'Looking for a walk partner', userName: 'Elena', emoji: '🚶', distance: '250m', payment: '', actionLabel: 'Accept', actionType: 'accept', priority: 'user', accentColor: '155, 70%, 50%', timeAgo: 'Live', status: 'active', createdAt: now, expiresInMin: 60 },
];

const NAV_HEIGHT = 68;
const MINIMIZED_HEIGHT = 64;

type SheetState = 'hidden' | 'minimized' | 'expanded';

interface Props {
  onStateChange?: (state: 'hidden' | 'visible') => void;
}

const NearbyActivitySheet = forwardRef<NearbyActivitySheetRef, Props>(({ onStateChange }, ref) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [state, setState] = useState<SheetState>('minimized');
  const [, forceUpdate] = useState(0);
  const [highlightId, setHighlightId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const sheetRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const dragStartY = useRef(0);
  const dragStartHeight = useRef(0);
  const isDragging = useRef(false);
  const dragMoved = useRef(false);
  const [currentHeight, setCurrentHeight] = useState(MINIMIZED_HEIGHT);

  const expandedHeight = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? Math.round(window.innerHeight * 0.65) : 500;

  useEffect(() => {
    const interval = setInterval(() => forceUpdate(n => n + 1), 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  const setSheetState = useCallback((s: SheetState) => {
    setState(s);
    if (s === 'minimized') setCurrentHeight(MINIMIZED_HEIGHT);
    else if (s === 'expanded') setCurrentHeight(expandedHeight);
    onStateChange?.(s === 'hidden' ? 'hidden' : 'visible');
  }, [expandedHeight, onStateChange]);

  // Expose openToItem via ref
  useImperativeHandle(ref, () => ({
    openToItem: (itemId: string) => {
      setSheetState('expanded');
      setHighlightId(itemId);
      // Scroll to item after expansion animation
      setTimeout(() => {
        const el = document.getElementById(`activity-item-${itemId}`);
        if (el && scrollRef.current) {
          el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
        }
        // Clear highlight after flash
        setTimeout(() => setHighlightId(null), 2000);
      }, 350);
    },
  }), [setSheetState]);

  // --- Touch handlers ---
  const onTouchStart = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    isDragging.current = true;
    dragMoved.current = false;
    dragStartY.current = e.touches[0].clientY;
    dragStartHeight.current = currentHeight;
  }, [currentHeight]);

  const onTouchMove = useCallback((e: React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDragging.current) return;
    dragMoved.current = true;
    e.preventDefault();
    const deltaY = dragStartY.current - e.touches[0].clientY;
    const newHeight = Math.max(MINIMIZED_HEIGHT / 2, Math.min(expandedHeight, dragStartHeight.current + deltaY));
    setCurrentHeight(newHeight);
  }, [expandedHeight]);

  const onTouchEnd = useCallback(() => {
    if (!isDragging.current) return;
    isDragging.current = false;

    if (!dragMoved.current) {
      // Pure tap — toggle
      if (state === 'minimized') setSheetState('expanded');
      else if (state === 'expanded') setSheetState('minimized');
      return;
    }

    // Snap based on final height
    const mid = (MINIMIZED_HEIGHT + expandedHeight) / 2;
    if (currentHeight < MINIMIZED_HEIGHT * 0.6) {
      setSheetState('hidden');
    } else if (currentHeight < mid) {
      setSheetState('minimized');
    } else {
      setSheetState('expanded');
    }
  }, [currentHeight, expandedHeight, setSheetState, state]);

  // Mouse fallback
  const onMouseDown = useCallback((e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    isDragging.current = true;
    dragMoved.current = false;
    dragStartY.current = e.clientY;
    dragStartHeight.current = currentHeight;

    const onMouseMove = (ev: MouseEvent) => {
      if (!isDragging.current) return;
      dragMoved.current = true;
      const deltaY = dragStartY.current - ev.clientY;
      const newHeight = Math.max(MINIMIZED_HEIGHT / 2, Math.min(expandedHeight, dragStartHeight.current + deltaY));
      setCurrentHeight(newHeight);
    };
    const onMouseUp = () => {
      isDragging.current = false;
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);

      if (!dragMoved.current) {
        // Tap
        setState(prev => {
          const next: SheetState = prev === 'minimized' ? 'expanded' : 'minimized';
          setCurrentHeight(next === 'expanded' ? expandedHeight : MINIMIZED_HEIGHT);
          onStateChange?.('visible');
          return next;
        });
        return;
      }

      setCurrentHeight(prev => {
        const mid = (MINIMIZED_HEIGHT + expandedHeight) / 2;
        if (prev < MINIMIZED_HEIGHT * 0.6) {
          setSheetState('hidden');
          return prev;
        } else if (prev < mid) {
          setSheetState('minimized');
          return MINIMIZED_HEIGHT;
        } else {
          setSheetState('expanded');
          return expandedHeight;
        }
      });
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousemove', onMouseMove);
    document.addEventListener('mouseup', onMouseUp);
  }, [currentHeight, expandedHeight, setSheetState, onStateChange]);

  const handleClose = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    e.preventDefault();
    setSheetState('hidden');
  };

  const handleAction = (item: ActivityItem) => {
    if (item.actionType === 'message') navigate('/chats');
  };

  const getStatus = (item: ActivityItem): ActivityStatus => {
    if (item.status === 'confirmed') return 'confirmed';
    if (item.status === 'expired') return 'expired';
    const elapsed = (Date.now() - item.createdAt) / 60000;
    if (elapsed >= item.expiresInMin) return 'expired';
    return item.status;
  };

  const totalCount = ITEMS.length;
  const helpCount = ITEMS.filter(i => i.priority === 'help').length;

  const priorityLabel: Record<CardPriority, string> = {
    help: '🚨 Help', plan: '📋 Plans', challenge: '⚔️ Challenges', user: '👤 Available',
  };
  const order: CardPriority[] = ['help', 'plan', 'user', 'challenge'];
  const groups = useMemo(() => {
    const result: { key: CardPriority; label: string; items: ActivityItem[] }[] = [];
    for (const p of order) {
      const filtered = ITEMS.filter(i => i.priority === p);
      if (filtered.length > 0) result.push({ key: p, label: priorityLabel[p], items: filtered });
    }
    return result;
  }, []);

  const isTransitioning = !isDragging.current;
  const sheetHeight = state === 'hidden' ? 0 : currentHeight;

  return (
    <>
      {state === 'hidden' && (
        <button
          onClick={() => setSheetState('minimized')}
          className="absolute z-[950] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl border border-border/40 shadow-lg active:scale-95 transition-transform"
          style={{ bottom: `${NAV_HEIGHT + 12}px` }}
        >
          <List className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">{totalCount} activities nearby</span>
          {helpCount > 0 && (
            <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20">
              {helpCount} help
            </span>
          )}
          <ChevronUp className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
        </button>
      )}

      {state === 'expanded' && (
        <div
          className="absolute inset-0 z-[949]"
          style={{ background: 'hsla(0, 0%, 0%, 0.3)' }}
          onClick={() => setSheetState('minimized')}
        />
      )}

      {state !== 'hidden' && (
        <div
          ref={sheetRef}
          className="absolute left-0 right-0 z-[950] flex flex-col rounded-t-[20px] overflow-hidden bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-border/40 border-b-0 shadow-xl"
          style={{
            bottom: NAV_HEIGHT,
            height: sheetHeight,
            transition: isTransitioning ? 'height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1)' : 'none',
          }}
        >
          {/* Drag handle */}
          <div
            onTouchStart={onTouchStart}
            onTouchMove={onTouchMove}
            onTouchEnd={onTouchEnd}
            onMouseDown={onMouseDown}
            className="flex flex-col items-center pt-2 pb-1.5 cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing select-none"
            style={{ touchAction: 'none' }}
          >
            <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/25 mb-2" />
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between w-full px-4">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">Nearby Activity</p>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary border border-primary/20">
                  {totalCount}
                </span>
                {helpCount > 0 && (
                  <span className="text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20">
                    {helpCount} help
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ChevronUp
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform duration-200"
                  style={{ transform: state === 'expanded' ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)' }}
                />
                <button
                  onTouchEnd={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); handleClose(e); }}
                  onClick={handleClose}
                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center bg-muted/40 hover:bg-muted/60 active:scale-90 transition-all relative z-[960]"
                  style={{ touchAction: 'manipulation' }}
                >
                  <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Scrollable list */}
          <div ref={scrollRef} className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-3 space-y-4 overscroll-contain">
            {groups.map(group => (
              <div key={group.key}>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">{group.label}</p>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {group.items.map((item, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={item.id}
                      id={`activity-item-${item.id}`}
                      className={`transition-all duration-500 rounded-2xl ${highlightId === item.id ? 'ring-2 ring-primary ring-offset-2 ring-offset-card' : ''}`}
                    >
                      <NearbyActivityCard
                        item={item}
                        index={i}
                        currentStatus={getStatus(item)}
                        onAction={handleAction}
                      />
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
});

NearbyActivitySheet.displayName = 'NearbyActivitySheet';

export default NearbyActivitySheet;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Bell, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';

const typeEmoji: Record<string, string> = {
  invite_received: '☕',
  invite_accepted: '✅',
  invite_expired: '⏰',
  invite_changed: '🔄',
  delay_request: '⏱️',
  new_message: '💬',
  gift_received: '🎁',
  session_started: '🟢',
  session_completed: '⭐',
  request_received: '🤝',
  request_accepted: '✅',
};

const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
  const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (diff < 1) return 'just now';
  if (diff < 60) return `${diff}m ago`;
  if (diff < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 1440)}d ago`;
};

const NotificationBell = () => {
  const { notifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead } = useApp();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;

  return (
    <div className="relative">
      <motion.button
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
        onClick={() => setOpen(!open)}
        className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/15 border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center relative"
      >
        <Bell className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
        {unread > 0 && (
          <motion.span
            initial={{ scale: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 min-w-[18px] h-[18px] rounded-full gradient-primary text-[10px] font-bold text-primary-foreground flex items-center justify-center px-1"
          >
            {unread > 99 ? '99+' : unread}
          </motion.span>
        )}
      </motion.button>

      <AnimatePresence>
        {open && (
          <>
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
              onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
              className="fixed inset-0 z-40"
            />
            <motion.div
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.95 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -8, scale: 0.95 }}
              className="absolute right-0 top-12 w-80 max-h-[420px] glass rounded-2xl border border-border/30 shadow-[0_8px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] z-50 overflow-hidden"
            >
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 border-b border-border/20">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">Notifications</span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {unread > 0 && (
                    <button onClick={markAllNotificationsRead} className="text-[10px] text-primary font-semibold hover:text-primary/80">
                      Read all
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-[320px]">
                {notifications.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-10">
                    <Bell className="w-6 h-6 text-muted-foreground mx-auto mb-2" />
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">No notifications yet</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  notifications.slice(0, 15).map(n => {
                    const emoji = typeEmoji[n.type] || '🔔';
                    return (
                      <motion.button
                        key={n.id}
                        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                        onClick={() => {
                          markNotificationRead(n.id);
                          if (n.action_url) navigate(n.action_url);
                          setOpen(false);
                        }}
                        className={`w-full px-3 py-2.5 text-left border-b border-border/10 flex items-center gap-2.5 transition-colors hover:bg-primary/5 ${!n.is_read ? 'bg-primary/5' : ''}`}
                      >
                        {n.avatar_url ? (
                          <img src={n.avatar_url} alt="" className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl object-cover ring-1 ring-border/20 shrink-0" />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <span className="text-sm">{emoji}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                          <p className="text-[12px] font-semibold text-foreground truncate">{n.title}</p>
                          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">{n.message}</p>
                          <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground/50 mt-0.5">{timeAgo(n.created_at)}</p>
                        </div>
                        {!n.is_read && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0" />}
                      </motion.button>
                    );
                  })
                )}
              </div>

              {/* View all link */}
              {notifications.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => { navigate('/notifications'); setOpen(false); }}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 border-t border-border/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-semibold text-primary hover:text-primary/80 transition-colors"
                >
                  View all notifications
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
              )}
            </motion.div>
          </>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
};

export default NotificationBell;

import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface NotificationToastProps {
  title: string;
  message: string;
  avatarUrl?: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  onClick?: () => void;
}

const NotificationToast = ({ title, message, avatarUrl, onClose, onClick }: NotificationToastProps) => (
  <motion.div
    initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 300, scale: 0.9 }}
    animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0, scale: 1 }}
    exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 300, scale: 0.9 }}
    transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 26, stiffness: 350 }}
    onClick={onClick}
    className="fixed top-4 left-4 right-4 z-[9999] cursor-pointer"
  >
    <div className="rounded-2xl p-3 flex items-center gap-3 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-primary/15 shadow-glow">
      {avatarUrl ? (
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full overflow-hidden ring-2 ring-primary/30 shrink-0">
          <img src={avatarUrl} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
          <span className="text-lg">{title.charAt(0)}</span>
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground truncate">{title}</p>
        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground truncate">{message}</p>
      </div>
      <button
        onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClose(); }}
        className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0"
      >
        <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
      </button>
    </div>
  </motion.div>
);

export default NotificationToast;

import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { UserCircle, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';

const ProfileCompletionGate = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => {
  const { currentUser, isAuthenticated } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (!isAuthenticated || !currentUser) return <>{children}</>;

  const isComplete = currentUser.name?.trim() && currentUser.gender && currentUser.age && currentUser.bio?.trim() && currentUser.city?.trim() && (currentUser.interests?.length || 0) >= 3;

  if (!isComplete) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface flex items-center justify-center px-6">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
          className="text-center max-w-sm"
        >
          <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-5 animate-float">
            <UserCircle className="w-10 h-10 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Complete Your Profile</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-3 leading-relaxed">
            Add your name, age, gender, bio, city, and interests to start meeting people nearby.
          </p>
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={() => navigate('/profile/edit')}
            className="mt-8 px-8 py-3.5 rounded-2xl gradient-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-glow inline-flex items-center gap-2 btn-press"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4" /> Set Up Profile
          </motion.button>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <>{children}</>;
};

FILE: src/components/ProximityAlerts.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { X, Sparkles, Navigation, Coffee, MessageCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface ProximityAlert {
  id: string;
  type: 'very_close' | 'just_passed';
  userId: string;
  userName: string;
  avatar: string;
  distance: number;
  timestamp: string;
}

const triggerHaptic = () => {
  try {
    if ('vibrate' in navigator) navigator.vibrate([50, 30, 50]);
  } catch {}
};

const ProximityAlerts = () => {
  const { authUser, isCompatible } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [alerts, setAlerts] = useState<ProximityAlert[]>([]);
  const soundRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);

  const playSound = () => {
    try {
      if (!soundRef.current) soundRef.current = new Audio('/notification.mp3');
      soundRef.current.volume = 0.25;
      soundRef.current.currentTime = 0;
      soundRef.current.play().catch(() => {});
    } catch {}
  };

  const dismissAlert = useCallback((id: string) => {
    setAlerts(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== id));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;

    const channel = supabase
      .channel('proximity-alerts-v2')
      .on(
        'postgres_changes',
        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'encounters' },
        async (payload) => {
          const enc = payload.new as any;
          const isMyEncounter = enc.user1_id === authUser.id || enc.user2_id === authUser.id;
          if (!isMyEncounter) return;
          if (enc.proximity_state !== 'very_close' && enc.proximity_state !== 'just_passed') return;
          if (localStorage.getItem('crossy_proximity_alerts') === 'off') return;
          if (localStorage.getItem('crossy_proximity_sound') === 'off') {
            // skip sound
          } else {
            playSound();
          }

          const otherId = enc.user1_id === authUser.id ? enc.user2_id : enc.user1_id;
          const { data: profile } = await supabase
            .from('profiles')
            .select('name, avatar, gender, interested_in')
            .eq('id', otherId)
            .single();

          if (!profile) return;
          if (!isCompatible({ gender: profile.gender, interested_in: profile.interested_in || 'everyone' })) return;

          triggerHaptic();

          const alert: ProximityAlert = {
            id: enc.id,
            type: enc.proximity_state as 'very_close' | 'just_passed',
            userId: otherId,
            userName: profile.name || 'Someone',
            avatar: profile.avatar || '',
            distance: enc.distance_estimate || 0,
            timestamp: enc.timestamp || new Date().toISOString(),
          };

          setAlerts(prev => [alert, ...prev].slice(0, 3));
          setTimeout(() => dismissAlert(enc.id), 12000);
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [authUser, dismissAlert, isCompatible]);

  const handleSayHi = (alert: ProximityAlert) => {
    triggerHaptic();
    dismissAlert(alert.id);
    navigate(`/chat/${alert.userId}`);
    toast('Opening chat...', { icon: '👋' });
  };

  const handleInviteCoffee = async (alert: ProximityAlert) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    triggerHaptic();
    dismissAlert(alert.id);
    // Create a coffee invite
    await supabase.from('invites').insert({
      sender_id: authUser.id,
      receiver_id: alert.userId,
      type: 'coffee',
      status: 'pending',
      duration_minutes: 30,
      token_cost: 0,
    });
    toast.success('☕ Coffee invite sent!');
    navigate(`/chat/${alert.userId}`);
  };

  if (alerts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed top-4 left-4 right-4 z-[1100] flex flex-col gap-2 pointer-events-none">
      <AnimatePresence>
        {alerts.map((alert) => (
          <motion.div
            key={alert.id}
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -50, scale: 0.9 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -30, scale: 0.9 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 28 }}
            className="pointer-events-auto"
          >
            {alert.type === 'very_close' ? (
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-accent/20 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-lg overflow-hidden">
                <div className="h-0.5 bg-accent" />
                <div className="p-3.5">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="relative shrink-0">
                      {alert.avatar ? (
                        <img src={alert.avatar} alt="" className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 ring-accent/40" />
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-accent/15 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold text-accent ring-2 ring-accent/30">
                          {alert.userName.charAt(0)}
                        </div>
                      )}
                      <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-accent flex items-center justify-center">
                        <Sparkles className="w-2.5 h-2.5 text-accent-foreground" />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">
                        {alert.userName} is nearby
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Navigation className="w-3 h-3" /> ~{alert.distance}m away
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.8 }}
                      onClick={() => dismissAlert(alert.id)}
                      className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </motion.button>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3">
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                      onClick={() => handleSayHi(alert)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
                    >
                      <MessageCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Say hi
                    </motion.button>
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                      onClick={() => handleInviteCoffee(alert)}
                      className="flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl bg-accent/10 text-accent text-xs font-bold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 border border-accent/20"
                    >
                      <Coffee className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Coffee
                    </motion.button>
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                      onClick={() => dismissAlert(alert.id)}
                      className="py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-muted/40 text-muted-foreground text-xs font-semibold"
                    >
                      Ignore
                    </motion.button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              /* Crossed paths - compact */
              <div className="rounded-2xl border border-border bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl shadow-md p-3">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  {alert.avatar ? (
                    <img src={alert.avatar} alt="" className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover ring-1 ring-primary/20" />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-primary">
                      {alert.userName.charAt(0)}
                    </div>
                  )}
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground truncate">
                      You crossed paths with {alert.userName}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                      onClick={() => handleSayHi(alert)}
                      className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-xs font-bold"
                    >
                      Say hi
                    </motion.button>
                    <motion.button
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                      onClick={() => dismissAlert(alert.id)}
                      className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-muted/40 flex items-center justify-center"
                    >
                      <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </motion.button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        ))}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProximityAlerts;

import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MapPin, X, Coffee, Flag, Ban, ChevronRight, MessageCircle, Footprints, Wine, Send } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const activityLabels: Record<string, { emoji: string; label: string }> = {
  coffee: { emoji: '☕️', label: 'Wants coffee now' },
  walk: { emoji: '🚶', label: 'Down for a walk' },
  drink: { emoji: '🍸', label: 'Looking for a drink' },
  chat: { emoji: '💬', label: 'Open to chat' },
  hangout: { emoji: '✨', label: 'Wants to hang out' },
};

const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
  const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (diff < 2) return null;
  if (diff < 60) return `${diff}m ago`;
  if (diff < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 1440)}d ago`;
};

interface BottomSheetUser {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar: string;
  bio: string;
  age: number | null;
  is_online: boolean;
  avg_rating: number;
  trust_score: number;
  distance_meters?: number;
  sessions_completed: number;
  city: string;
  interests?: string[];
  is_available?: boolean;
  activity_type?: string | null;
  available_until?: string | null;
  interested_in?: string;
  gender?: string | null;
  last_active_at?: string;
}

const UserBottomSheet = ({ user, onClose }: { user: BottomSheetUser | null; onClose: () => void }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { authUser, isCompatible, blockUser, reportUser, sendJoinRequest } = useApp();
  const [showActions, setShowActions] = useState(false);

  if (!user) return null;

  const userIsLive = user.is_available && user.available_until && new Date(user.available_until) > new Date();
  const compatible = isCompatible(user);

  const formatDistance = (m?: number) => {
    if (!m) return 'Nearby';
    return m < 1000 ? `${Math.round(m)}m away` : `${(m / 1000).toFixed(1)}km away`;
  };

  const lastSeen = user.last_active_at ? timeAgo(user.last_active_at) : null;
  const isRecentlyActive = user.is_online || !lastSeen;

  const activity = user.activity_type && activityLabels[user.activity_type];
  const interests = user.interests?.slice(0, 3) || [];

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {user && (
        <>
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
            onClick={onClose}
            className="fixed inset-0 z-[1001] bg-background/30 backdrop-blur-sm"
          />

          <motion.div
            initial={{ y: '100%' }}
            animate={{ y: 0 }}
            exit={{ y: '100%' }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 32, stiffness: 350 }}
            className="fixed left-0 right-0 z-[1002] rounded-t-[28px] border-t border-border/15 overflow-hidden"
            style={{ bottom: '72px', background: 'linear-gradient(180deg, hsl(250 25% 10% / 0.95), hsl(250 28% 7% / 0.98))', backdropFilter: 'blur(40px)' }}
          >
            <div className="flex justify-center pt-3 pb-1">
              <div className="w-9 h-1 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/20" />
            </div>

            <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }} onClick={() => setShowActions(!showActions)}
                className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Flag className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground" />
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }} onClick={onClose}
                className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center">
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
              </motion.button>
            </div>

            <div className="px-5 pb-7 pt-1">
              {/* Avatar + Core Info */}
              <div className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
                <div className="relative mb-3">
                  <div className={`absolute -inset-2 rounded-full opacity-40 blur-xl ${userIsLive ? 'bg-primary' : 'bg-primary/50'}`} />
                  <div className={`relative w-[88px] h-[88px] rounded-full p-[2.5px] ${userIsLive ? 'gradient-glow' : 'bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/60 to-accent/40'}`}
                    style={userIsLive ? { boxShadow: '0 0 30px hsla(265,85%,60%,0.35)' } : undefined}>

                    ) : (

                        {user.name?.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  {isRecentlyActive && (
                    <div className="absolute bottom-0.5 right-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 border-[2.5px] border-background"
                      style={{ boxShadow: '0 0 8px hsla(155,70%,50%,0.5)' }} />

                )}

                  {interests.map((tag) => (
                    <span key={tag} className="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 border border-border/15">
                      {tag}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </motion.div>
              )}

              {/* Block/Report dropdown */}
              <AnimatePresence>

FILE: src/components/UserCard.tsx

import { Star, Shield, MapPin, MessageCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { activityEmojiMap } from '@/data/activityTypes';

interface UserCardUser {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  avatar: string;
  bio: string;
  age: number | null;
  is_online: boolean;
  avg_rating: number;
  trust_score: number;
  distance_meters?: number;
  is_available?: boolean;
  activity_type?: string | null;
  available_until?: string | null;
  last_active_at?: string;
}

type StatusType = 'available' | 'invited' | 'accepted' | 'live' | 'offline';

const statusMap: Record<StatusType, { label: string; dotColor: string; pillBg: string; pillText: string }> = {
  available: { label: 'Available', dotColor: 'bg-[hsl(var(--status-available))]', pillBg: 'bg-emerald-50', pillText: 'text-emerald-600' },
  invited: { label: 'Invited', dotColor: 'bg-[hsl(var(--status-invited))]', pillBg: 'bg-amber-50', pillText: 'text-amber-600' },
  accepted: { label: 'Accepted', dotColor: 'bg-[hsl(var(--status-accepted))]', pillBg: 'bg-blue-50', pillText: 'text-blue-600' },
  live: { label: 'Live', dotColor: 'bg-[hsl(var(--status-live))]', pillBg: 'bg-purple-50', pillText: 'text-purple-600' },
  offline: { label: 'Offline', dotColor: 'bg-muted-foreground/40', pillBg: 'bg-muted', pillText: 'text-muted-foreground' },
};

const getCardStatus = (user: UserCardUser): StatusType => {
  if (user.is_available && user.available_until && new Date(user.available_until) > new Date()) return 'live';
  if (user.is_available) return 'available';
  if (user.is_online) return 'available';
  return 'offline';
};

const formatDistance = (m?: number) => {
  if (!m) return '';
  return m < 1000 ? `${Math.round(m)}m` : `${(m / 1000).toFixed(1)}km`;
};

const UserCard = ({ user, index = 0 }: { user: UserCardUser; index?: number }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const status = getCardStatus(user);
  const statusCfg = statusMap[status];
  const emoji = activityEmojiMap[user.activity_type || ''] || '';

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: index * 0.04, duration: 0.35, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
      onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${user.id}`)}
      className="cursor-pointer"
    >
      <div className="rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-card border border-border shadow-card">
        {/* Image */}
        <div className="relative h-56 overflow-hidden">
          {user.avatar ? (
            <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-full h-full bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
              <span className="text-5xl font-semibold text-muted-foreground/30">{user.name?.charAt(0)}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/50 via-transparent to-transparent" />

          {/* Status pill */}
          <div className={`absolute top-3 left-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold ${statusCfg.pillBg} ${statusCfg.pillText}`}>
            {(status === 'live' || status === 'available') && (
              <div className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${statusCfg.dotColor} animate-pulse`} />
            )}
            {emoji && <span>{emoji}</span>}
            {statusCfg.label}
          </div>

          {/* Distance */}
          {user.distance_meters !== undefined && user.distance_meters > 0 && (
            <div className="absolute top-3 right-3 flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/90 backdrop-blur text-[11px] font-medium text-foreground">
              <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" />
              {formatDistance(user.distance_meters)}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Name overlay */}
          <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 right-0 p-4">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-white">
              {user.name}{user.age ? `, ${user.age}` : ''}
            </h3>
            {user.bio && (
              <p className="text-[13px] text-white/75 mt-0.5 line-clamp-1">{user.bio}</p>
            )}

              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Star className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400 fill-amber-400" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-white">{user.avg_rating?.toFixed(1) || '0.0'}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Shield className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white/70" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-white">{user.trust_score}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="p-3 flex gap-2">
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); navigate(`/chat/${user.id}`); }}

          >

              className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-secondary border border-border flex items-center justify-center text-base"
            >
              {type === 'coffee' ? '☕' : type === 'walk' ? '🚶' : '🍸'}
            </motion.button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Check, X, Clock, Eye, Users, MapPin, Timer } from 'lucide-react';
import TokenLockBadge from './TokenLockBadge';

interface ActivityJoinCardProps {
  participant: {
    id: string;
    user_id: string;
    status: string;
    created_at: string;
  };
  activity: {
    id: string;
    activityType: string;
    meetingPoint: string;
    duration: string;
    deposit: string;
    payment: string;
    isGroup: boolean;
  };
  isOwner: boolean;
  requesterName: string;
  ownerName: string;
  onAccept?: (participantId: string) => void;
  onDecline?: (participantId: string) => void;
  onIgnore?: (participantId: string) => void;
}

const statusConfig: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: any }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Pending approval', color: 'text-amber-600', icon: Clock },
  confirmed: { label: 'Accepted', color: 'text-emerald-600', icon: Check },
  declined: { label: 'Declined', color: 'text-destructive', icon: X },
  ignored: { label: 'No response', color: 'text-muted-foreground', icon: Eye },
  cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', color: 'text-muted-foreground', icon: X },
};

const ActivityJoinCard = ({
  participant, activity, isOwner, requesterName, ownerName,
  onAccept, onDecline, onIgnore,
}: ActivityJoinCardProps) => {
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const isPending = participant.status === 'pending';
  const sCfg = statusConfig[participant.status] || statusConfig.pending;
  const StatusIcon = sCfg.icon;

  const handleAction = async (action: 'accept' | 'decline' | 'ignore') => {
    if (acting) return;
    setActing(true);
    try {
      if (action === 'accept') await onAccept?.(participant.id);
      else if (action === 'decline') await onDecline?.(participant.id);
      else await onIgnore?.(participant.id);
    } finally {
      setActing(false);
    }
  };

  const depositLabel = activity.deposit === 'none' ? null : `${activity.deposit} tokens`;

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className={`flex ${isOwner ? 'justify-start' : 'justify-end'} my-1`}
    >
      <div className="max-w-[85%] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200">
        <div className="px-4 py-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/80 flex items-center justify-center border border-border/50">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground leading-tight">
                {isOwner ? `${requesterName} wants to join` : `You requested to join ${ownerName}'s activity`}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {activity.activityType} · {activity.duration}min · {activity.isGroup ? '+ 👥' : '+ 👤'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-2.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
            {activity.meetingPoint && (
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-white/60 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                <MapPin className="w-3 h-3" /> {activity.meetingPoint}
              </span>
            )}
            <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-white/60 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
              <Timer className="w-3 h-3" /> {activity.duration}min
            </span>
            {depositLabel && (
              <TokenLockBadge
                amount={parseInt(activity.deposit) || 0}
                status={participant.status === 'confirmed' ? 'locked' : 'pending'}
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {!isPending && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/60 ${sCfg.color}`}>
                <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">{sCfg.label}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {isOwner && isPending && (
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3">
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                disabled={acting}
                onClick={() => handleAction('accept')}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--status-available))] text-white text-xs font-bold"
              >
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                Accept
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                disabled={acting}
                onClick={() => handleAction('decline')}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-destructive/10 text-destructive text-xs font-bold border border-destructive/20"
              >
                <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                Decline
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                disabled={acting}
                onClick={() => handleAction('ignore')}
                className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground text-xs font-medium"
              >
                Ignore
              </motion.button>
            </div>
          )}

          {!isOwner && isPending && (
            <div className="mt-2.5">
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground italic flex items-center gap-1">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> Waiting for approval...
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default ActivityJoinCard;

FILE: src/components/chat/ChatMessage.tsx

import { useState, useRef } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Check, CheckCheck, Copy } from 'lucide-react';
import ReactionPicker from './ReactionPicker';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

type MessageStatus = 'sent' | 'delivered' | 'seen';

interface ChatMessageProps {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  isMine: boolean;
  createdAt: string | null;
  seenAt: string | null;
  reaction?: string;
  onReact: (msgId: string, emoji: string) => void;
  delay?: number;
  showStatus?: boolean;
  seenAvatar?: string | null;
}

const formatTime = (ts: string | null) => {
  if (!ts) return '';
  return new Date(ts).toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
};

const isEmojiOnly = (text: string): boolean => {
  const stripped = text.replace(/\s/g, '');
  const emojiPattern = /(?:\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Emoji}\uFE0F)(?:\u200D(?:\p{Emoji_Presentation}|\p{Emoji}\uFE0F))*/gu;
  const matches = stripped.match(emojiPattern);
  if (!matches) return false;
  const joined = matches.join('');
  return joined === stripped && matches.length <= 3;
};

const getMessageStatus = (createdAt: string | null, seenAt: string | null): MessageStatus => {
  if (seenAt) return 'seen';
  if (createdAt) return 'delivered';
  return 'sent';
};

const StatusIcon = ({ status }: { status: MessageStatus }) => {
  if (status === 'seen') return <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-primary" />;
  if (status === 'delivered') return <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground/50" />;
  return <Check className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground/40" />;
};

const ChatMessage = ({ id, text, isMine, createdAt, seenAt, reaction, onReact, delay = 0, showStatus = true, seenAvatar }: ChatMessageProps) => {
  const [showPicker, setShowPicker] = useState(false);
  const [showContextMenu, setShowContextMenu] = useState(false);
  const longPressTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const doubleTapTimer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const tapCount = useRef(0);

  const bigEmoji = isEmojiOnly(text);
  const status = getMessageStatus(createdAt, seenAt);

  const handleTap = () => {
    tapCount.current++;
    if (tapCount.current === 2) {
      onReact(id, '❤️');
      tapCount.current = 0;
      if (doubleTapTimer.current) clearTimeout(doubleTapTimer.current);
      return;
    }
    doubleTapTimer.current = setTimeout(() => { tapCount.current = 0; }, 300);
  };

  const handleLongPressStart = () => {
    longPressTimer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      setShowPicker(true);
      setShowContextMenu(true);
    }, 500);
  };

  const handleLongPressEnd = () => {
    if (longPressTimer.current) clearTimeout(longPressTimer.current);
  };

  const handleCopy = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    toast.success('Copied');
    setShowContextMenu(false);
    setShowPicker(false);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ delay: Math.min(delay * 0.008, 0.3), duration: 0.25 }}
      className={`flex ${isMine ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'} group`}
    >
      <div className="relative max-w-[75%]">
        <div
          onClick={handleTap}
          onPointerDown={handleLongPressStart}
          onPointerUp={handleLongPressEnd}
          onPointerLeave={handleLongPressEnd}
          className={`select-none ${
            bigEmoji
              ? 'px-1 py-1'
              : `px-4 py-2.5 ${
                  isMine
                    ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-br-md'
                    : 'bg-card text-foreground rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md border border-border shadow-card'
                }`
          }`}
        >
          {bigEmoji ? (
            <motion.p
              initial={{ scale: 0.5 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1 }}
              transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 400, damping: 15 }}
              className="text-5xl leading-tight"
            >
              {text}
            </motion.p>
          ) : (
            <p className="text-[14px] leading-[1.5]">{text}</p>
          )}
          <div className={`flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5 ${isMine ? 'justify-end' : ''}`}>
            <span className={`text-[10px] ${bigEmoji ? 'text-muted-foreground/60' : isMine ? 'text-primary-foreground/50' : 'text-muted-foreground/50'}`}>
              {formatTime(createdAt)}
            </span>
            {isMine && showStatus && <StatusIcon status={status} />}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Seen avatar */}
        {isMine && showStatus && status === 'seen' && seenAvatar && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ scale: 0 }}
            animate={{ scale: 1 }}
            className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-5"
          >
            <img src={seenAvatar} className="w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full object-cover" alt="Seen" />
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* Reaction bubble */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {reaction && (
            <motion.div
              initial={{ scale: 0 }}
              animate={{ scale: 1 }}
              exit={{ scale: 0 }}
              className={`absolute -bottom-3 ${isMine ? 'left-2' : 'right-2'} bg-card rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 border border-border shadow-sm cursor-pointer`}
              onClick={() => onReact(id, reaction)}
            >
              <span className="text-sm">{reaction}</span>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        {/* Reaction picker + context menu */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showPicker && (
            <>
              <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[5]" onClick={() => { setShowPicker(false); setShowContextMenu(false); }} />
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.7, y: 8 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.7, y: 8 }}
                className={`absolute -top-14 ${isMine ? 'right-0' : 'left-0'} z-10`}
              >
                <ReactionPicker
                  isOpen={true}
                  onSelect={(emoji) => { onReact(id, emoji); setShowPicker(false); setShowContextMenu(false); }}
                  onClose={() => { setShowPicker(false); setShowContextMenu(false); }}
                  position={isMine ? 'right' : 'left'}
                />
                {showContextMenu && (
                  <motion.div
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: -4 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className={`mt-1 ${isMine ? 'ml-auto' : ''} bg-card rounded-xl border border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden w-36`}
                  >
                    <button onClick={handleCopy} className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs text-foreground hover:bg-secondary transition-colors">
                      <Copy className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" /> Copy
                    </button>
                  </motion.div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            </>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default ChatMessage;

FILE: src/components/chat/CircularTimer.tsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';

interface CircularTimerProps {
  expiresAt: number;
  totalMs: number;
  size?: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  className?: string;
}

const CircularTimer = ({ expiresAt, totalMs, size = 28, strokeWidth = 2.5, className = '' }: CircularTimerProps) => {
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(Math.max(0, expiresAt - Date.now()));

  useEffect(() => {
    const iv = setInterval(() => {
      setRemaining(Math.max(0, expiresAt - Date.now()));
    }, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [expiresAt]);

  const progress = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, remaining / totalMs));
  const radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;
  const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  const offset = circumference * (1 - progress);

  const mins = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
  const secs = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
  const label = remaining <= 0 ? '–' : `${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const urgencyColor = progress < 0.2
    ? 'hsl(var(--destructive))'
    : progress < 0.5
      ? 'hsl(45, 93%, 47%)'
      : 'hsl(var(--primary))';

  return (
    <div className={`relative inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${className}`}>
      <svg width={size} height={size} className="-rotate-90">
        <circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius}
          fill="none"
          stroke="hsl(var(--border))"
          strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
        />
        <motion.circle
          cx={size / 2} cy={size / 2} r={radius}
          fill="none"
          stroke={urgencyColor}
          strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeDasharray={circumference}
          strokeDashoffset={offset}
          initial={false}
          animate={{ strokeDashoffset: offset }}
          transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
        />
      </svg>
      <span className="text-[10px] font-bold tabular-nums" style={{ color: urgencyColor }}>
        {label}
      </span>
    </div>
  );
};

export default CircularTimer;

FILE: src/components/chat/DelayUpdateCard.tsx

import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Clock, Check, X, AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';

interface DelayUpdate {
  sessionId: string;
  senderId: string;
  delayMinutes: number;
  reason?: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'accepted' | 'declined';
}

interface DelayUpdateCardProps {
  messageId: string;
  delayData: DelayUpdate;
  isMine: boolean;
  senderName: string;
}

const DelayUpdateCard = ({ messageId, delayData, isMine, senderName }: DelayUpdateCardProps) => {
  const { authUser } = useApp();
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    setActing(true);

    // Update the delay message status
    const updatedData = { ...delayData, status: 'accepted' as const };
    await supabase.from('messages').update({
      text: `⏰DELAY:${JSON.stringify(updatedData)}`,
    } as any).eq('id', messageId);

    // Update session meetup_time if there's a session
    if (delayData.sessionId) {
      const { data: session } = await supabase.from('sessions')
        .select('meetup_time').eq('id', delayData.sessionId).single();
      if (session?.meetup_time) {
        const newTime = new Date(new Date(session.meetup_time).getTime() + delayData.delayMinutes * 60000).toISOString();
        await supabase.from('sessions').update({
          meetup_time: newTime,
        } as any).eq('id', delayData.sessionId);
      }
    }
    setActing(false);
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    setActing(true);
    const updatedData = { ...delayData, status: 'declined' as const };
    await supabase.from('messages').update({
      text: `⏰DELAY:${JSON.stringify(updatedData)}`,
    } as any).eq('id', messageId);
    setActing(false);
  };

  const isPending = delayData.status === 'pending';
  const isAccepted = delayData.status === 'accepted';
  const isDeclined = delayData.status === 'declined';

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6, scale: 0.97 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
      className="flex justify-center my-1.5"
    >
      <div className="w-[80%] max-w-xs rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-amber-500/5 backdrop-blur-sm border border-amber-500/15 shadow-sm">
        <div className="px-3 py-2.5">
          {/* Header - compact */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1.5">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/15 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-foreground leading-tight">
                {isMine ? "You're running late" : `${senderName} is running late`}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 font-medium">
                +{delayData.delayMinutes} min delay
              </p>
            </div>
            {/* Status indicator */}
            {isAccepted && (
              <div className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-500/10">
                <span className="text-[8px] font-bold text-emerald-400 uppercase">OK</span>
              </div>
            )}
            {isDeclined && (
              <div className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-destructive/10">
                <span className="text-[8px] font-bold text-destructive uppercase">Declined</span>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {delayData.reason && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground ml-9 mb-1.5">
              {delayData.reason}
            </p>
          )}

          {/* Actions for receiver */}
          {!isMine && isPending && (
            <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-1.5">
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                disabled={acting}
                onClick={handleAccept}
                className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/12 text-emerald-400 text-[10px] font-bold border border-emerald-500/15 hover:bg-emerald-500/20 transition-colors"
              >
                <Check className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-0.5" /> OK
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                disabled={acting}
                onClick={handleDecline}
                className="flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-destructive/8 text-destructive text-[10px] font-bold border border-destructive/12 hover:bg-destructive/15 transition-colors"
              >
                <X className="w-3 h-3 inline mr-0.5" /> Cancel meetup
              </motion.button>
            </div>
          )}

          {isMine && isPending && (
            <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground/60 italic ml-9">Waiting for response...</p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default DelayUpdateCard;

// Helper to parse delay data from message text
export const parseDelayMessage = (text: string): DelayUpdate | null => {
  if (!text.startsWith('⏰DELAY:')) return null;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(text.slice('⏰DELAY:'.length));
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
};

FILE: src/components/chat/EmojiPicker.tsx

import { useState, useMemo, useCallback, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Search, Clock, Smile, Heart, Dog, Coffee, Plane, Lightbulb, Hash, Flag } from 'lucide-react';

const CATEGORIES = [
  { id: 'recent', icon: Clock, label: 'Recent' },
  { id: 'smileys', icon: Smile, label: 'Smileys' },
  { id: 'people', icon: Heart, label: 'People' },
  { id: 'animals', icon: Dog, label: 'Animals' },

const RECENTS_KEY = 'crossy-recent-emojis';
const MAX_RECENTS = 24;

interface EmojiPickerProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onSelect: (emoji: string) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}

const EmojiPicker = ({ isOpen, onSelect, onClose }: EmojiPickerProps) => {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('smileys');
  const [recents, setRecents] = useState<string[]>(() => {
    try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(RECENTS_KEY) || '[]'); } catch { return []; }
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isOpen) setSearch('');
  }, [isOpen]);

  const addRecent = useCallback((emoji: string) => {
    setRecents(prev => {
      const next = [emoji, ...prev.filter(e => e !== emoji)].slice(0, MAX_RECENTS);
      localStorage.setItem(RECENTS_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));
      return next;
    });
  }, []);

  const handleSelect = useCallback((emoji: string) => {
    addRecent(emoji);
    onSelect(emoji);
  }, [addRecent, onSelect]);

  const filteredEmojis = useMemo(() => {
    if (!search) return null;
    const q = search.toLowerCase();
    const all = Object.values(EMOJI_DATA).flat();
    // Simple filter - just return all emojis (native emojis don't have searchable names easily)
    // For search, we show all categories flattened
    return all.slice(0, 100); // Show first 100 for perf
  }, [search]);

  const displayEmojis = filteredEmojis || (activeCategory === 'recent' ? recents : EMOJI_DATA[activeCategory] || []);

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <>
          <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40" onClick={onClose} />
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20, scale: 0.95 }}
            transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 25, stiffness: 400 }}
            className="absolute bottom-full left-0 right-0 mb-2 z-50 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-2xl border border-border/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] overflow-hidden"
            style={{ height: 320 }}
          >
            {/* Search */}
            <div className="px-3 pt-3 pb-2">
              <div className="relative">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
                <input
                  value={search}
                  onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="Search emoji..."
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl bg-secondary/50 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground text-xs outline-none border border-border/20 focus:border-primary/40 transition-colors"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Category tabs */}
            {!search && (
              <div className="flex px-2 gap-0.5 pb-1">
                {CATEGORIES.map(cat => {
                  const Icon = cat.icon;
                  const isActive = activeCategory === cat.id;
                  if (cat.id === 'recent' && recents.length === 0) return null;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={cat.id}
                      onClick={() => setActiveCategory(cat.id)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center transition-colors ${
                        isActive ? 'bg-primary/15 text-primary' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/30'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Emoji grid */}
            <div className="overflow-y-auto px-2 pb-2" style={{ height: search ? 248 : 220 }}>
              {displayEmojis.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground py-8">No recent emojis yet</p>
              ) : (
                <div className="grid grid-cols-8 gap-0.5">
                  {displayEmojis.map((emoji, i) => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={`${emoji}-${i}`}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.75 }}
                      onClick={() => handleSelect(emoji)}
                      className="w-full aspect-square rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xl hover:bg-muted/40 active:bg-muted/60 transition-colors"
                    >
                      {emoji}
                    </motion.button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        </>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
};

export default EmojiPicker;

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Check, X, Clock, RefreshCw, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import type { Invite } from '@/context/AppContext';
import CircularTimer from './CircularTimer';

const typeConfig: Record<string, { emoji: string; label: string; bgColor: string; borderColor: string }> = {
  coffee: { emoji: '☕', label: 'Coffee', bgColor: 'bg-amber-50', borderColor: 'border-amber-200' },
  walk: { emoji: '🚶', label: 'Walk', bgColor: 'bg-emerald-50', borderColor: 'border-emerald-200' },
  drink: { emoji: '🍸', label: 'Drink', bgColor: 'bg-purple-50', borderColor: 'border-purple-200' },
  premium: { emoji: '✨', label: 'Premium', bgColor: 'bg-indigo-50', borderColor: 'border-indigo-200' },
};

const statusConfig: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; icon: any }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Pending', color: 'text-amber-600', icon: Clock },
  accepted: { label: 'Accepted', color: 'text-emerald-600', icon: Check },
  declined: { label: 'Declined', color: 'text-destructive', icon: X },
  expired: { label: 'Expired', color: 'text-muted-foreground', icon: Clock },
  ignored: { label: 'No response', color: 'text-muted-foreground', icon: EyeOff },
  delayed: { label: 'Delayed', color: 'text-amber-500', icon: Clock },
  countered: { label: 'Counter sent', color: 'text-primary', icon: RefreshCw },
};

const INVITE_EXPIRY_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

interface InviteCardProps {
  invite: Invite;
  isMine: boolean;
  otherName: string;
  isOtherOnline?: boolean;
  onAccept?: (id: string) => void;
  onDecline?: (id: string) => void;
  onIgnore?: (id: string) => void;
  onChange?: (invite: Invite) => void;
}

const InviteCard = ({ invite, isMine, otherName, isOtherOnline = true, onAccept, onDecline, onIgnore, onChange }: InviteCardProps) => {
  const cfg = typeConfig[invite.type] || typeConfig.coffee;
  
  const isExpired = invite.status === 'pending' && invite.created_at && 
    (Date.now() - new Date(invite.created_at).getTime() > INVITE_EXPIRY_MS);
  const effectiveStatus = isExpired ? 'expired' : invite.status;
  
  const isPending = effectiveStatus === 'pending';
  const sCfg = statusConfig[effectiveStatus] || statusConfig.pending;
  const StatusIcon = sCfg.icon;
  const showOfflineTag = isMine && isPending && !isOtherOnline;

  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (effectiveStatus !== 'pending' || !invite.created_at) return;
    const update = () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - new Date(invite.created_at).getTime();
      const remaining = Math.max(0, INVITE_EXPIRY_MS - elapsed);
      if (remaining <= 0) { setTimeLeft('Expired'); return; }
      const mins = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
      const secs = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
      setTimeLeft(`${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`);
    };
    update();
    const iv = setInterval(update, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [effectiveStatus, invite.created_at]);

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      className={`flex ${isMine ? 'justify-end' : 'justify-start'} my-1`}
    >
      <div className={`max-w-[80%] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden ${cfg.bgColor} border ${cfg.borderColor}`}>
        <div className="px-4 py-3.5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/80 flex items-center justify-center text-xl border border-border/50">
              {cfg.emoji}
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
              <p className="text-[13px] font-semibold text-foreground leading-tight">
                {isMine ? `You invited ${otherName}` : `${otherName} invited you`}
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {cfg.label} · {invite.duration_minutes}min
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {!isPending && (
            <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <div className={`flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-white/60 ${sCfg.color}`}>
                <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">{sCfg.label}</span>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {isPending && invite.created_at && (
            <div className="mt-2.5">
              <CircularTimer
                expiresAt={new Date(invite.created_at).getTime() + INVITE_EXPIRY_MS}
                totalMs={INVITE_EXPIRY_MS}
                size={26}
              />
            </div>
          )}

          {!isMine && isPending && (
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3">
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                onClick={() => onAccept?.(invite.id)}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-[hsl(var(--status-available))] text-white text-xs font-bold"
              >
                <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                Accept
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                onClick={() => onChange?.(invite)}
                className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-primary/10 text-primary text-xs font-bold border border-primary/20"
              >
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                Suggest
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                onClick={() => onIgnore?.(invite.id)}
                className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground text-xs font-medium"
              >
                Ignore
              </motion.button>
            </div>
          )}

          {isMine && isPending && (
            <div className="mt-2.5">
              {showOfflineTag ? (
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/40" />
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">Pending · {otherName} is offline</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground italic">Waiting for response...</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default InviteCard;
