import { useState } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Clock, MessageSquare } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface MeetupActionsProps {
  sessionId: string;
  otherId: string;
}

const quickMessages = [
  { text: "I'm 5 min late", emoji: '⏱️' },
  { text: 'Traffic', emoji: '🚗' },
  { text: 'Parking now', emoji: '🅿️' },
  { text: '2 min away', emoji: '📍' },
  { text: 'Sorry, delay', emoji: '🙏' },
];

const MeetupActions = ({ sessionId, otherId }: MeetupActionsProps) => {
  const { authUser } = useApp();
  const [activePanel, setActivePanel] = useState<'none' | 'delay' | 'update'>('none');
  const [delayReason, setDelayReason] = useState('');
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);

  const togglePanel = (panel: 'delay' | 'update') => {
    setActivePanel(prev => (prev === panel ? 'none' : panel));
  };

  const handleSendDelay = async (minutes: number) => {
    if (!authUser || sending) return;
    setSending(true);
    const delayData = {
      sessionId,
      senderId: authUser.id,
      delayMinutes: minutes,
      reason: delayReason || undefined,
      status: 'pending',
    };
    await supabase.from('messages').insert({
      sender_id: authUser.id,
      receiver_id: otherId,
      text: `⏰DELAY:${JSON.stringify(delayData)}`,
    });
    toast.success(`Extra time request sent (+${minutes} min)`);
    setActivePanel('none');
    setDelayReason('');
    setSending(false);
  };

  const handleQuickUpdate = async (msg: string) => {
    if (!authUser || sending) return;
    setSending(true);
    await supabase.from('messages').insert({
      sender_id: authUser.id,
      receiver_id: otherId,
      text: msg,
    });
    toast.success('Update sent');
    setActivePanel('none');
    setSending(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1.5">
      {/* Two action buttons side by side */}
      <div className="flex gap-1.5">
        <motion.button
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          onClick={() => togglePanel('delay')}
          className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors border ${
            activePanel === 'delay'
              ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/25'
              : 'text-amber-400 bg-amber-500/8 border-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/15'
          }`}
        >
          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Need extra time
        </motion.button>
        <motion.button
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          onClick={() => togglePanel('update')}
          className={`flex-1 py-2 rounded-xl text-[11px] font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 transition-colors border ${
            activePanel === 'update'
              ? 'bg-primary/15 text-primary border-primary/25'
              : 'text-muted-foreground bg-card/40 border-border/15 hover:text-foreground hover:bg-card/60'
          }`}
        >
          <MessageSquare className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          Send update
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
        {/* Official delay request panel */}
        {activePanel === 'delay' && (
          <motion.div
            key="delay"
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="glass-card rounded-xl p-3 border border-amber-500/15 space-y-2">
              <p className="text-[9px] text-amber-400/70 font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Official request · requires approval
              </p>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1.5">
                {[5, 10, 15, 20].map(m => (
                  <motion.button
                    key={m}
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                    disabled={sending}
                    onClick={() => handleSendDelay(m)}
                    className="py-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-400 text-[10px] font-bold border border-amber-500/15 hover:bg-amber-500/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    +{m} min
                  </motion.button>
                ))}
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                {['Traffic', 'Parking', 'Delay'].map(r => (
                  <motion.button
                    key={r}
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                    onClick={() => setDelayReason(prev => (prev === r.toLowerCase() ? '' : r.toLowerCase()))}
                    className={`flex-1 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-[9px] font-semibold border transition-colors ${
                      delayReason === r.toLowerCase()
                        ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border-amber-500/25'
                        : 'bg-card/40 text-muted-foreground border-border/15'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {r}
                  </motion.button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {/* Quick update panel */}
        {activePanel === 'update' && (
          <motion.div
            key="update"
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }}
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
            className="overflow-hidden"
          >
            <div className="glass-card rounded-xl p-3 border border-border/15 space-y-2">
              <p className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground font-medium uppercase tracking-wider">
                Quick message · no approval needed
              </p>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {quickMessages.map(qm => (
                  <motion.button
                    key={qm.text}
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                    disabled={sending}
                    onClick={() => handleQuickUpdate(`${qm.emoji} ${qm.text}`)}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-card/50 text-foreground text-[10px] font-semibold border border-border/15 hover:bg-card/70 hover:border-primary/20 transition-colors"
                  >
                    {qm.emoji} {qm.text}
                  </motion.button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MeetupActions;

FILE: src/components/chat/MeetupPlaceCard.tsx

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MapPin, Coffee, Wine, TreePine, Check, Loader2, Navigation, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react';
import NavigationCard from '@/components/NavigationCard';
import MeetupActions from '@/components/chat/MeetupActions';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

interface MeetupPlaceCardProps {
  session: {
    id: string;
    user_a: string;
    user_b: string;
    invite_id: string | null;
    meetup_place_name?: string | null;
    meetup_place_type?: string | null;
    meetup_lat?: number | null;
    meetup_lng?: number | null;
    confirmed_by_sender?: boolean;
    confirmed_by_receiver?: boolean;
    proposed_by?: string | null;
    meetup_status?: string | null;
  };
  inviteType: string;
  otherUser: { name: string; latitude?: number | null; longitude?: number | null } | null;
  isSender: boolean;
}

interface PlaceSuggestion {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  lat: number;
  lng: number;
  distA: number;
  distB: number;
  etaA: string;
  etaB: string;
  icon: string;
}

const haversine = (lat1: number, lng1: number, lat2: number, lng2: number): number => {
  const R = 6371000;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLng = ((lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
};

const etaFromMeters = (m: number): string => {
  const mins = Math.max(1, Math.round(m / 80));
  if (mins < 2) return '1 min';
  return `${mins} min`;
};

const PLACE_NAMES: Record<string, { names: string[]; types: string[]; icon: string }> = {
  coffee: {
    names: ['The Brew Lab', 'Café Noir', 'Espresso House', 'Bean & Leaf', 'Morning Glory'],
    types: ['Coffee Shop', 'Café', 'Coffee Bar', 'Espresso Bar', 'Café'],
    icon: '☕',
  },
  drink: {
    names: ['The Velvet Lounge', 'Neon Bar', 'Skyline Drinks', 'The Hidden Flask', 'Ember & Ice'],
    types: ['Cocktail Bar', 'Lounge', 'Wine Bar', 'Bar', 'Rooftop Bar'],
    icon: '🍸',
  },
  walk: {
    names: ['Riverside Park', 'Sunset Gardens', 'Central Green', 'The Promenade', 'Lake View Trail'],
    types: ['Park', 'Gardens', 'Green Space', 'Walking Path', 'Trail'],
    icon: '🚶',
  },
  premium: {
    names: ['The Grand Terrace', 'Panorama Lounge', 'Crystal Garden', 'The Observatory', 'Horizon Hall'],
    types: ['Premium Venue', 'Lounge', 'Terrace', 'Rooftop', 'Event Space'],
    icon: '✨',
  },
};

const generatePlaces = (
  latA: number, lngA: number,
  latB: number, lngB: number,
  type: string
): PlaceSuggestion[] => {
  const config = PLACE_NAMES[type] || PLACE_NAMES.coffee;
  const midLat = (latA + latB) / 2;
  const midLng = (lngA + lngB) / 2;

  const offsets = [
    { dlat: 0.0005, dlng: 0.0003 },
    { dlat: -0.0004, dlng: 0.0006 },
    { dlat: 0.0002, dlng: -0.0005 },
    { dlat: -0.0006, dlng: -0.0002 },
  ];

  return offsets.map((off, i) => {
    const lat = midLat + off.dlat;
    const lng = midLng + off.dlng;
    const distA = Math.round(haversine(latA, lngA, lat, lng));
    const distB = Math.round(haversine(latB, lngB, lat, lng));
    return {
      name: config.names[i],
      type: config.types[i],
      lat, lng,
      distA, distB,
      etaA: etaFromMeters(distA),
      etaB: etaFromMeters(distB),
      icon: config.icon,
    };
  });
};

const TypeIcon = ({ type }: { type: string }) => {
  switch (type) {
    case 'coffee': return <Coffee className="w-4 h-4" />;
    case 'drink': return <Wine className="w-4 h-4" />;
    case 'walk': return <TreePine className="w-4 h-4" />;
    default: return <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" />;
  }
};

const MeetupPlaceCard = ({ session, inviteType, otherUser, isSender }: MeetupPlaceCardProps) => {
  const { currentUser, authUser } = useApp();
  const [selectedIdx, setSelectedIdx] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [showPicker, setShowPicker] = useState(false);

  const myId = authUser?.id;
  const iProposed = session.proposed_by === myId;
  const bothConfirmed = session.confirmed_by_sender && session.confirmed_by_receiver;
  const myConfirmed = isSender ? session.confirmed_by_sender : session.confirmed_by_receiver;

  const latA = currentUser?.latitude;
  const lngA = currentUser?.longitude;
  const latB = otherUser?.latitude;
  const lngB = otherUser?.longitude;

  const places = useMemo(() => {
    if (!latA || !lngA || !latB || !lngB) return [];
    return generatePlaces(latA, lngA, latB, lngB, inviteType);
  }, [latA, lngA, latB, lngB, inviteType]);

  // Compute ETA for the currently proposed place
  const proposedEta = useMemo(() => {
    if (!session.meetup_lat || !session.meetup_lng || !latA || !lngA || !latB || !lngB) return null;
    const distMe = Math.round(haversine(latA, lngA, session.meetup_lat, session.meetup_lng));
    const distThem = Math.round(haversine(latB!, lngB!, session.meetup_lat, session.meetup_lng));
    return { distMe, distThem, etaMe: etaFromMeters(distMe), etaThem: etaFromMeters(distThem) };
  }, [session.meetup_lat, session.meetup_lng, latA, lngA, latB, lngB]);

  // ── STATE: Both confirmed ──
  if (bothConfirmed && session.meetup_place_name && session.meetup_lat && session.meetup_lng) {
    const otherId = session.user_a === myId ? session.user_b : session.user_a;
    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
        <div className="max-w-[90%] w-full space-y-2">
          <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-3 border border-emerald-500/30 flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-emerald-500/15 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">Meeting Point Agreed! ✅</p>
          </div>
          <NavigationCard
            destinationName={session.meetup_place_name}
            destinationCategory={session.meetup_place_type}
            destinationIcon={PLACE_NAMES[inviteType]?.icon}
            destinationLat={session.meetup_lat}
            destinationLng={session.meetup_lng}
            userLat={latA ?? null}
            userLng={lngA ?? null}
            otherUserName={otherUser?.name}
            otherUserDistance={
              latB && lngB && session.meetup_lat && session.meetup_lng
                ? Math.round(haversine(latB, lngB, session.meetup_lat, session.meetup_lng))
                : null
            }
          />
          <MeetupActions sessionId={session.id} otherId={otherId} />
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // ── STATE: Place proposed, waiting for confirmation / counter ──
  if (session.meetup_place_name && !bothConfirmed && !showPicker) {
    const proposerName = iProposed ? 'You' : (otherUser?.name || 'They');

    // I proposed — waiting for other
    if (iProposed && myConfirmed) {
      return (
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
          <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[85%] border border-accent/20">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
              <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center">
                <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">You proposed</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{session.meetup_place_name}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {proposedEta && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2 px-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">You: {proposedEta.etaMe}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{otherUser?.name?.split(' ')[0]}: {proposedEta.etaThem}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-center py-1">
              <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-accent" />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Waiting for {otherUser?.name || 'them'} to respond...</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      );
    }

    // Other proposed — I need to confirm or counter
    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
        <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[90%] w-full border border-primary/20">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center">
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">{proposerName} suggested a place</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Confirm or suggest another?</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="glass-card rounded-xl p-3 border border-border/30 mb-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-lg">{PLACE_NAMES[inviteType]?.icon || '📍'}</span>
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">{session.meetup_place_name}</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{session.meetup_place_type}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
            {proposedEta && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-2 px-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">You: {proposedEta.etaMe}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{otherUser?.name?.split(' ')[0]}: {proposedEta.etaThem}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
              onClick={async () => {
                setConfirming(true);
                const update: Record<string, any> = isSender
                  ? { confirmed_by_sender: true }
                  : { confirmed_by_receiver: true };
                // If other already confirmed (won't happen in normal flow but be safe)
                const otherAlready = isSender ? session.confirmed_by_receiver : session.confirmed_by_sender;
                if (otherAlready) {
                  update.meetup_status = 'planning';
                  update.meetup_confirmed_at = new Date().toISOString();
                }
                await supabase.from('sessions').update(update as any).eq('id', session.id);
                setConfirming(false);
              }}
              disabled={confirming}
              className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold text-xs shadow-[0_4px_16px_hsla(var(--primary)/0.3)]"
            >
              {confirming ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin mx-auto" /> : '✓ Confirm'}
            </motion.button>
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
              onClick={() => setShowPicker(true)}
              className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl glass-card text-foreground font-semibold text-xs border border-border/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3" />
              Suggest Another
            </motion.button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  // ── STATE: No place yet OR counter-proposing (showPicker) ──
  const isCounter = showPicker && session.meetup_place_name;

  const handleSelect = async (place: PlaceSuggestion) => {
    setSaving(true);
    await supabase.from('sessions').update({
      meetup_place_name: place.name,
      meetup_place_type: place.type,
      meetup_lat: place.lat,
      meetup_lng: place.lng,
      proposed_by: myId,
      // Proposer auto-confirms, other's confirmation is reset
      confirmed_by_sender: isSender ? true : false,
      confirmed_by_receiver: isSender ? false : true,
      meetup_status: 'choosing_place',
    } as any).eq('id', session.id);
    setSaving(false);
    setShowPicker(false);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0, scale: 1 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
      <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[95%] w-full border border-primary/20">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center">
            <TypeIcon type={inviteType} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">
              {isCounter ? 'Suggest a different place' : 'Choose a meeting point'}
            </p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
              {inviteType === 'coffee' ? 'Nearby coffee spots' :
               inviteType === 'drink' ? 'Nearby bars & lounges' :
               inviteType === 'walk' ? 'Nearby parks & paths' : 'Suggested venues'}
            </p>
          </div>
          {isCounter && (
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
              onClick={() => setShowPicker(false)}
              className="ml-auto text-[10px] text-muted-foreground underline"
            >
              Cancel
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </div>

        {places.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-4">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Enable location to see suggestions</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <AnimatePresence>
              {places.map((place, i) => (
                <motion.button
                  key={i}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: i * 0.08 }}
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSelectedIdx(i);
                    handleSelect(place);
                  }}
                  disabled={saving}
                  className={`w-full text-left rounded-xl p-3 transition-all border ${
                    selectedIdx === i
                      ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/40 shadow-[0_0_12px_hsla(var(--primary)/0.15)]'
                      : 'glass-card border-border/30 hover:border-primary/30'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-2.5">
                    <span className="text-lg mt-0.5">{place.icon}</span>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground truncate">{place.name}</p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1.5">{place.type}</p>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-primary" />
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">You: {place.etaA}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <div className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-accent" />
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{otherUser?.name?.split(' ')[0]}: {place.etaB}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    {selectedIdx === i && saving && (
                      <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-primary mt-1" />
                    )}
                    {selectedIdx === i && !saving && (
                      <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-primary mt-1" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                </motion.button>
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default MeetupPlaceCard;

========================================
FILE: src/components/chat/MeetupStatusCard.tsx
========================================
import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MapPin, Navigation, Coffee, Check, Loader2, Bug } from 'lucide-react';
import MeetupActions from '@/components/chat/MeetupActions';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface MeetupStatusCardProps {
  session: {
    id: string;
    user_a: string;
    user_b: string;
    status: string;
    meetup_time?: string | null;
    meetup_status?: string;
    user_a_arrived?: boolean;
    user_b_arrived?: boolean;
    created_at?: string | null;
  };
  otherUser: { name: string; latitude?: number | null; longitude?: number | null } | null;
}

const ARRIVAL_DISTANCE_M = 30;
const STABILITY_DURATION_MS = 10_000; // 10 seconds stable proximity
const MIN_TRAVEL_DELAY_MS = 2 * 60 * 1000; // 2 min after session created
const MAX_SPEED_MPS = 50; // ~180 km/h max realistic speed

const haversineDistance = (lat1: number, lng1: number, lat2: number, lng2: number): number => {
  const R = 6371000;
  const dLat = ((lat2 - lat1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const dLng = ((lng2 - lng1) * Math.PI) / 180;
  const a = Math.sin(dLat / 2) ** 2 + Math.cos((lat1 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.cos((lat2 * Math.PI) / 180) * Math.sin(dLng / 2) ** 2;
  return R * 2 * Math.atan2(Math.sqrt(a), Math.sqrt(1 - a));
};

const getDistanceLabel = (meters: number): { label: string; color: string } => {
  if (meters > 500) return { label: `${Math.round(meters)}m away`, color: 'text-muted-foreground' };
  if (meters > 100) return { label: `${Math.round(meters)}m away`, color: 'text-amber-400' };
  if (meters > 50) return { label: '~50m away', color: 'text-accent' };
  if (meters > ARRIVAL_DISTANCE_M) return { label: 'Almost there!', color: 'text-primary' };
  return { label: 'You are together ☕', color: 'text-emerald-400' };
};

const MeetupStatusCard = ({ session, otherUser }: MeetupStatusCardProps) => {
  const { currentUser, authUser } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [distance, setDistance] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [arrived, setArrived] = useState(false);
  const [otherArrived, setOtherArrived] = useState(false);
  const [canArrive, setCanArrive] = useState(false);
  const [gpsAccuracy, setGpsAccuracy] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [lastUpdate, setLastUpdate] = useState<string>('');
  const [showDebug, setShowDebug] = useState(false);

  const isA = session.user_a === authUser?.id;
  const otherId = isA ? session.user_b : session.user_a;

  // Proximity stability tracking
  const closeStartRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const lastLocationRef = useRef<{ lat: number; lng: number; time: number } | null>(null);

  // isA defined above

  useEffect(() => {
    setArrived(isA ? !!session.user_a_arrived : !!session.user_b_arrived);
    setOtherArrived(isA ? !!session.user_b_arrived : !!session.user_a_arrived);
  }, [session, isA]);

  // Minimum travel time enforcement
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session.created_at) { setCanArrive(true); return; }
    const elapsed = Date.now() - new Date(session.created_at).getTime();
    if (elapsed >= MIN_TRAVEL_DELAY_MS) { setCanArrive(true); return; }
    const timeout = setTimeout(() => setCanArrive(true), MIN_TRAVEL_DELAY_MS - elapsed);
    return () => clearTimeout(timeout);
  }, [session.created_at]);

  // Validate location update - reject teleportation
  const isLocationValid = useCallback((lat: number, lng: number): boolean => {
    const now = Date.now();
    const prev = lastLocationRef.current;
    if (!prev) {
      lastLocationRef.current = { lat, lng, time: now };
      return true;
    }
    const dt = (now - prev.time) / 1000; // seconds
    if (dt < 0.5) return false; // too fast updates
    const dist = haversineDistance(prev.lat, prev.lng, lat, lng);
    const speed = dist / dt;
    if (speed > MAX_SPEED_MPS) {
      console.warn(`[Proximity] Rejected teleportation: ${Math.round(dist)}m in ${dt.toFixed(1)}s = ${Math.round(speed)}m/s`);
      return false;
    }
    lastLocationRef.current = { lat, lng, time: now };
    return true;
  }, []);

  // Live distance with smoothing
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!currentUser?.latitude || !currentUser?.longitude || !otherUser?.latitude || !otherUser?.longitude) return;
    if (!isLocationValid(currentUser.latitude, currentUser.longitude)) return;
    const d = haversineDistance(currentUser.latitude, currentUser.longitude, otherUser.latitude, otherUser.longitude);
    setDistance(Math.round(d));
    setLastUpdate(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());

    // Track proximity stability
    if (d <= ARRIVAL_DISTANCE_M) {
      if (!closeStartRef.current) closeStartRef.current = Date.now();
    } else {
      closeStartRef.current = null;
    }
  }, [currentUser?.latitude, currentUser?.longitude, otherUser?.latitude, otherUser?.longitude, isLocationValid]);

  // Poll other user's location every 5s with validation
  useEffect(() => {
    if (session.status === 'active' || session.status === 'ended') return;
    const otherId = isA ? session.user_b : session.user_a;
    const interval = setInterval(async () => {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('latitude, longitude').eq('id', otherId).single();
      if (data?.latitude && data?.longitude && currentUser?.latitude && currentUser?.longitude) {
        if (isLocationValid(currentUser.latitude, currentUser.longitude)) {
          const d = haversineDistance(currentUser.latitude, currentUser.longitude, data.latitude, data.longitude);
          setDistance(Math.round(d));
          setLastUpdate(new Date().toLocaleTimeString());

          if (d <= ARRIVAL_DISTANCE_M) {
            if (!closeStartRef.current) closeStartRef.current = Date.now();
          } else {
            closeStartRef.current = null;
          }
        }
      }
    }, 5000);
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, [session, isA, currentUser?.latitude, currentUser?.longitude, isLocationValid]);

  // Watch GPS accuracy
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!navigator.geolocation) return;
    const watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(
      (pos) => setGpsAccuracy(Math.round(pos.coords.accuracy)),
      () => setGpsAccuracy(null),
      { enableHighAccuracy: true }
    );
    return () => navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId);
  }, []);

  const isProximityStable = closeStartRef.current !== null && (Date.now() - closeStartRef.current) >= STABILITY_DURATION_MS;
  const hasGoodGps = gpsAccuracy !== null && gpsAccuracy < 50;

  const handleArrival = async () => {
    if (!canArrive) {
      console.warn('[Proximity] Arrival blocked: minimum travel time not met');
      return;
    }
    setArrived(true);
    const update: any = isA ? { user_a_arrived: true } : { user_b_arrived: true };
    const otherAlsoArrived = isA ? session.user_b_arrived : session.user_a_arrived;
    if (otherAlsoArrived) {
      update.status = 'active';
      update.meetup_status = 'active';
      update.started_at = new Date().toISOString();
    } else {
      update.meetup_status = 'ready';
    }
    await supabase.from('sessions').update(update).eq('id', session.id);
    console.log('[Proximity] Arrival confirmed', { distance, gpsAccuracy, canArrive });
  };

  // If session is active, show link to session screen
  if (session.status === 'active') {
    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
        <motion.button
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
          onClick={() => navigate(`/session/${session.id}`)}
          className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[85%] w-full border border-emerald-500/30 text-left"
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 flex items-center justify-center">
              <Coffee className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
            </div>
            <div className="flex-1">
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">☕ Coffee in Progress!</p>
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Tap to view session & tokens</p>
            </div>
            <Navigation className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-400" />
          </div>
        </motion.button>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  if (session.status === 'ended') {
    return (
      <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
        <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[85%] border border-primary/20">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Coffee className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-foreground">Session completed ✨</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    );
  }

  const distInfo = distance !== null ? getDistanceLabel(distance) : null;
  // Arrival is allowed when: canArrive + (stable proximity OR manual confirmation with good GPS)
  const autoArrivalReady = canArrive && isProximityStable && hasGoodGps;
  const manualArrivalAllowed = canArrive; // Always allow manual if travel time passed

  return (
    <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="flex justify-center my-3">
      <div className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 max-w-[90%] w-full border border-primary/20">
        {/* Distance */}
        {distInfo && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
            <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
            <motion.span
              key={distInfo.label}
              initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
              className={`text-xs font-bold ${distInfo.color}`}
            >
              {distInfo.label}
            </motion.span>
          </div>
        )}

        {!canArrive && (
          <div className="mb-3 p-2 rounded-xl bg-amber-500/10 border border-amber-500/20">
            <p className="text-[10px] text-amber-400 text-center font-semibold">
              ⏳ Travel to the meeting point first...
            </p>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Arrival buttons */}
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={handleArrival}
            disabled={arrived || !manualArrivalAllowed}
            className={`w-full py-3 rounded-xl font-semibold text-sm transition-all ${
              arrived
                ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30'
                : !manualArrivalAllowed
                ? 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30 cursor-not-allowed'
                : 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_4px_16px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]'
            }`}
          >
            {arrived ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2"><Check className="w-4 h-4" /> I'm Here!</span>
            ) : !manualArrivalAllowed ? (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">On my way...</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2"><MapPin className="w-4 h-4" /> I've Arrived</span>
            )}
          </motion.button>

          {/* Running Late / Quick Update */}
          {!arrived && (
            <MeetupActions sessionId={session.id} otherId={otherId} />
          )}

          {arrived && !otherArrived && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-center py-1">
              <Loader2 className="w-3 h-3 animate-spin text-primary" />
              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Waiting for {otherUser?.name || 'them'} to arrive...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {otherArrived && !arrived && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400 text-center font-semibold">
              {otherUser?.name || 'They'} arrived! Confirm yours ☕
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Debug toggle */}
        <motion.button
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
          onClick={() => setShowDebug(p => !p)}
          className="mt-3 w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-1 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground/50 hover:text-muted-foreground transition-colors"
        >
          <Bug className="w-3 h-3" /> {showDebug ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} debug info
        </motion.button>

        {showDebug && (
          <motion.div initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }} className="mt-2 p-2 rounded-lg bg-muted/20 text-[9px] text-muted-foreground font-mono space-y-0.5">
            <p>Distance: {distance !== null ? `${distance}m` : 'N/A'}</p>
            <p>GPS accuracy: {gpsAccuracy !== null ? `±${gpsAccuracy}m` : 'N/A'}</p>
            <p>Last update: {lastUpdate || 'N/A'}</p>
            <p>Stable close: {closeStartRef.current ? `${((Date.now() - closeStartRef.current) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s` : 'no'}</p>
            <p>Can arrive: {canArrive ? '✓' : '✗'} | Auto-ready: {autoArrivalReady ? '✓' : '✗'}</p>
            <p>Min travel: {MIN_TRAVEL_DELAY_MS / 1000}s | Stability: {STABILITY_DURATION_MS / 1000}s</p>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
};

export default MeetupStatusCard;

const ProposalBuilder = ({ receiverId, onClose, onSent }: ProposalBuilderProps) => {
  const { authUser, wallet, refreshWallet, currentUser } = useApp();
  const [step, setStep] = useState<'activity' | 'place' | 'time' | 'payment' | 'review'>('activity');
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [place, setPlace] = useState<{ name: string; category: string; lat: number; lng: number } | null>(null);
  const [timeMinutes, setTimeMinutes] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [duration, setDuration] = useState(30);
  const [customTime, setCustomTime] = useState('');
  const [showCustomTime, setShowCustomTime] = useState(false);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [nearbyPlaces, setNearbyPlaces] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [paymentPref, setPaymentPref] = useState('split');

  // Generate quick nearby places based on activity
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!activity || !currentUser?.latitude) return;
    const lat = currentUser.latitude;
    const lng = currentUser.longitude!;
    const placeSuggestions: Record<string, { name: string; category: string }[]> = {
      coffee: [
        { name: 'Nearby Café', category: 'cafe' },
        { name: 'Coffee Corner', category: 'cafe' },
        { name: 'Espresso Bar', category: 'cafe' },

    };
    const suggestions = (placeSuggestions[activity] || placeSuggestions.coffee).map((p, i) => ({
      ...p,
      lat: lat + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005,
      lng: lng + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.005,
      distance: Math.round(100 + Math.random() * 800),
    }));
    setNearbyPlaces(suggestions);
  }, [activity, currentUser?.latitude]);

  const selectedOpt = INVITE_OPTIONS.find(o => o.type === activity);
  const tokenCost = selectedOpt?.token_cost || 5;

  const handleSend = async () => {
    if (!authUser || !activity || timeMinutes === null) return;
    if ((wallet?.token_balance ?? 0) < tokenCost) {
      toast.error('Not enough tokens');
      return;
    }

    setSending(true);

    // Anti-spam: max 5 invites per 10 minutes
    const tenMinAgo = new Date(Date.now() - 10 * 60000).toISOString();
    const { count: recentCount } = await supabase.from('invites').select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('sender_id', authUser.id)
      .gte('created_at', tenMinAgo);
    if ((recentCount ?? 0) >= 5) {
      toast.error('Too many invites. Please wait a few minutes.');
      setSending(false);
      return;
    }

    // Check existing invites with this user
    const { data: existing } = await supabase.from('invites').select('id')
      .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${receiverId}),and(sender_id.eq.${receiverId},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id})`)
      .in('status', ['pending', 'accepted']);
    if (existing && existing.length > 0) {
      toast.error('Active invite already exists');
      setSending(false);
      return;
    }

    // Create invite
    const { data: invite, error: invErr } = await supabase.from('invites').insert({
      sender_id: authUser.id,
      receiver_id: receiverId,
      type: activity,
      token_cost: tokenCost,
      duration_minutes: duration,
    }).select().single();

    if (invErr || !invite) {
      toast.error('Failed to send proposal');
      setSending(false);
      return;
    }

    // Create meeting proposal
    const proposedTime = timeMinutes === 0
      ? new Date().toISOString()
      : showCustomTime && customTime
        ? new Date(customTime).toISOString()
        : new Date(Date.now() + timeMinutes * 60000).toISOString();

    await supabase.from('meeting_proposals').insert({
      invite_id: invite.id,
      sender_id: authUser.id,
      receiver_id: receiverId,
      activity_type: activity,
      place_name: place?.name || null,
      place_category: place?.category || null,
      place_lat: place?.lat || null,
      place_lng: place?.lng || null,
      proposed_time: proposedTime,
      duration_minutes: duration,
      status: 'pending',
      payment_preference: paymentPref,
    } as any);

    // Deduct tokens
    await supabase.from('wallets').update({
      token_balance: (wallet?.token_balance ?? 0) - tokenCost,
      total_spent: (wallet?.total_spent ?? 0) + tokenCost,
    }).eq('user_id', authUser.id);
    await refreshWallet();

    toast.success('Meeting proposal sent!');
    setSending(false);
    onSent();
  };

  const canProceedFromActivity = !!activity;
  const canProceedFromPlace = true; // place is optional
  const canProceedFromTime = timeMinutes !== null || (showCustomTime && customTime);

  const activityEmoji = activities.find(a => a.key === activity)?.emoji || '☕';

  return (
    <>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
        className="fixed inset-0 bg-background/70 backdrop-blur-md z-40"
        onClick={onClose}
      />
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 100 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 100 }}
        transition={{ type: 'spring', damping: 28, stiffness: 300 }}
        className="fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl rounded-t-3xl border-t border-border/15 shadow-[0_-8px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)] max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="sticky top-0 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl z-10 px-5 pt-4 pb-3 border-b border-border/10">
          <div className="w-10 h-1 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/20 mx-auto mb-3" />
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
              <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">Plan a Meeting</h3>
            </div>
            <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={onClose} className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-muted/20 flex items-center justify-center">
              <X className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            </motion.button>
          </div>
          {/* Steps indicator */}
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-3">
            {['activity', 'place', 'time', 'payment', 'review'].map((s, i) => (
              <div key={s} className={`h-1 flex-1 rounded-full transition-all ${
                ['activity', 'place', 'time', 'payment', 'review'].indexOf(step) >= i
                  ? 'bg-primary shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.4)]'
                  : 'bg-muted/20'
              }`} />
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="px-5 py-4">
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {/* STEP 1: Activity */}
            {step === 'activity' && (
              <motion.div key="activity" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">What would you like to do?</p>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {activities.map(a => {
                    const Icon = a.icon;
                    const selected = activity === a.key;
                    return (
                      <motion.button
                        key={a.key}
                        whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                        onClick={() => setActivity(a.key)}
                        className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                          selected
                            ? `bg-gradient-to-r ${a.gradient} ${a.border} shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.1)]`
                            : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10 hover:border-border/30'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <div className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl ${selected ? a.activeBg : 'bg-card/50'}`}>
                          {a.emoji}
                        </div>
                        <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${selected ? a.color : 'text-foreground'}`}>{a.label}</span>
                        {selected && <div className="ml-auto w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center"><ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 text-primary-foreground" /></div>}
                      </motion.button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  disabled={!canProceedFromActivity}
                  onClick={() => setStep('place')}
                  className={`w-full mt-4 py-3.5 rounded-2xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
                    canProceedFromActivity
                      ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]'
                      : 'bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground'
                  }`}
                >
                  Next: Choose Place
                </motion.button>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* STEP 2: Place */}
            {step === 'place' && (
              <motion.div key="place" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">Where should you meet? (optional)</p>

                {/* Current location option */}
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={() => setPlace(null)}
                  className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border mb-2 transition-all ${
                    !place ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/20' : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center">
                    <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-left">
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">Decide later</p>
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Choose after accepting</p>
                  </div>
                </motion.button>

                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {nearbyPlaces.map((p, i) => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={i}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                      onClick={() => setPlace({ name: p.name, category: p.category, lat: p.lat, lng: p.lng })}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-3.5 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                        place?.name === p.name ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/20' : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-card/50 flex items-center justify-center text-lg">
                        {p.category === 'cafe' ? '☕' : p.category === 'park' ? '🌿' : '🍸'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-left flex-1">
                        <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground">{p.name}</p>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{p.distance}m away</p>
                      </div>
                    </motion.button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                  <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => setStep('activity')} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
                    Back
                  </motion.button>
                  <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => setStep('time')} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-sm font-bold shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]">
                    Next: Time
                  </motion.button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* STEP 3: Time & Duration */}
            {step === 'time' && (
              <motion.div key="time" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">When do you want to meet?</p>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  {timeOptions.map(t => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={t.minutes}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                      onClick={() => { setTimeMinutes(t.minutes); setShowCustomTime(false); }}
                      className={`py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition-all ${
                        timeMinutes === t.minutes && !showCustomTime
                          ? 'bg-primary/15 border-primary/30 text-primary shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.15)]'
                          : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10 text-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mx-auto mb-1 opacity-60" />
                      {t.label}
                    </motion.button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={() => { setShowCustomTime(!showCustomTime); setTimeMinutes(null); }}
                  className={`w-full mt-2 py-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition-all ${
                    showCustomTime ? 'bg-primary/15 border-primary/30 text-primary' : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10 text-muted-foreground'
                  }`}
                >
                  <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1.5" />
                  Custom time
                </motion.button>

                {showCustomTime && (
                  <input
                    type="datetime-local"
                    value={customTime}
                    onChange={e => setCustomTime(e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full mt-2 px-4 py-3 rounded-xl bg-muted/10 border border-border/10 text-foreground text-xs outline-none focus:border-primary/30"
                  />
                )}

                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-4 mb-2">Duration</p>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  {durationOptions.map(d => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={d.value}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                      onClick={() => setDuration(d.value)}
                      className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border transition-all ${
                        duration === d.value
                          ? 'bg-primary/15 border-primary/30 text-primary'
                          : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10 text-foreground'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {d.label}
                    </motion.button>
                  ))}
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                  <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => setStep('place')} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
                    Back
                  </motion.button>
                  <motion.button
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                    disabled={!canProceedFromTime}
                    onClick={() => setStep('payment')}
                    className={`flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm font-bold transition-all ${
                      canProceedFromTime
                        ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]'
                        : 'bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Next: Payment
                  </motion.button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* STEP 4: Payment */}
            {step === 'payment' && (
              <motion.div key="payment" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-3">How do you want to pay?</p>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {paymentOptions.map(p => (
                    <motion.button
                      key={p.key}
                      whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                      onClick={() => setPaymentPref(p.key)}
                      className={`w-full flex items-center gap-3 p-4 rounded-2xl border transition-all ${
                        paymentPref === p.key
                          ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/25 shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.1)]'
                          : 'bg-muted/10 border-border/10 hover:border-border/30'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl ${paymentPref === p.key ? 'bg-primary/15' : 'bg-card/50'}`}>
                        {p.emoji}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-left">
                        <span className={`text-sm font-semibold ${paymentPref === p.key ? 'text-primary' : 'text-foreground'}`}>{p.label}</span>
                        <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{p.desc}</p>
                      </div>
                      {paymentPref === p.key && (
                        <div className="ml-auto w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-primary flex items-center justify-center">
                          <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3 text-primary-foreground" />
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </motion.button>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                  <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => setStep('time')} className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
                    Back
                  </motion.button>
                  <motion.button
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                    onClick={() => setStep('review')}
                    className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-sm font-bold shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]"
                  >
                    Review
                  </motion.button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}

            {/* STEP 5: Review */}
            {step === 'review' && (
              <motion.div key="review" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                <div className="bg-gradient-to-br from-primary/10 to-accent/5 rounded-2xl border border-primary/15 p-4 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-card/50 flex items-center justify-center text-2xl border border-border/10">
                      {activityEmoji}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <p className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground">{activities.find(a => a.key === activity)?.label} Meeting</p>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{tokenCost} tokens · {duration} min</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {place && (
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
                      <span>{place.name}</span>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
                    <span>
                      {timeMinutes === 0 ? 'Now' :
                       showCustomTime && customTime ? new Date(customTime).toLocaleString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) :
                       `In ${timeMinutes} min`}
                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <span className="text-base">{paymentOptions.find(p => p.key === paymentPref)?.emoji}</span>
                    <span className="font-medium">Payment: {paymentOptions.find(p => p.key === paymentPref)?.label}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4">
                  <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={() => setStep('payment')} className="flex-1 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-muted/20 text-muted-foreground text-sm font-semibold">
                    Back
                  </motion.button>
                  <motion.button
                    whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                    disabled={sending}
                    onClick={handleSend}
                    className="flex-1 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground text-sm font-bold shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]"
                  >
                    {sending ? 'Sending...' : 'Send Proposal'}
                  </motion.button>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </>
  );
};

export default ProposalBuilder;


========================================
FILE: src/components/chat/ProposalCard.tsx

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { MapPin, Clock, Check, Calendar, Navigation, ChevronDown } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import ProposalEditor from './ProposalEditor';

interface Proposal {
  id: string;
  invite_id: string | null;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  activity_type: string;
  place_name: string | null;
  place_category: string | null;
  place_lat: number | null;
  place_lng: number | null;
  proposed_time: string | null;
  duration_minutes: number;
  status: string;
  parent_proposal_id: string | null;
  created_at: string | null;
  payment_preference?: string;
}

const paymentLabels: Record<string, { emoji: string; senderLabel: string; receiverLabel: string }> = {
  i_pay: { emoji: '💳', senderLabel: "I'll pay", receiverLabel: "They'll pay" },
  split: { emoji: '🤝', senderLabel: 'Split 50/50', receiverLabel: 'Split 50/50' },
  they_pay: { emoji: '🎁', senderLabel: "They pay", receiverLabel: "I'll pay" },
};

interface ProposalCardProps {
  proposal: Proposal;
  previousProposal?: Proposal | null;
  isMine: boolean;
  otherName: string;
  isOtherOnline?: boolean;
  isSuperseded?: boolean;
  onCounter?: (proposal: Proposal) => void;
}

const activityConfig: Record<string, { emoji: string; label: string; gradient: string; border: string }> = {
  coffee: { emoji: '☕', label: 'Coffee', gradient: 'from-amber-500/10 to-amber-600/5', border: 'border-amber-500/15' },
  walk: { emoji: '🚶', label: 'Walk', gradient: 'from-emerald-500/10 to-emerald-600/5', border: 'border-emerald-500/15' },
  drink: { emoji: '🍸', label: 'Drink', gradient: 'from-purple-500/10 to-purple-600/5', border: 'border-purple-500/15' },
};

const PROPOSAL_EXPIRY_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

const statusBadge: Record<string, { label: string; color: string; bg: string }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Pending', color: 'text-amber-400', bg: 'bg-amber-500/10' },
  accepted: { label: 'Confirmed ✓', color: 'text-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-500/10' },
  confirmed: { label: 'Confirmed ✓', color: 'text-emerald-400', bg: 'bg-emerald-500/10' },
  countered: { label: 'Replaced', color: 'text-muted-foreground', bg: 'bg-muted/10' },
  expired: { label: 'Expired', color: 'text-muted-foreground', bg: 'bg-muted/10' },
  ignored: { label: 'No response', color: 'text-muted-foreground/50', bg: 'bg-muted/5' },
  cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', color: 'text-destructive', bg: 'bg-destructive/10' },
};

const ProposalCard = ({ proposal, previousProposal, isMine, otherName, isOtherOnline = true, isSuperseded = false, onCounter }: ProposalCardProps) => {
  const { authUser } = useApp();
  const [acting, setActing] = useState(false);
  const [showEditor, setShowEditor] = useState(false);

  const cfg = activityConfig[proposal.activity_type] || activityConfig.coffee;

  const isExpired = proposal.status === 'pending' && proposal.created_at &&
    (Date.now() - new Date(proposal.created_at).getTime() > PROPOSAL_EXPIRY_MS);
  const effectiveStatus = isSuperseded ? 'countered' : (isExpired ? 'expired' : proposal.status);

  const badge = statusBadge[effectiveStatus] || statusBadge.pending;
  const isPending = effectiveStatus === 'pending';
  const isAccepted = effectiveStatus === 'accepted' || effectiveStatus === 'confirmed';
  const isInactive = ['countered', 'expired', 'ignored', 'cancelled'].includes(effectiveStatus);

  const proposedTime = proposal.proposed_time ? new Date(proposal.proposed_time) : null;
  const timeStr = proposedTime?.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
  const dateStr = proposedTime?.toLocaleDateString([], { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });

  // Detect changes from previous proposal
  const changes = previousProposal ? {
    time: previousProposal.proposed_time !== proposal.proposed_time,
    place: previousProposal.place_name !== proposal.place_name,
    payment: previousProposal.payment_preference !== proposal.payment_preference,
  } : { time: false, place: false, payment: false };
  const hasChanges = changes.time || changes.place || changes.payment;

  // Countdown for pending
  const [timeLeft, setTimeLeft] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (effectiveStatus !== 'pending' || !proposal.created_at) return;
    const update = () => {
      const elapsed = Date.now() - new Date(proposal.created_at!).getTime();
      const remaining = Math.max(0, PROPOSAL_EXPIRY_MS - elapsed);
      if (remaining <= 0) { setTimeLeft('Expired'); return; }
      const mins = Math.floor(remaining / 60000);
      const secs = Math.floor((remaining % 60000) / 1000);
      setTimeLeft(`${mins}:${secs.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`);
    };
    update();
    const iv = setInterval(update, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [effectiveStatus, proposal.created_at]);

  const [countdown, setCountdown] = useState('');
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isAccepted || !proposedTime) return;
    const update = () => {
      const diff = proposedTime.getTime() - Date.now();
      if (diff <= 0) { setCountdown('Now!'); return; }
      const mins = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
      const secs = Math.floor((diff % 60000) / 1000);
      setCountdown(mins > 0 ? `${mins}m ${secs}s` : `${secs}s`);
    };
    update();
    const iv = setInterval(update, 1000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [isAccepted, proposedTime]);

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    setActing(true);
    await supabase.from('meeting_proposals').update({ status: 'accepted' } as any).eq('id', proposal.id);
    if (proposal.invite_id) {
      const { data: sessions } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('id')
        .eq('invite_id', proposal.invite_id).limit(1);
      if (sessions && sessions.length > 0) {
        await supabase.from('sessions').update({
          meetup_place_name: proposal.place_name,
          meetup_lat: proposal.place_lat,
          meetup_lng: proposal.place_lng,
          meetup_time: proposal.proposed_time,
          meetup_status: proposal.place_name ? 'approaching' : 'choosing_place',
          status: 'awaiting_arrival',
          confirmed_by_sender: true,
          confirmed_by_receiver: true,
          meetup_confirmed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
        } as any).eq('id', sessions[0].id);
      }
    }
    toast.success('Meeting confirmed!');
    setActing(false);
  };

  const handleIgnore = async () => {
    setActing(true);
    await supabase.from('meeting_proposals').update({ status: 'ignored' } as any).eq('id', proposal.id);
    setActing(false);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8, scale: 0.95 }}
        animate={{ opacity: isInactive ? 0.5 : 1, y: 0, scale: isInactive ? 0.97 : 1 }}
        className="flex justify-center my-2"
      >
        <div className={`w-[90%] max-w-sm rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br ${cfg.gradient} backdrop-blur-sm border ${cfg.border} shadow-[0_4px_24px_rgba(0,0,0,0.2)] ${isInactive ? 'opacity-60' : ''}`}>
          <div className="px-4 py-4">
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-3">
              <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-card/50 backdrop-blur flex items-center justify-center text-2xl border border-border/10 shadow-sm">
                {cfg.emoji}
              </div>
              <div className="flex-1">
                <p className="text-[13px] font-bold text-foreground">
                  {isInactive ? `${cfg.label} Proposal` : hasChanges ? '🔄 Updated Proposal' : `${cfg.label} Meeting`}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {isMine ? `You proposed to ${otherName}` : `${otherName} proposes`}
                </p>
              </div>
              <div className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg ${badge.bg}`}>
                <span className={`text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider ${badge.color}`}>{badge.label}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Details — compact for inactive */}
            {!isInactive && (
              <div className="space-y-2 mb-3">
                {proposal.place_name && (
                  <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${changes.place ? 'bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 border border-blue-500/15' : ''}`}>
                    <MapPin className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${changes.place ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-primary'}`} />
                    <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${changes.place ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                      {proposal.place_name}
                      {changes.place && <span className="text-[9px] ml-1.5 opacity-60">changed</span>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                {proposedTime && (
                  <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${changes.time ? 'bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 border border-blue-500/15' : ''}`}>
                    <Clock className={`w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0 ${changes.time ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-primary'}`} />
                    <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${changes.time ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                      {timeStr} · {dateStr}
                      {changes.time && <span className="text-[9px] ml-1.5 opacity-60">changed</span>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calendar className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary shrink-0" />
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{proposal.duration_minutes} min</span>
                </div>
                {proposal.payment_preference && (
                  <div className={`flex items-center gap-2 ${changes.payment ? 'bg-blue-500/10 rounded-lg px-2 py-1 border border-blue-500/15' : ''}`}>
                    <span className="text-sm">{paymentLabels[proposal.payment_preference]?.emoji || '🤝'}</span>
                    <span className={`text-xs font-medium ${changes.payment ? 'text-blue-400' : 'text-foreground'}`}>
                      {isMine
                        ? paymentLabels[proposal.payment_preference]?.senderLabel
                        : paymentLabels[proposal.payment_preference]?.receiverLabel
                      }
                      {changes.payment && <span className="text-[9px] ml-1.5 opacity-60">changed</span>}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Compact summary for inactive */}
            {isInactive && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-2">
                {proposal.place_name && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><MapPin className="w-3 h-3" />{proposal.place_name}</span>}
                {proposedTime && <span className="flex items-center gap-1"><Clock className="w-3 h-3" />{timeStr}</span>}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Expiry countdown */}
            {isPending && timeLeft && (
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-3">
                <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground/60" />
                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/60 font-medium">Expires in {timeLeft}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Accepted countdown */}
            {isAccepted && countdown && (
              <div className="bg-emerald-500/10 border border-emerald-500/20 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 mb-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-400">Meeting Confirmed</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-emerald-400">{countdown}</span>
                </div>
                {proposal.place_name && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mt-2">
                    <Navigation className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-400" />
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-400/80">Head to {proposal.place_name}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Actions: Accept / Change / Ignore */}
            {!isMine && isPending && (
              <div className="flex gap-2">
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                  disabled={acting}
                  onClick={handleAccept}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 text-xs font-bold border border-emerald-500/20 hover:bg-emerald-500/25 transition-colors"
                >
                  <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                  Accept
                </motion.button>
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                  onClick={() => setShowEditor(true)}
                  className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl bg-blue-500/10 text-blue-400 text-xs font-bold border border-blue-500/15 hover:bg-blue-500/20 transition-colors"
                >
                  <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />
                  Change
                </motion.button>
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                  disabled={acting}
                  onClick={handleIgnore}
                  className="py-2.5 px-3 rounded-xl text-muted-foreground/60 text-xs font-medium hover:text-muted-foreground transition-colors"
                >
                  Ignore
                </motion.button>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Sender can also change their own pending proposal */}
            {isMine && isPending && (
              <div className="mt-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                {!isOtherOnline ? (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/40" />
                    <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 font-medium">Pending · {otherName} is offline</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/70 italic">Waiting for {otherName}'s response...</p>
                )}
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
                  onClick={() => setShowEditor(true)}
                  className="text-[10px] text-blue-400 font-semibold hover:text-blue-300 transition-colors"
                >
                  Edit
                </motion.button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </motion.div>

      {/* Full-screen proposal editor */}
      <AnimatePresence>
        {showEditor && (
          <ProposalEditor
            proposal={proposal}
            isMine={isMine}
            onClose={() => setShowEditor(false)}
            onSent={() => setShowEditor(false)}
          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </>
  );
};

export default ProposalCard;


========================================
FILE: src/components/chat/ProposalEditor.tsx
