import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect, useRef, ReactNode, useCallback } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import type { User as SupabaseUser, Session } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

interface Profile {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  username: string | null;
  email: string | null;
  avatar: string;
  bio: string;
  age: number | null;
  city: string;
  interests: string[];
  trust_score: number;
  sessions_completed: number;
  early_leaves: number;
  no_shows: number;
  avg_rating: number;
  latitude: number | null;
  longitude: number | null;
  bluetooth_ready: boolean;
  is_online: boolean;
  last_active_at: string;
  distance_meters?: number;
  is_available?: boolean;
  activity_type?: string | null;
  available_until?: string | null;
  interested_in?: string;
  gender?: string | null;
}

interface ContactRequest {
  id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string | null;
}

interface Message {
  id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  text: string;
  created_at: string | null;
  seen_at: string | null;
}

export interface Invite {
  id: string;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  type: string;
  token_cost: number;
  duration_minutes: number;
  status: string;
  created_at: string | null;
}

interface Wallet {
  user_id: string;
  token_balance: number;
  total_spent: number;
  total_received: number;
  updated_at: string;
}

interface AppNotification {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  type: string;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  avatar_url: string;
  action_url: string;
  is_read: boolean;
  created_at: string;
}

export interface PostedActivity {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  category: string;
  activityType: string;
  title: string;
  meetingPoint: string;
  time: string;
  duration: string;
  whoCanJoin: string;
  payment: string;
  deposit: string;
  pace: string;
  isGroup: boolean;
  maxPeople: number;
  latitude: number;
  longitude: number;
  createdAt: string;
  status: string;
}

export interface ActivityParticipant {
  id: string;
  activity_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  status: string;
  created_at: string;
}

interface AppState {
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  currentUser: Profile | null;
  authUser: SupabaseUser | null;
  nearbyUsers: Profile[];
  contacts: ContactRequest[];
  messages: Message[];
  invites: Invite[];
  wallet: Wallet | null;
  notifications: AppNotification[];
  postedActivities: PostedActivity[];
  activityParticipants: Record<string, ActivityParticipant[]>;
  loading: boolean;
  activeChatId: string | null;
  setActiveChatId: (id: string | null) => void;
  login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ error?: string }>;
  register: (name: string, email: string, password: string) => Promise<{ error?: string }>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  sendRequest: (userId: string) => Promise<void>;
  acceptRequest: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
  declineRequest: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
  cancelRequest: (requestId: string) => Promise<void>;
  sendMessage: (receiverId: string, text: string) => Promise<void>;
  isConnected: (userId: string) => boolean;
  getRequestStatus: (userId: string) => ContactRequest | undefined;
  fetchNearbyUsers: (radius: number) => Promise<void>;
  updateLocation: (lat: number, lng: number) => Promise<void>;
  fetchMessages: (userId: string, limit?: number, offset?: number) => Promise<void>;
  markMessagesAsRead: (otherUserId: string) => Promise<void>;
  refreshContacts: () => Promise<void>;
  refreshWallet: () => Promise<void>;
  updateProfile: (updates: Partial<Profile>) => Promise<{ error?: string }>;
  markNotificationRead: (id: string) => void;
  markAllNotificationsRead: () => void;
  clearNotifications: () => void;
  goLive: () => Promise<'success' | 'denied' | 'blocked' | 'error'>;
  goOffline: () => Promise<void>;
  blockUser: (userId: string) => Promise<void>;
  reportUser: (userId: string, reason: string) => Promise<void>;
  isCompatible: (user: { gender?: string | null; interested_in?: string }) => boolean;
  blockedIds: string[];
  acceptInvite: (inviteId: string) => Promise<void>;
  declineInvite: (inviteId: string) => Promise<void>;
  fetchInvites: (userId: string) => Promise<void>;
  sendJoinRequest: (activityId: string) => Promise<string | null>;
  acceptJoinRequest: (participantId: string) => Promise<void>;
  declineJoinRequest: (participantId: string) => Promise<void>;
  ignoreJoinRequest: (participantId: string) => Promise<void>;
  cancelActivity: (activityId: string) => Promise<void>;
  postActivity: (activity: Omit<PostedActivity, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'latitude' | 'longitude' | 'createdAt' | 'status'>) => Promise<PostedActivity | null>;
  fetchActivities: () => Promise<void>;
  leaveActivity: (activityId: string) => Promise<void>;
  fetchParticipants: (activityId: string) => Promise<void>;
  getParticipantCount: (activityId: string) => number;
  getMyRequestStatus: (activityId: string) => string | null;
  getUnreadCount: (otherUserId: string) => number;
}

const AppContext = createContext<AppState | undefined>(undefined);

export const AppProvider = ({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) => {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session | null>(null);
  const [authUser, setAuthUser] = useState<SupabaseUser | null>(null);
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState<Profile | null>(null);
  const [nearbyUsers, setNearbyUsers] = useState<Profile[]>([]);
  const [contacts, setContacts] = useState<ContactRequest[]>([]);
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Message[]>([]);
  const [invites, setInvites] = useState<Invite[]>([]);
  const [wallet, setWallet] = useState<Wallet | null>(null);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState<AppNotification[]>([]);
  const [blockedIds, setBlockedIds] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [postedActivities, setPostedActivities] = useState<PostedActivity[]>([]);
  const [activityParticipants, setActivityParticipants] = useState<Record<string, ActivityParticipant[]>>({});
  const [activeChatId, setActiveChatId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const activeChatIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => { activeChatIdRef.current = activeChatId; }, [activeChatId]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const isAuthenticated = !!session;

  const addNotification = useCallback(async (n: { type: string; title: string; message: string; avatar_url?: string; action_url?: string }) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const row = {
      user_id: authUser.id,
      type: n.type,
      title: n.title,
      message: n.message,
      avatar_url: n.avatar_url || '',
      action_url: n.action_url || '',
      is_read: false,
    };
    const { data } = await supabase.from('notifications').insert(row as any).select().single();
    if (data) {
      setNotifications(prev => [data as any, ...prev].slice(0, 50));
    }
    toast(n.title, {
      description: n.message,
      action: n.action_url ? {
        label: 'Open',
        onClick: () => {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('app-navigate', { detail: n.action_url }));
        },
      } : undefined,
    });

    // Play notification sound
    try {
      const audio = new Audio('/notification.mp3');
      audio.volume = 0.3;
      audio.play().catch(() => {});
    } catch {}


    // Browser push
    if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'granted') {
      try { new Notification(n.title, { body: n.message, icon: n.avatar_url || '/placeholder.svg' }); } catch {}
    }
  }, [authUser]);

  const fetchNotifications = useCallback(async (userId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('notifications').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(50);
    if (data) setNotifications(data as any);
  }, []);

  const markNotificationRead = useCallback(async (id: string) => {
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => n.id === id ? { ...n, is_read: true } : n));
    await supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true } as any).eq('id', id);
  }, []);

  const markAllNotificationsRead = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    setNotifications(prev => prev.map(n => ({ ...n, is_read: true })));
    await supabase.from('notifications').update({ is_read: true } as any).eq('user_id', authUser.id).eq('is_read', false);
  }, [authUser]);

  const clearNotifications = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    setNotifications([]);
    await supabase.from('notifications').delete().eq('user_id', authUser.id);
  }, [authUser]);

  // Request browser notification permission
  useEffect(() => {
    if ('Notification' in window && Notification.permission === 'default') {
      Notification.requestPermission();
    }
  }, []);

  // Auth state listener
  useEffect(() => {
    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(
      async (event, session) => {
        setSession(session);
        setAuthUser(session?.user ?? null);
        if (session?.user) {
        setTimeout(() => {
            fetchProfile(session.user.id);
            fetchWallet(session.user.id);
            fetchContacts();
            fetchBlocks(session.user.id);
            fetchNotifications(session.user.id);
            fetchInvites(session.user.id);
          }, 0);
        } else {
          setCurrentUser(null);
          setWallet(null);
          setContacts([]);
          setMessages([]);
          setNearbyUsers([]);
        }
        setLoading(false);
      }
    );

    supabase.auth.getSession().then(({ data: { session } }) => {
      setSession(session);
      setAuthUser(session?.user ?? null);
      if (session?.user) {
        fetchProfile(session.user.id);
        fetchWallet(session.user.id);
        fetchContacts();
        fetchBlocks(session.user.id);
        fetchNotifications(session.user.id);
        fetchInvites(session.user.id);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });

    return () => subscription.unsubscribe();
  }, []);

  // Realtime subscriptions for contacts, messages, invites, gifts, sessions
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;

    const contactSub = supabase
      .channel(`contact-requests-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'contact_requests' }, (payload) => {
        fetchContacts();
        if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
          const req = payload.new as any;
          if (req.receiver_id === authUser.id) {
            addNotification({ type: 'request_received', title: '🤝 New Request', message: 'Someone wants to connect with you!', action_url: '/chats' });
          }
        }
        if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
          const req = payload.new as any;
          if (req.sender_id === authUser.id && req.status === 'accepted') {
            addNotification({ type: 'request_accepted', title: '✅ Request Accepted', message: 'Your connection request was accepted! Chat is unlocked.', action_url: '/chats' });
          }
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    const messageSub = supabase
      .channel(`messages-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'messages' }, async (payload) => {
        const msg = payload.new as Message;
        if (!msg || (!msg.sender_id && !msg.receiver_id)) return;
        if (msg.sender_id !== authUser.id && msg.receiver_id !== authUser.id) return;
        setMessages(prev => {
          if (prev.some(m => m.id === msg.id)) return prev;
          return [...prev, msg];
        });
        if (msg.receiver_id === authUser.id && msg.sender_id !== authUser.id) {
          const isInChat = activeChatIdRef.current === msg.sender_id;
          if (msg.text.startsWith('⏰DELAY:')) {
            if (!isInChat) {
              addNotification({ type: 'delay_request', title: '⏱️ Extra Time Requested', message: 'Someone needs more time for your meetup.', action_url: `/chat/${msg.sender_id}` });
            }
          } else if (!isInChat) {
            // Show visible banner popup
            const { data: sender } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('name, avatar').eq('id', msg.sender_id).single();
            window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show-message-banner', {
              detail: {
                id: msg.id,
                senderId: msg.sender_id,
                senderName: sender?.name || 'Someone',
                senderAvatar: sender?.avatar || '',
                preview: msg.text.slice(0, 80),
                timestamp: Date.now(),
              }
            }));
          }
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    const inviteSub = supabase
      .channel(`invites-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'invites' }, async (payload) => {
        const inv = payload.new as any;
        if (!inv || (!inv.sender_id && !inv.receiver_id)) return;
        if (inv.sender_id !== authUser.id && inv.receiver_id !== authUser.id) return;
        console.log('[Invite Realtime]', payload.eventType, inv.id, inv.status);
        if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
          setInvites(prev => {
            if (prev.some(i => i.id === inv.id)) return prev;
            return [...prev, inv as Invite];
          });
          // Notification is now created by DB trigger — no client-side addNotification needed
        }
        if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
          setInvites(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === inv.id ? { ...i, ...inv } : i));
          // Show banner to sender when their invite is accepted/declined/delayed
          if (inv.sender_id === authUser.id) {
            const statusLabels: Record<string, { title: string; msg: string }> = {
              accepted: { title: '✅ Invite Accepted!', msg: 'Your invite was accepted — check the chat!' },
              declined: { title: '❌ Invite Declined', msg: 'Your invite was declined.' },
              delayed: { title: '⏳ Delayed', msg: 'They need more time — check back later.' },
            };
            const info = statusLabels[inv.status];
            if (info) {
              const isInChat = activeChatIdRef.current === inv.receiver_id;
              if (!isInChat) {
                const { data: other } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('name, avatar').eq('id', inv.receiver_id).single();
                window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('show-message-banner', {
                  detail: {
                    id: `inv-${inv.id}-${inv.status}`,
                    senderId: inv.receiver_id,
                    senderName: other?.name || 'Someone',
                    senderAvatar: other?.avatar || '',
                    preview: info.msg,
                    timestamp: Date.now(),
                  }
                }));
              }
            }
          }
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    const giftSub = supabase
      .channel(`gifts-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'gifts' }, (payload) => {
        const gift = payload.new as any;
        if (gift.to_user === authUser.id) {
          addNotification({ type: 'gift_received', title: '🎁 Gift Received!', message: `You received a gift worth ${gift.token_amount} tokens!`, action_url: '/wallet' });
          fetchWallet(authUser.id);
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    const sessionSub = supabase
      .channel(`sessions-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'sessions' }, (payload) => {
        const sess = payload.new as any;
        const isMySession = sess.user_a === authUser.id || sess.user_b === authUser.id;
        if (!isMySession) return;
        if (sess.status === 'active') {
          addNotification({ type: 'session_started', title: '🟢 Session Active!', message: 'Both arrived — session has started!', action_url: `/session/${sess.id}` });
        }
        if (sess.status === 'ended') {
          addNotification({ type: 'session_completed', title: '⭐ Session Completed', message: 'Your meetup has ended. Rate your experience!', action_url: `/session/${sess.id}` });
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    const proposalSub = supabase
      .channel(`proposals-notif-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'meeting_proposals' }, (payload) => {
        const prop = payload.new as any;
        if (prop.receiver_id === authUser.id && prop.status === 'pending') {
          addNotification({ type: 'invite_changed', title: '🔄 Counter Proposal', message: `New proposal for ${prop.activity_type}: ${prop.place_name || 'updated details'}`, action_url: `/chat/${prop.sender_id}` });
        }
      })
      .subscribe();

    // Realtime notifications subscription - picks up DB-trigger-created notifications
    const notifSub = supabase
      .channel(`notifications-rt-${authUser.id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'notifications', filter: `user_id=eq.${authUser.id}` }, (payload) => {
        const notif = payload.new as AppNotification;
        setNotifications(prev => {
          if (prev.some(n => n.id === notif.id)) return prev;
          return [notif, ...prev].slice(0, 50);
        });
        toast(notif.title, { description: notif.message });
        try { const audio = new Audio('/notification.mp3'); audio.volume = 0.3; audio.play().catch(() => {}); } catch {}
      })
      .subscribe();

    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(contactSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(messageSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(inviteSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(giftSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(sessionSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(proposalSub);
      supabase.removeChannel(notifSub);
    };
  }, [authUser, addNotification]);

  const fetchProfile = async (userId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', userId).single();
    if (data) {
      setCurrentUser({
        ...data,
        avatar: data.avatar || '',
        bio: data.bio || '',
        city: data.city || '',
        interests: data.interests || [],
        trust_score: data.trust_score || 50,
        sessions_completed: data.sessions_completed || 0,
        early_leaves: data.early_leaves || 0,
        no_shows: data.no_shows || 0,
        avg_rating: Number(data.avg_rating) || 0,
        is_online: data.is_online || false,
        bluetooth_ready: data.bluetooth_ready || false,
        last_active_at: data.last_active_at || new Date().toISOString(),
        is_available: (data as any).is_available || false,
        activity_type: (data as any).activity_type || null,
        available_until: (data as any).available_until || null,
        interested_in: (data as any).interested_in || 'everyone',
        gender: (data as any).gender || null,
      });
      await supabase.from('profiles').update({ is_online: true, last_active_at: new Date().toISOString() }).eq('id', userId);
    }
  };

  const fetchWallet = async (userId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('wallets').select('*').eq('user_id', userId).single();
    if (data) {
      setWallet({
        user_id: data.user_id,
        token_balance: data.token_balance || 100,
        total_spent: data.total_spent || 0,
        total_received: data.total_received || 0,
        updated_at: data.updated_at || new Date().toISOString(),
      });
    }
  };

  const refreshWallet = useCallback(async () => {
    if (authUser) await fetchWallet(authUser.id);
  }, [authUser]);

  const fetchContacts = async () => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('contact_requests').select('*').order('created_at', { ascending: false });
    if (data) setContacts(data);
  };

  const refreshContacts = fetchContacts;

  const fetchBlocks = async (userId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('blocks').select('blocked_id').eq('blocker_id', userId);
    if (data) setBlockedIds(data.map((b: any) => b.blocked_id));
  };

  const blockUser = async (userId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('blocks').insert({ blocker_id: authUser.id, blocked_id: userId } as any);
    setBlockedIds(prev => [...prev, userId]);
    // Remove from nearby
    setNearbyUsers(prev => prev.filter(u => u.id !== userId));
    toast('User blocked');
  };

  const reportUser = async (userId: string, reason: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('reports').insert({ reporter_id: authUser.id, reported_id: userId, reason } as any);
    toast('Report submitted');
  };

  const isCompatible = useCallback((otherUser: { gender?: string | null; interested_in?: string }) => {
    if (!currentUser) return true;
    const myGender = currentUser.gender;
    const myInterest = currentUser.interested_in || 'everyone';
    const theirGender = otherUser.gender;
    const theirInterest = otherUser.interested_in || 'everyone';

    // If either hasn't set gender, show them (be permissive)
    if (!myGender || !theirGender) return true;

    const genderMap: Record<string, string> = { male: 'men', female: 'women' };
    const myGenderLabel = genderMap[myGender] || myGender;
    const theirGenderLabel = genderMap[theirGender] || theirGender;

    const iLikeThem = myInterest === 'everyone' || myInterest === theirGenderLabel;
    const theyLikeMe = theirInterest === 'everyone' || theirInterest === myGenderLabel;

    return iLikeThem && theyLikeMe;
  }, [currentUser?.gender, currentUser?.interested_in]);

  const fetchNearbyUsers = useCallback(async (radius: number) => {
    try {
      if (!currentUser?.latitude || !currentUser?.longitude) {
        const { data, error } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').neq('id', authUser?.id || '').limit(50);
        if (error) { console.error('Nearby fetch error:', error); setNearbyUsers([]); return; }
        if (data) {
          setNearbyUsers(data.map(p => ({
            ...p, avatar: p.avatar || '', bio: p.bio || '', city: p.city || '',
            interests: p.interests || [], trust_score: p.trust_score || 50,
            sessions_completed: p.sessions_completed || 0, early_leaves: p.early_leaves || 0,
            no_shows: p.no_shows || 0, avg_rating: Number(p.avg_rating) || 0,
            is_online: p.is_online || false, bluetooth_ready: p.bluetooth_ready || false,
            last_active_at: p.last_active_at || new Date().toISOString(),
            gender: (p as any).gender || null,
            interested_in: (p as any).interested_in || 'everyone',
          })));
        } else {
          setNearbyUsers([]);
        }
        return;
      }
      const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc('get_nearby_users', {
        user_lat: currentUser.latitude, user_lng: currentUser.longitude,
        radius_meters: radius, max_results: 50,
      });
      if (error) { console.error('Nearby RPC error:', error); setNearbyUsers([]); return; }
      if (data) {
        setNearbyUsers(data.map((p: any) => ({
          ...p, avatar: p.avatar || '', bio: p.bio || '', city: p.city || '',
          interests: p.interests || [], trust_score: p.trust_score || 50,
          sessions_completed: p.sessions_completed || 0, early_leaves: p.early_leaves || 0,
          no_shows: p.no_shows || 0, avg_rating: Number(p.avg_rating) || 0,
          is_online: p.is_online || false, bluetooth_ready: p.bluetooth_ready || false,
          last_active_at: p.last_active_at || new Date().toISOString(),
          distance_meters: Math.round(p.distance_meters || 0),
          gender: p.gender || null,
          interested_in: p.interested_in || 'everyone',
        })));
      } else {
        setNearbyUsers([]);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('Nearby fetch exception:', err);
      setNearbyUsers([]);
    }
  }, [currentUser?.latitude, currentUser?.longitude, authUser?.id]);

  // Debounced location update — prevents spamming DB
  const lastLocationUpdate = useRef<number>(0);
  const pendingLocationUpdate = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  const updateLocation = useCallback(async (lat: number, lng: number) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    // Update local state immediately for responsiveness
    if (currentUser) setCurrentUser(prev => prev ? { ...prev, latitude: lat, longitude: lng } : prev);

    const now = Date.now();
    const timeSince = now - lastLocationUpdate.current;

    if (pendingLocationUpdate.current) clearTimeout(pendingLocationUpdate.current);

    if (timeSince >= 5000) {
      lastLocationUpdate.current = now;
      await supabase.from('profiles').update({ latitude: lat, longitude: lng }).eq('id', authUser.id);
    } else {
      pendingLocationUpdate.current = setTimeout(async () => {
        lastLocationUpdate.current = Date.now();
        await supabase.from('profiles').update({ latitude: lat, longitude: lng }).eq('id', authUser.id);
      }, 5000 - timeSince);
    }
  }, [authUser, currentUser]);

  const login = async (email: string, password: string) => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password });
    if (error) return { error: error.message };
    return {};
  };

  const register = async (name: string, email: string, password: string) => {
    const { error } = await supabase.auth.signUp({ email, password, options: { data: { name } } });
    if (error) return { error: error.message };
    return {};
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    if (authUser) await supabase.from('profiles').update({ is_online: false }).eq('id', authUser.id);
    await supabase.auth.signOut();
  };

  const sendRequest = async (userId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    // Check existing request
    const existing = contacts.find(r =>
      (r.sender_id === authUser.id && r.receiver_id === userId) ||
      (r.sender_id === userId && r.receiver_id === authUser.id)
    );
    if (existing) {
      if (existing.status === 'pending') { toast('Request already pending'); return; }
      if (existing.status === 'accepted') { toast('Already connected'); return; }
      if (existing.status === 'declined' || existing.status === 'blocked') {
        const declinedAt = new Date(existing.created_at || '');
        const hoursSince = (Date.now() - declinedAt.getTime()) / 3600000;
        if (hoursSince < 24) { toast('Please wait before sending another request'); return; }
      }
    }
    // Check blocked
    if (blockedIds.includes(userId)) { toast('Cannot send request'); return; }
    // Daily limit: max 15 outgoing requests per day
    const todayStart = new Date(); todayStart.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
    const todayRequests = contacts.filter(r => r.sender_id === authUser.id && r.created_at && new Date(r.created_at) >= todayStart);
    if (todayRequests.length >= 15) { toast('Daily request limit reached (15/day)'); return; }
    // Cooldown: if 3+ declines today, add cooldown
    const todayDeclines = contacts.filter(r => r.sender_id === authUser.id && r.status === 'declined' && r.created_at && new Date(r.created_at) >= todayStart);
    if (todayDeclines.length >= 3) { toast('Too many declined requests today. Try again tomorrow.'); return; }

    await supabase.from('contact_requests').insert({ sender_id: authUser.id, receiver_id: userId });
    await fetchContacts();
  };

  const acceptRequest = async (requestId: string) => {
    await supabase.from('contact_requests').update({ status: 'accepted' }).eq('id', requestId);
    await fetchContacts();
  };

  const declineRequest = async (requestId: string) => {
    await supabase.from('contact_requests').update({ status: 'declined' }).eq('id', requestId);
    await fetchContacts();
  };

  const cancelRequest = async (requestId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('contact_requests').update({ status: 'cancelled' }).eq('id', requestId);
    await fetchContacts();
    toast('Request cancelled');
  };

  const sendMessage = async (receiverId: string, text: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('messages').insert({ sender_id: authUser.id, receiver_id: receiverId, text });
  };

  const fetchMessages = useCallback(async (userId: string, limit = 50, offset = 0) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const { data } = await supabase.from('messages').select('*')
      .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${userId}),and(sender_id.eq.${userId},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id})`)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
      .range(offset, offset + limit - 1);
    if (data) {
      const sorted = data.reverse();
      if (offset === 0) {
        setMessages(sorted);
      } else {
        setMessages(prev => [...sorted, ...prev]);
      }
    }
  }, [authUser]);

  const markMessagesAsRead = useCallback(async (otherUserId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const unreadIds = messages
      .filter(m => m.sender_id === otherUserId && m.receiver_id === authUser.id && !m.seen_at)
      .map(m => m.id);
    if (unreadIds.length === 0) return;
    setMessages(prev => prev.map(m =>
      unreadIds.includes(m.id) ? { ...m, seen_at: now } : m
    ));
    await supabase.from('messages').update({ seen_at: now } as any).in('id', unreadIds);
  }, [authUser, messages]);

  const getUnreadCount = useCallback((otherUserId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return 0;
    return messages.filter(m => m.sender_id === otherUserId && m.receiver_id === authUser.id && !m.seen_at).length;
  }, [authUser, messages]);

  const isConnected = (_userId: string) => {
    // Direct interaction model — everyone can chat
    return true;
  };

  const getRequestStatus = (userId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return undefined;
    return contacts.find(r =>
      (r.sender_id === authUser.id && r.receiver_id === userId) ||
      (r.sender_id === userId && r.receiver_id === authUser.id)
    );
  };

  const updateProfile = async (updates: Partial<Profile>) => {
    if (!authUser) return { error: 'Not authenticated' };
    const { error } = await supabase.from('profiles').update(updates as any).eq('id', authUser.id);
    if (error) return { error: error.message };
    if (currentUser) setCurrentUser({ ...currentUser, ...updates });
    return {};
  };

  const goLive = async (): Promise<'success' | 'denied' | 'blocked' | 'error'> => {
    if (!authUser) return 'error';

    if (!navigator.geolocation) {
      return 'error';
    }

    // Check if permission is already permanently blocked
    if (navigator.permissions) {
      try {
        const permStatus = await navigator.permissions.query({ name: 'geolocation' });
        if (permStatus.state === 'denied') {
          return 'blocked';
        }
      } catch {
        // permissions API not supported, continue with request
      }
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
        async (pos) => {
          const { latitude, longitude } = pos.coords;
          const availableUntil = new Date(Date.now() + 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString();
          await supabase.from('profiles').update({
            is_available: true,
            activity_type: 'available',
            available_until: availableUntil,
            latitude,
            longitude,
          } as any).eq('id', authUser.id);
          if (currentUser) {
            setCurrentUser({ ...currentUser, is_available: true, activity_type: 'available', available_until: availableUntil, latitude, longitude });
          }
          resolve('success');
        },
        (err) => {
          if (err.code === 1) {
            resolve('denied');
          } else {
            resolve('error');
          }
        },
        { timeout: 15000, enableHighAccuracy: true, maximumAge: 0 }
      );
    });
  };

  const goOffline = async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('profiles').update({
      is_available: false,
      activity_type: null,
      available_until: null,
    } as any).eq('id', authUser.id);
    if (currentUser) {
      setCurrentUser({ ...currentUser, is_available: false, activity_type: null, available_until: null });
    }
  };

  const fetchInvites = useCallback(async (userId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('invites').select('*')
      .or(`sender_id.eq.${userId},receiver_id.eq.${userId}`)
      .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
    if (data) setInvites(data as Invite[]);
  }, []);

  // Auto-expire pending invites & proposals every 30s
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const EXPIRY_MS = 15 * 60 * 1000;

    const expireCheck = async () => {
      const now = Date.now();

      // Expire local invites
      const expiredInvites = invites.filter(
        i => i.status === 'pending' && i.created_at && (now - new Date(i.created_at).getTime() > EXPIRY_MS)
      );
      if (expiredInvites.length > 0) {
        for (const inv of expiredInvites) {
          await supabase.from('invites').update({ status: 'expired' } as any).eq('id', inv.id).eq('status', 'pending');
        }
        setInvites(prev => prev.map(i => expiredInvites.some(e => e.id === i.id) ? { ...i, status: 'expired' } : i));
      }

      // Expire proposals
      const { data: pendingProposals } = await supabase.from('meeting_proposals')
        .select('id, created_at')
        .or(`sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id}`)
        .eq('status', 'pending');
      if (pendingProposals) {
        const expiredProps = pendingProposals.filter(
          p => p.created_at && (now - new Date(p.created_at).getTime() > EXPIRY_MS)
        );
        for (const p of expiredProps) {
          await supabase.from('meeting_proposals').update({ status: 'expired' } as any).eq('id', p.id).eq('status', 'pending');
        }
      }
    };

    expireCheck();
    const iv = setInterval(expireCheck, 30000);
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [authUser, invites]);

  // Meeting reminder system — only for confirmed meetings
  const sentReminders = useRef<Set<string>>(new Set());
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;

    const checkReminders = async () => {
      // Fetch confirmed proposals with a future meeting time
      const { data: confirmed } = await supabase.from('meeting_proposals')
        .select('*')
        .or(`sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id}`)
        .eq('status', 'accepted')
        .not('proposed_time', 'is', null);

      if (!confirmed || confirmed.length === 0) return;

      const now = Date.now();
      const REMINDER_THRESHOLDS = [
        { key: '30m', ms: 30 * 60 * 1000, label: '30 min' },
        { key: '15m', ms: 15 * 60 * 1000, label: '15 min' },
        { key: '5m', ms: 5 * 60 * 1000, label: '5 min' },
      ];

      for (const meeting of confirmed) {
        const meetingTime = new Date(meeting.proposed_time!).getTime();
        const timeUntil = meetingTime - now;
        if (timeUntil < 0 || timeUntil > 60 * 60 * 1000) continue; // only within 1 hour

        const otherId = meeting.sender_id === authUser.id ? meeting.receiver_id : meeting.sender_id;
        const activityLabel = meeting.activity_type === 'coffee' ? '☕ Coffee' : meeting.activity_type === 'walk' ? '🚶 Walk' : meeting.activity_type === 'drink' ? '🍸 Drink' : '✨ Meeting';

        for (const threshold of REMINDER_THRESHOLDS) {
          const reminderId = `${meeting.id}-${threshold.key}`;
          if (sentReminders.current.has(reminderId)) continue;
          // Fire if we're within the threshold window (±30s tolerance)
          if (timeUntil <= threshold.ms && timeUntil > threshold.ms - 30000) {
            sentReminders.current.add(reminderId);
            addNotification({
              type: 'meeting_reminder',
              title: `⏰ ${activityLabel} in ${threshold.label}`,
              message: meeting.place_name ? `Head to ${meeting.place_name}` : 'Get ready!',
              action_url: `/chat/${otherId}`,
            });
          }
        }

        // "Time to go" reminder at 1 min
        const goId = `${meeting.id}-go`;
        if (!sentReminders.current.has(goId) && timeUntil <= 60000 && timeUntil > 0) {
          sentReminders.current.add(goId);
          addNotification({
            type: 'meeting_reminder',
            title: `🚀 Time to go!`,
            message: `${activityLabel} is starting now${meeting.place_name ? ` at ${meeting.place_name}` : ''}`,
            action_url: `/chat/${otherId}`,
          });
        }
      }
    };

    checkReminders();
    const iv = setInterval(checkReminders, 15000); // check every 15s
    return () => clearInterval(iv);
  }, [authUser, addNotification]);


  const acceptInvite = async (inviteId: string) => {
    const invite = invites.find(i => i.id === inviteId);
    if (!invite) return;

    // Block accepting expired invites
    if (invite.status === 'expired' || (invite.status === 'pending' && invite.created_at && 
        (Date.now() - new Date(invite.created_at).getTime() > 15 * 60 * 1000))) {
      toast.error('This invite has expired');
      setInvites(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === inviteId ? { ...i, status: 'expired' } : i));
      return;
    }

    console.log('[Invite] Accepting invite:', inviteId);
    await supabase.from('invites').update({ status: 'accepted' }).eq('id', inviteId);
    setInvites(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === inviteId ? { ...i, status: 'accepted' } : i));

    // Auto-set user online when accepting an invite
    if (authUser) {
      await supabase.from('profiles').update({
        is_online: true,
        is_available: true,
        last_active_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      } as any).eq('id', authUser.id);
      if (currentUser) {
        setCurrentUser({ ...currentUser, is_online: true, is_available: true });
      }
    }

    // Auto-create a session for this invite
    if (invite && authUser) {
      const { data: existingSession } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('id').eq('invite_id', inviteId).maybeSingle();
      if (!existingSession) {
        const { data: newSession } = await supabase.from('sessions').insert({
          invite_id: inviteId,
          user_a: invite.sender_id,
          user_b: invite.receiver_id,
          duration_seconds: invite.duration_minutes * 60,
          payout_tokens: invite.token_cost,
          status: 'pending',
          meetup_status: 'choosing_place',
        } as any).select().single();
        console.log('[Session] Auto-created session:', newSession);
      }
    }
  };

  const declineInvite = async (inviteId: string) => {
    console.log('[Invite] Declining invite:', inviteId);
    await supabase.from('invites').update({ status: 'declined' }).eq('id', inviteId);
    setInvites(prev => prev.map(i => i.id === inviteId ? { ...i, status: 'declined' } : i));
  };

  const sendJoinRequest = async (activityId: string): Promise<string | null> => {
    if (!authUser) {
      toast.error('Not authenticated — please sign in first');
      return null;
    }

    // Find the activity
    const activity = postedActivities.find(a => a.id === activityId);
    if (!activity) {
      toast.error('Activity not found');
      return null;
    }

    if (activity.user_id === authUser.id) {
      toast.error('Cannot join your own activity');
      return null;
    }

    // Check for existing pending request
    const existing = activityParticipants[activityId]?.find(
      p => p.user_id === authUser.id && (p.status === 'pending' || p.status === 'confirmed')
    );
    if (existing) {
      toast(existing.status === 'pending' ? 'Request already pending' : 'Already confirmed');
      return existing.id;
    }

    // Check capacity for group activities
    if (activity.isGroup && activity.maxPeople) {
      const confirmedCount = activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(p => p.status === 'confirmed')?.length || 0;
      if (confirmedCount >= activity.maxPeople) {
        toast.error('Activity is full');
        return null;
      }
    }

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').insert({
        activity_id: activityId,
        user_id: authUser.id,
        status: 'pending',
      } as any).select().single();

      if (error) {
        console.error('Join request DB error:', error);
        if (error.code === '23505') {
          toast.error('Join request already exists');
        } else if (error.code === '42501') {
          toast.error('Permission denied — RLS policy blocked the insert');
        } else {
          toast.error(`Join request failed: ${error.message}`);
        }
        return null;
      }

      if (data) {
        setActivityParticipants(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [activityId]: [...(prev[activityId] || []), data as ActivityParticipant],
        }));
        return data.id;
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(`Join request error: ${e?.message || 'Unknown error'}`);
    }
    return null;
  };

  const acceptJoinRequest = useCallback(async (participantId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    
    // Find the participant record
    let participant: ActivityParticipant | undefined;
    let activityId = '';
    for (const [aId, parts] of Object.entries(activityParticipants)) {
      const found = parts.find(p => p.id === participantId);
      if (found) { participant = found; activityId = aId; break; }
    }
    if (!participant) { toast.error('Request not found'); return; }

    const activity = postedActivities.find(a => a.id === activityId);
    if (!activity) { toast.error('Activity not found'); return; }

    // For 1-to-1: check if someone is already confirmed
    if (!activity.isGroup) {
      const alreadyConfirmed = activityParticipants[activityId]?.some(p => p.status === 'confirmed');
      if (alreadyConfirmed) {
        toast.error('Already accepted someone for this 1-to-1 activity');
        return;
      }
    }

    // For group: check capacity
    if (activity.isGroup && activity.maxPeople) {
      const confirmedCount = activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(p => p.status === 'confirmed')?.length || 0;
      if (confirmedCount >= activity.maxPeople) {
        toast.error('Activity is full');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Update status to confirmed
    const { error } = await supabase.from('activity_participants')
      .update({ status: 'confirmed' } as any)
      .eq('id', participantId);
    if (error) { toast.error(`Accept failed: ${error.message}`); return; }

    // Lock deposit if activity has one
    const depositVal = activity.deposit === '10' ? 10 : activity.deposit === '20' ? 20 : 0;
    if (depositVal > 0) {
      // Check joiner's wallet and lock tokens
      const { data: joinerWallet } = await supabase.from('wallets')
        .select('token_balance, total_spent')
        .eq('user_id', participant.user_id)
        .single();

      if (joinerWallet && (joinerWallet.token_balance ?? 0) >= depositVal) {
        await supabase.from('wallets').update({
          token_balance: (joinerWallet.token_balance ?? 0) - depositVal,
          total_spent: (joinerWallet.total_spent ?? 0) + depositVal,
        } as any).eq('user_id', participant.user_id);

        await supabase.from('transactions').insert({
          user_id: participant.user_id,
          type: 'deposit_lock',
          amount: -depositVal,
          description: `Attendance deposit locked for ${activity.activityType}`,
        } as any);
      }
    }

    // For 1-to-1: decline all other pending requests
    if (!activity.isGroup) {
      const otherPending = activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(
        p => p.id !== participantId && p.status === 'pending'
      ) || [];
      for (const other of otherPending) {
        await supabase.from('activity_participants')
          .update({ status: 'declined' } as any)
          .eq('id', other.id);
      }
    }

    // Create notification for the accepted user
    const ownerProfile = currentUser;
    await supabase.from('notifications').insert({
      user_id: participant.user_id,
      type: 'join_accepted',
      title: '✅ Request Accepted',
      message: `${ownerProfile?.name || 'Someone'} accepted your join request for ${activity.activityType}`,
      avatar_url: ownerProfile?.avatar || '',
      action_url: `/activity-detail/${activityId}`,
    } as any);

    // Auto-create session linking owner and participant
    const { data: existingSession } = await supabase.from('sessions')
      .select('id')
      .or(`and(user_a.eq.${authUser.id},user_b.eq.${participant.user_id}),and(user_a.eq.${participant.user_id},user_b.eq.${authUser.id})`)
      .in('status', ['pending', 'awaiting_arrival', 'active'])
      .maybeSingle();

    if (!existingSession) {
      const durationSec = parseInt(activity.duration) * 60 || 3600;
      await supabase.from('sessions').insert({
        user_a: authUser.id,
        user_b: participant.user_id,
        status: 'pending',
        meetup_status: 'planning',
        duration_seconds: durationSec,
        payout_tokens: depositVal || 10,
        meetup_place_name: activity.meetingPoint || null,
        meetup_lat: activity.latitude || null,
        meetup_lng: activity.longitude || null,
      } as any);
    }

    // Refresh participants inline
    const { data: refreshed } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', activityId);
    if (refreshed) setActivityParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [activityId]: refreshed as any }));
    toast.success('Request accepted!');
  }, [authUser, activityParticipants, postedActivities, currentUser]);

  const declineJoinRequest = useCallback(async (participantId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    
    let participant: ActivityParticipant | undefined;
    let activityId = '';
    for (const [aId, parts] of Object.entries(activityParticipants)) {
      const found = parts.find(p => p.id === participantId);
      if (found) { participant = found; activityId = aId; break; }
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('activity_participants')
      .update({ status: 'declined' } as any)
      .eq('id', participantId);
    if (error) { toast.error(`Decline failed: ${error.message}`); return; }

    // Notify the declined user
    if (participant) {
      const activity = postedActivities.find(a => a.id === activityId);
      await supabase.from('notifications').insert({
        user_id: participant.user_id,
        type: 'join_declined',
        title: '❌ Request Declined',
        message: `${currentUser?.name || 'Someone'} declined your join request${activity ? ` for ${activity.activityType}` : ''}`,
        avatar_url: currentUser?.avatar || '',
        action_url: '/chats',
      } as any);
    }

    if (activityId) {
      const { data: refreshed } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', activityId);
      if (refreshed) setActivityParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [activityId]: refreshed as any }));
    }
    toast('Request declined');
  }, [authUser, activityParticipants, postedActivities, currentUser]);

  const ignoreJoinRequest = useCallback(async (participantId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;

    let activityId = '';
    for (const [aId, parts] of Object.entries(activityParticipants)) {
      if (parts.find(p => p.id === participantId)) { activityId = aId; break; }
    }

    const { error } = await supabase.from('activity_participants')
      .update({ status: 'ignored' } as any)
      .eq('id', participantId);
    if (error) { toast.error(`Ignore failed: ${error.message}`); return; }

    if (activityId) {
      const { data: refreshed } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', activityId);
      if (refreshed) setActivityParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [activityId]: refreshed as any }));
    }
    toast('Request ignored');
  }, [authUser, activityParticipants]);

  const cancelActivity = useCallback(async (activityId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;

    const activity = postedActivities.find(a => a.id === activityId);
    if (!activity) { toast.error('Activity not found'); return; }
    if (activity.user_id !== authUser.id) { toast.error('Only the owner can cancel'); return; }

    const depositVal = activity.deposit === '10' ? 10 : activity.deposit === '20' ? 20 : 0;

    // Refund all confirmed participants if deposit exists
    if (depositVal > 0) {
      const confirmedParts = activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(p => p.status === 'confirmed') || [];
      for (const p of confirmedParts) {
        // Refund wallet
        const { data: pWallet } = await supabase.from('wallets')
          .select('token_balance, total_spent')
          .eq('user_id', p.user_id)
          .single();

        if (pWallet) {
          await supabase.from('wallets').update({
            token_balance: (pWallet.token_balance ?? 0) + depositVal,
            total_spent: Math.max(0, (pWallet.total_spent ?? 0) - depositVal),
          } as any).eq('user_id', p.user_id);

          await supabase.from('transactions').insert({
            user_id: p.user_id,
            type: 'deposit_refund',
            amount: depositVal,
            description: `Deposit refund — activity cancelled by owner (${activity.activityType})`,
          } as any);
        }

        // Notify participant
        await supabase.from('notifications').insert({
          user_id: p.user_id,
          type: 'activity_cancelled',
          title: '🔄 Activity Cancelled — Deposit Refunded',
          message: `${currentUser?.name || 'The owner'} cancelled their ${activity.activityType} activity. Your ${depositVal} token deposit has been returned.`,
          avatar_url: currentUser?.avatar || '',
          action_url: '/nearby',
        } as any);
      }
    }

    // Also notify non-deposit confirmed/pending participants
    const allParts = activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(p => p.status === 'pending' || (depositVal === 0 && p.status === 'confirmed')) || [];
    for (const p of allParts) {
      await supabase.from('notifications').insert({
        user_id: p.user_id,
        type: 'activity_cancelled',
        title: '❌ Activity Cancelled',
        message: `${currentUser?.name || 'The owner'} cancelled their ${activity.activityType} activity.`,
        avatar_url: currentUser?.avatar || '',
        action_url: '/nearby',
      } as any);
    }

    // Mark all participants as cancelled
    const { error: partErr } = await supabase.from('activity_participants')
      .update({ status: 'cancelled' } as any)
      .eq('activity_id', activityId);
    if (partErr) console.error('Failed to cancel participants:', partErr);

    // Mark activity as cancelled
    const { error } = await supabase.from('activities')
      .update({ status: 'cancelled' } as any)
      .eq('id', activityId);
    if (error) { toast.error(`Cancel failed: ${error.message}`); return; }

    setPostedActivities(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== activityId));
    setActivityParticipants(prev => { const next = { ...prev }; delete next[activityId]; return next; });

    if (depositVal > 0) await refreshWallet();
    toast.success('Activity cancelled. All deposits refunded.');
  }, [authUser, postedActivities, activityParticipants, currentUser, refreshWallet]);

  const postActivity = useCallback(async (activity: Omit<PostedActivity, 'id' | 'user_id' | 'latitude' | 'longitude' | 'createdAt' | 'status'>): Promise<PostedActivity | null> => {
    if (!authUser) return null;
    const lat = currentUser?.latitude || 48.8566;
    const lng = currentUser?.longitude || 2.3522;

    // Calculate start_time from the time option
    let startTime = new Date();
    if (activity.time === '15') startTime = new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60000);
    else if (activity.time === '30') startTime = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60000);
    else if (activity.time === '60') startTime = new Date(Date.now() + 60 * 60000);

    const row = {
      user_id: authUser.id,
      category: activity.category || 'social',
      activity_type: activity.activityType,
      is_group: activity.isGroup,
      max_people: activity.isGroup ? activity.maxPeople : null,
      lat,
      lng,
      location_name: activity.meetingPoint || null,
      start_time: startTime.toISOString(),
      duration: parseInt(activity.duration) || 60,
      description: activity.title || '',
      who_can_join: activity.whoCanJoin,
      payment: activity.payment,
      deposit: activity.deposit,
      pace: activity.pace || null,
      status: 'active',
    };

    try {
      const { data, error } = await supabase.from('activities').insert(row as any).select().single();
      if (error) throw error;
      if (data) {
        const posted: PostedActivity = {
          id: data.id,
          user_id: data.user_id,
          category: data.category,
          activityType: data.activity_type,
          title: data.description || '',
          meetingPoint: data.location_name || '',
          time: activity.time,
          duration: String(data.duration),
          whoCanJoin: data.who_can_join,
          payment: data.payment,
          deposit: data.deposit,
          pace: data.pace || '',
          isGroup: data.is_group,
          maxPeople: data.max_people || 4,
          latitude: data.lat,
          longitude: data.lng,
          createdAt: data.created_at,
          status: data.status,
        };
        setPostedActivities(prev => [posted, ...prev]);
        return posted;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Activity insert failed, using local fallback:', err);
      // Local fallback
      const local: PostedActivity = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        user_id: authUser.id,
        category: activity.category || 'social',
        activityType: activity.activityType,
        title: activity.title,
        meetingPoint: activity.meetingPoint,
        time: activity.time,
        duration: activity.duration,
        whoCanJoin: activity.whoCanJoin,
        payment: activity.payment,
        deposit: activity.deposit,
        pace: activity.pace,
        isGroup: activity.isGroup,
        maxPeople: activity.maxPeople,
        latitude: lat,
        longitude: lng,
        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
        status: 'active',
      };
      setPostedActivities(prev => [local, ...prev]);
      return local;
    }
    return null;
  }, [authUser, currentUser?.latitude, currentUser?.longitude]);

  const fetchActivities = useCallback(async () => {
    const { data, error } = await supabase.from('activities').select('*').eq('status', 'active').order('created_at', { ascending: false }).limit(100);
    if (error) { console.error('Fetch activities error:', error); return; }
    if (data) {
      // Client-side safety: filter out expired activities
      const now = Date.now();
      const active = data.filter((d: any) => {
        const start = new Date(d.start_time).getTime();
        const maxMs = Math.min(d.duration, 180) * 60000;
        return start + maxMs > now;
      });
      setPostedActivities(active.map((d: any) => ({
        id: d.id,
        user_id: d.user_id,
        category: d.category,
        activityType: d.activity_type,
        title: d.description || '',
        meetingPoint: d.location_name || '',
        time: 'now',
        duration: String(d.duration),
        whoCanJoin: d.who_can_join,
        payment: d.payment,
        deposit: d.deposit,
        pace: d.pace || '',
        isGroup: d.is_group,
        maxPeople: d.max_people || 4,
        latitude: d.lat,
        longitude: d.lng,
        createdAt: d.created_at,
        status: d.status,
      })));
    }
  }, []);

  const fetchParticipants = useCallback(async (activityId: string) => {
    const { data } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', activityId);
    if (data) {
      setActivityParticipants(prev => ({ ...prev, [activityId]: data as any }));
    }
  }, []);

  const leaveActivity = useCallback(async (activityId: string) => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('activity_participants').delete().eq('activity_id', activityId).eq('user_id', authUser.id);
    setActivityParticipants(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [activityId]: (prev[activityId] || []).filter(p => p.user_id !== authUser.id),
    }));
  }, [authUser]);

  const getParticipantCount = useCallback((activityId: string) => {
    return activityParticipants[activityId]?.filter(p => p.status === 'confirmed')?.length || 0;
  }, [activityParticipants]);

  const getMyRequestStatus = useCallback((activityId: string): string | null => {
    if (!authUser) return null;
    const myParticipation = activityParticipants[activityId]?.find(p => p.user_id === authUser.id);
    return myParticipation?.status || null;
  }, [authUser, activityParticipants]);

  return (
    <AppContext.Provider value={{
      isAuthenticated, currentUser, authUser, nearbyUsers, contacts, messages, invites,
      wallet, notifications, postedActivities, activityParticipants, loading,
      activeChatId, setActiveChatId,
      login, register, logout, sendRequest, acceptRequest,
      declineRequest, cancelRequest, sendMessage, isConnected, getRequestStatus,
      fetchNearbyUsers, updateLocation, fetchMessages, markMessagesAsRead, refreshContacts,
      refreshWallet, updateProfile, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead, clearNotifications,
      goLive, goOffline, blockUser, reportUser, isCompatible, blockedIds,
      acceptInvite, declineInvite, fetchInvites, sendJoinRequest,
      acceptJoinRequest, declineJoinRequest, ignoreJoinRequest,
      cancelActivity, postActivity, fetchActivities,
      leaveActivity, fetchParticipants, getParticipantCount, getMyRequestStatus, getUnreadCount,
    }}>
      {children}
    </AppContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useApp = () => {
  const ctx = useContext(AppContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useApp must be used within AppProvider');
  return ctx;
};

// Centralised activity type definitions used across Create, Nearby, Map, etc.

export interface ActivityDef {
  id: string;
  emoji: string;
  label: string;
  category: ActivityCategory;
  color: string; // HSL values without hsl() wrapper e.g. "30, 80%, 55%"
  fields?: ('pace' | 'maxPeople' | 'meetingPoint' | 'groupToggle')[];
}

export type ActivityCategory =
  | 'social'
  | 'sport_outdoor'
  | 'culture'
  | 'fun_city'
  | 'nightlife'
  | 'winter'
  | 'practical';

export interface CategoryDef {
  id: ActivityCategory;
  emoji: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
}

export const CATEGORIES: CategoryDef[] = [
  { id: 'social', emoji: '👋', label: 'Social', color: '265, 85%, 60%' },
  { id: 'sport_outdoor', emoji: '🏃', label: 'Sport & Outdoor', color: '155, 70%, 50%' },
  { id: 'culture', emoji: '🎭', label: 'Culture', color: '340, 75%, 55%' },
  { id: 'fun_city', emoji: '🎡', label: 'Fun City', color: '45, 90%, 55%' },
  { id: 'nightlife', emoji: '🌙', label: 'Nightlife', color: '280, 70%, 55%' },
  { id: 'winter', emoji: '❄️', label: 'Winter', color: '200, 80%, 60%' },
  { id: 'practical', emoji: '🤝', label: 'Practical / Help', color: '30, 80%, 55%' },
];

export const ACTIVITY_TYPES: ActivityDef[] = [
  // Social
  { id: 'coffee', emoji: '☕', label: 'Coffee', category: 'social', color: '30, 80%, 55%' },
  { id: 'walk', emoji: '🚶', label: 'Walk', category: 'social', color: '155, 70%, 50%' },
  { id: 'brunch', emoji: '🥞', label: 'Brunch', category: 'social', color: '35, 85%, 55%' },
  { id: 'dinner', emoji: '🍽️', label: 'Dinner', category: 'social', color: '15, 75%, 50%' },

export const getActivityById = (id: string): ActivityDef | undefined =>
  ACTIVITY_TYPES.find(a => a.id === id);

export const getActivitiesByCategory = (cat: ActivityCategory): ActivityDef[] =>
  ACTIVITY_TYPES.filter(a => a.category === cat);

export const activityEmojiMap: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(
  ACTIVITY_TYPES.map(a => [a.id, a.emoji])
);

export const activityLabelMap: Record<string, string> = Object.fromEntries(
  ACTIVITY_TYPES.map(a => [a.id, a.label])
);

FILE: src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx

import * as React from "react";

const MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768;

export function useIsMobile() {
  const [isMobile, setIsMobile] = React.useState<boolean | undefined>(undefined);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const mql = window.matchMedia(`(max-width: ${MOBILE_BREAKPOINT - 1}px)`);
    const onChange = () => {
      setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    };
    mql.addEventListener("change", onChange);
    setIsMobile(window.innerWidth < MOBILE_BREAKPOINT);
    return () => mql.removeEventListener("change", onChange);
  }, []);

  return !!isMobile;
}

FILE: src/hooks/use-toast.ts
========================================
import * as React from "react";

import type { ToastActionElement, ToastProps } from "@/components/ui/toast";

const TOAST_LIMIT = 1;
const TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY = 1000000;

type ToasterToast = ToastProps & {
  id: string;
  title?: React.ReactNode;
  description?: React.ReactNode;
  action?: ToastActionElement;
};

const actionTypes = {
  ADD_TOAST: "ADD_TOAST",
  UPDATE_TOAST: "UPDATE_TOAST",
  DISMISS_TOAST: "DISMISS_TOAST",
  REMOVE_TOAST: "REMOVE_TOAST",
} as const;

let count = 0;

function genId() {
  count = (count + 1) % Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER;
  return count.toString();
}

type ActionType = typeof actionTypes;

type Action =
  | {
      type: ActionType["ADD_TOAST"];
      toast: ToasterToast;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["UPDATE_TOAST"];
      toast: Partial<ToasterToast>;
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["DISMISS_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    }
  | {
      type: ActionType["REMOVE_TOAST"];
      toastId?: ToasterToast["id"];
    };

interface State {
  toasts: ToasterToast[];
}

const toastTimeouts = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();

const addToRemoveQueue = (toastId: string) => {
  if (toastTimeouts.has(toastId)) {
    return;
  }

  const timeout = setTimeout(() => {
    toastTimeouts.delete(toastId);
    dispatch({
      type: "REMOVE_TOAST",
      toastId: toastId,
    });
  }, TOAST_REMOVE_DELAY);

  toastTimeouts.set(toastId, timeout);
};

export const reducer = (state: State, action: Action): State => {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "ADD_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: [action.toast, ...state.toasts].slice(0, TOAST_LIMIT),
      };

    case "UPDATE_TOAST":
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) => (t.id === action.toast.id ? { ...t, ...action.toast } : t)),
      };

    case "DISMISS_TOAST": {
      const { toastId } = action;

      // ! Side effects ! - This could be extracted into a dismissToast() action,
      // but I'll keep it here for simplicity
      if (toastId) {
        addToRemoveQueue(toastId);
      } else {
        state.toasts.forEach((toast) => {
          addToRemoveQueue(toast.id);
        });
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.map((t) =>
          t.id === toastId || toastId === undefined
            ? {
                ...t,
                open: false,
              }
            : t,
        ),
      };
    }
    case "REMOVE_TOAST":
      if (action.toastId === undefined) {
        return {
          ...state,
          toasts: [],
        };
      }
      return {
        ...state,
        toasts: state.toasts.filter((t) => t.id !== action.toastId),
      };
  }
};

const listeners: Array<(state: State) => void> = [];

let memoryState: State = { toasts: [] };

function dispatch(action: Action) {
  memoryState = reducer(memoryState, action);
  listeners.forEach((listener) => {
    listener(memoryState);
  });
}

type Toast = Omit<ToasterToast, "id">;

function toast({ ...props }: Toast) {
  const id = genId();

  const update = (props: ToasterToast) =>
    dispatch({
      type: "UPDATE_TOAST",
      toast: { ...props, id },
    });
  const dismiss = () => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId: id });

  dispatch({
    type: "ADD_TOAST",
    toast: {
      ...props,
      id,
      open: true,
      onOpenChange: (open) => {
        if (!open) dismiss();
      },
    },
  });

  return {
    id: id,
    dismiss,
    update,
  };
}

function useToast() {
  const [state, setState] = React.useState<State>(memoryState);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    listeners.push(setState);
    return () => {
      const index = listeners.indexOf(setState);
      if (index > -1) {
        listeners.splice(index, 1);
      }
    };
  }, [state]);

  return {
    ...state,
    toast,
    dismiss: (toastId?: string) => dispatch({ type: "DISMISS_TOAST", toastId }),
  };
}

export { useToast, toast };

FILE: src/hooks/usePushNotifications.ts
========================================
import { useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

const VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY = 'BC3etIuMb9ZsK8W4k3lczMTrBOKGp9PLwdsml5YOp2g_9km4I8NUHN6X7M6-WizyQvmcVdbIbmOTmMfBUZt9k6I';

function urlBase64ToUint8Array(base64String: string): Uint8Array {
  const padding = '='.repeat((4 - (base64String.length % 4)) % 4);
  const base64 = (base64String + padding).replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/');
  const rawData = window.atob(base64);
  const outputArray = new Uint8Array(rawData.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < rawData.length; ++i) {
    outputArray[i] = rawData.charCodeAt(i);
  }
  return outputArray;
}

export function usePushNotifications(userId: string | undefined) {
  const subscribe = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!userId) return;
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator) || !('PushManager' in window)) {
      console.log('[Push] Not supported in this browser');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Register service worker
      const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js', { scope: '/' });
      await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;

      // Request permission
      const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
      if (permission !== 'granted') {
        console.log('[Push] Permission denied');
        return;
      }

      // Check for existing subscription
      let subscription = await registration.pushManager.getSubscription();

      if (!subscription) {
        const appServerKey = urlBase64ToUint8Array(VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY);
        subscription = await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
          userVisibleOnly: true,
          applicationServerKey: appServerKey.buffer as ArrayBuffer,
        });
      }

      const subJson = subscription.toJSON();
      if (!subJson.endpoint || !subJson.keys?.p256dh || !subJson.keys?.auth) {
        console.error('[Push] Invalid subscription');
        return;
      }

      // Store in database (upsert by endpoint)
      const { error } = await supabase
        .from('push_subscriptions')
        .upsert(
          {
            user_id: userId,
            endpoint: subJson.endpoint,
            p256dh: subJson.keys.p256dh,
            auth: subJson.keys.auth,
          } as any,
          { onConflict: 'user_id,endpoint' }
        );

      if (error) {
        console.error('[Push] Failed to store subscription:', error);
      } else {
        console.log('[Push] Subscription stored successfully');
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error('[Push] Subscription error:', err);
    }
  }, [userId]);

  // Listen for SW navigation messages
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!('serviceWorker' in navigator)) return;

    const handler = (event: MessageEvent) => {
      if (event.data?.type === 'NAVIGATE' && event.data.url) {
        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('app-navigate', { detail: event.data.url }));
      }
    };

    navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('message', handler);
    return () => navigator.serviceWorker.removeEventListener('message', handler);
  }, []);

  // Auto-subscribe on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    subscribe();
  }, [subscribe]);

  return { subscribe };
}

import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";

export function cn(...inputs: ClassValue[]) {
  return twMerge(clsx(inputs));
}
