import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { MessageCircle, Users, Clock, MapPin, CheckCircle, Zap, Navigation, Calendar, Lock } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { activityEmojiMap, activityLabelMap } from '@/data/activityTypes';

const ActivityDetailScreen = () => {
  const { id } = useParams(); // activity_id
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { authUser, currentUser, wallet, refreshWallet } = useApp();
  const [activity, setActivity] = useState<any>(null);
  const [owner, setOwner] = useState<any>(null);
  const [participants, setParticipants] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<any>(null);
  const [myParticipant, setMyParticipant] = useState<any>(null);
  const [depositLocked, setDepositLocked] = useState(false);

  // Load activity, owner, participants, session
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    const load = async () => {
      const { data: act } = await supabase.from('activities').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
      if (!act) return;
      setActivity(act);

      const { data: ownerP } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, avatar').eq('id', act.user_id).single();
      if (ownerP) setOwner(ownerP);

      const { data: parts } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', id);
      if (parts) {
        setParticipants(parts);
        const mine = parts.find((p: any) => p.user_id === authUser.id);
        setMyParticipant(mine || null);
      }

      // Find session between me and owner
      const otherId = act.user_id === authUser.id ? null : act.user_id;
      if (otherId) {
        const { data: sess } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('*')
          .or(`and(user_a.eq.${authUser.id},user_b.eq.${otherId}),and(user_a.eq.${otherId},user_b.eq.${authUser.id})`)
          .in('status', ['pending', 'awaiting_arrival', 'active'])
          .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
          .limit(1)
          .maybeSingle();
        if (sess) setSession(sess);
      }
    };
    load();
  }, [id, authUser]);

  // Realtime updates
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    const ch = supabase
      .channel(`activity-detail-${id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'activities', filter: `id=eq.${id}` }, (p) => setActivity(p.new))
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'activity_participants' }, async () => {
        const { data } = await supabase.from('activity_participants').select('*').eq('activity_id', id);
        if (data) {
          setParticipants(data);
          setMyParticipant(data.find((p: any) => p.user_id === authUser?.id) || null);
        }
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(ch); };
  }, [id, authUser]);

  if (!activity) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-background flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin w-6 h-6 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const isOwner = activity.user_id === authUser?.id;
  const isConfirmed = myParticipant?.status === 'confirmed';
  const isPending = myParticipant?.status === 'pending';
  const emoji = activityEmojiMap[activity.activity_type] || '📍';
  const label = activityLabelMap[activity.activity_type] || activity.activity_type;
  const depositVal = activity.deposit === '10' ? 10 : activity.deposit === '20' ? 20 : 0;
  const confirmedParticipants = participants.filter((p: any) => p.status === 'confirmed');

  const handleConfirmDeposit = async () => {
    if (!authUser || !wallet || depositVal <= 0) return;
    if ((wallet.token_balance || 0) < depositVal) {
      toast.error(`Insufficient tokens. Need ${depositVal}, have ${wallet.token_balance}`);
      return;
    }
    setDepositLocked(true);
    toast.success(`${depositVal} tokens locked as attendance deposit`);
  };

  const handleOpenChat = () => {
    const otherId = isOwner
      ? confirmedParticipants[0]?.user_id
      : activity.user_id;
    if (otherId) navigate(`/chat/${otherId}`);
  };

  const handleGoToSession = () => {
    if (session) navigate(`/session/${session.id}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background flex flex-col">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/30 px-4 pt-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">← Back</button>
          <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground flex-1">Activity Details</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 px-5 py-6 flex flex-col items-center">
        {/* Activity Icon */}
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 25 }}
          className="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl flex items-center justify-center text-4xl mb-4 bg-primary/10 border-2 border-primary/20"
        >
          {emoji}
        </motion.div>

        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{label}</h2>
        {activity.description && (
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">{activity.description}</p>
        )}

        {/* Status Badge */}
        <div className={`mt-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 ${
          activity.status === 'active' ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30' :
          activity.status === 'cancelled' ? 'bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border border-destructive/30' :
          'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'
        }`}>
          {activity.status === 'active' && <><Zap className="w-3 h-3" /> Active</>}
          {activity.status === 'cancelled' && 'Cancelled'}
          {activity.status === 'expired' && 'Expired'}
        </div>

        {/* Info Card */}
        <div className="mt-5 w-full max-w-sm bg-card/80 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-border/20 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Duration: {activity.duration} min</span>
          </div>
          {activity.location_name && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{activity.location_name}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {new Date(activity.start_time).toLocaleString([], { dateStyle: 'short', timeStyle: 'short' })}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {activity.payment === 'free' ? 'Free' : activity.payment === 'tokens' ? 'Token payment' : 'Arrange in chat'}
            </span>
          </div>
          {depositVal > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-400" />
              <span className="text-sm text-amber-400 font-semibold">{depositVal} token attendance deposit</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="text-sm font-bold text-muted-foreground">
              {activity.is_group ? '+ 👥' : '+ 👤'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              {activity.is_group ? `max ${activity.max_people}` : '1 person only'}
              {confirmedParticipants.length > 0 && ` · ${confirmedParticipants.length} confirmed`}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Owner Info */}
        {owner && (
          <div className="mt-4 w-full max-w-sm">
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-2">Organized by</p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 bg-card/80 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 border border-border/20">
              {owner.avatar ? (
                <img src={owner.avatar} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                  {owner.name?.charAt(0)}
                </div>
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{owner.name}</p>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{isOwner ? 'You' : 'Owner'}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="mt-6 w-full max-w-sm space-y-3">
          {/* Confirmed participant: show chat + session buttons */}
          {isConfirmed && (
            <>
              {/* Deposit confirmation (if not yet locked and deposit required) */}
              {depositVal > 0 && !depositLocked && session?.meetup_status === 'planning' && (
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={handleConfirmDeposit}
                  className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30"
                >
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4" /> Confirm {depositVal} Token Deposit
                </motion.button>
              )}

              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                onClick={handleOpenChat}
                className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow"
              >
                <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> Open Chat
              </motion.button>

              {session && (
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={handleGoToSession}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-card/80 border border-border/30 text-foreground"
                >
                  <Navigation className="w-4 h-4" /> Go to Session
                </motion.button>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {/* Pending request */}
          {isPending && !isOwner && (
            <div className="text-center py-4">
              <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Waiting for owner to accept your request...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Owner view: link to requests */}
          {isOwner && (
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
              onClick={() => navigate('/chats')}
              className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow"
            >
              <Users className="w-4 h-4" /> Manage Requests
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { MessageCircle, Users, Clock, MapPin, CheckCircle, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const activityConfig: Record<string, { emoji: string; label: string }> = {
  coffee: { emoji: '☕', label: 'Coffee' },
  walk: { emoji: '🚶', label: 'Walk' },
  drink: { emoji: '🍸', label: 'Drink' },
  chat: { emoji: '💬', label: 'Chat' },
  hangout: { emoji: '✨', label: 'Hangout' },
  help: { emoji: '🔧', label: 'Help' },
  ride: { emoji: '🚗', label: 'Ride' },
};

const ActivityScreen = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { authUser, acceptInvite, declineInvite } = useApp();
  const [invite, setInvite] = useState<any>(null);
  const [sender, setSender] = useState<any>(null);
  const [receiver, setReceiver] = useState<any>(null);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    const load = async () => {
      const { data: inv } = await supabase.from('invites').select('*').eq('id', id).single();
      if (!inv) return;
      setInvite(inv);
      const [{ data: s }, { data: r }] = await Promise.all([
        supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, avatar').eq('id', inv.sender_id).single(),
        supabase.from('profiles').select('id, name, avatar').eq('id', inv.receiver_id).single(),
      ]);
      setSender(s);
      setReceiver(r);
      const { data: sess } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('*').eq('invite_id', id).maybeSingle();
      if (sess) setSession(sess);
    };
    load();
  }, [id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id) return;
    const ch = supabase
      .channel(`activity-invite-${id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'invites', filter: `id=eq.${id}` }, (payload) => {
        setInvite(payload.new);
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(ch); };
  }, [id]);

  if (!invite) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-background flex items-center justify-center">
        <div className="animate-spin w-6 h-6 border-2 border-primary border-t-transparent rounded-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }

  const cfg = activityConfig[invite.type] || { emoji: '📍', label: invite.type };
  const isAccepted = invite.status === 'accepted';
  const isPending = invite.status === 'pending';
  const isDeclined = invite.status === 'declined';
  const isExpired = invite.status === 'expired';
  const iAmSender = authUser?.id === invite.sender_id;
  const otherUser = iAmSender ? receiver : sender;
  const participants = [sender, receiver].filter(Boolean);

  const handleAccept = async () => {
    await acceptInvite(invite.id);
    toast.success('Request accepted!');
    // Reload session
    const { data: sess } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('*').eq('invite_id', id).maybeSingle();
    if (sess) setSession(sess);
  };

  const handleDecline = async () => {
    await declineInvite(invite.id);
    toast('Request declined');
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background flex flex-col">
      <div className="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-border/30 px-4 pt-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] pb-3">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">← Back</button>
          <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground flex-1">Activity</h1>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex-1 px-5 py-6 flex flex-col items-center">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 300, damping: 25 }}
          className="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl flex items-center justify-center text-4xl mb-4 bg-primary/10 border-2 border-primary/20"
        >
          {cfg.emoji}
        </motion.div>

        <h2 className="text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{cfg.label}</h2>

        <div className={`mt-2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold flex items-center gap-1 ${
          isAccepted ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400 border border-emerald-500/30' :
          isPending ? 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400 border border-amber-500/30' :
          isDeclined ? 'bg-destructive/15 text-destructive border border-destructive/30' :
          'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'
        }`}>
          {isAccepted && <><CheckCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> Confirmed</>}
          {isPending && <><Clock className="w-3 h-3" /> Pending</>}
          {isDeclined && 'Declined'}
          {isExpired && 'Expired'}
        </div>

        {/* Participants */}
        <div className="mt-6 w-full max-w-sm">
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
            <Users className="w-3 h-3" /> Participants
          </p>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            {participants.map((p: any) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-card/80 rounded-2xl px-3 py-2 border border-border/20 flex-1">
                {p.avatar ? (
                  <img src={p.avatar} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                    {p.name?.charAt(0)}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">{p.name}</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {p.id === invite.sender_id ? 'Organizer' : 'Participant'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Info */}
        <div className="mt-5 w-full max-w-sm bg-card/80 rounded-2xl p-4 border border-border/20 space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Duration: {invite.duration_minutes} min</span>
          </div>
          {invite.token_cost > 0 && (
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Zap className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{invite.token_cost} tokens</span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Actions */}
        <div className="mt-6 w-full max-w-sm space-y-3">
          {isAccepted && (
            <>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                onClick={() => navigate(`/chat/${otherUser?.id}`)}
                className="w-full py-3.5 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow"
              >
                <MessageCircle className="w-4 h-4" /> Open Chat
              </motion.button>
              {session && (
                <motion.button
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/session/${session.id}`)}
                  className="w-full py-3 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2 bg-card/80 border border-border/30 text-foreground"
                >
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4" /> Go to Session
                </motion.button>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          {isPending && iAmSender && (
            <div className="text-center py-4">
              <div className="w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-amber-400 animate-pulse mx-auto mb-2" />
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Waiting for {otherUser?.name || 'response'}...</p>
            </div>
          )}

          {isPending && !iAmSender && (
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                onClick={handleAccept}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm gradient-primary text-primary-foreground"
              >
                Accept
              </motion.button>
              <motion.button
                whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
                onClick={handleDecline}
                className="flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl font-semibold text-sm bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30"
              >
                Decline
              </motion.button>
            </div>
          )}

          {(isDeclined || isExpired) && (
            <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              This activity is no longer available.
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ActivityScreen;

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { ArrowLeft, Send, Lock, ShieldCheck, Loader2, Smile, MoreVertical, Ban, ShieldOff } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  AlertDialog, AlertDialogContent, AlertDialogHeader, AlertDialogTitle, AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter, AlertDialogCancel, AlertDialogAction,
} from '@/components/ui/alert-dialog';

import ChatMessage from '@/components/chat/ChatMessage';
import QuickActions from '@/components/chat/QuickActions';
import InviteCard from '@/components/chat/InviteCard';
import MeetupPlanCard from '@/components/chat/MeetupPlanCard';
import MeetupPlaceCard from '@/components/chat/MeetupPlaceCard';
import MeetupStatusCard from '@/components/chat/MeetupStatusCard';
import ProposalCard from '@/components/chat/ProposalCard';
import DelayUpdateCard, { parseDelayMessage } from '@/components/chat/DelayUpdateCard';
import ActivityJoinCard from '@/components/chat/ActivityJoinCard';

import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';

const MSG_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

interface Proposal {
  id: string;
  invite_id: string | null;
  sender_id: string;
  receiver_id: string;
  activity_type: string;
  place_name: string | null;
  place_category: string | null;
  place_lat: number | null;
  place_lng: number | null;
  proposed_time: string | null;
  duration_minutes: number;
  status: string;
  parent_proposal_id: string | null;
  created_at: string | null;
}

type ChatItem =
  | { kind: 'message'; ts: number; msg: { id: string; sender_id: string; receiver_id: string; text: string; created_at: string | null; seen_at: string | null } }
  | { kind: 'invite'; ts: number; invite: import('@/context/AppContext').Invite }
  | { kind: 'proposal'; ts: number; proposal: Proposal; superseded?: boolean }
  | { kind: 'activity_join'; ts: number; participant: import('@/context/AppContext').ActivityParticipant; activity: import('@/context/AppContext').PostedActivity };

const Chat = () => {
  const { id } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { authUser, messages, invites, sendMessage, isConnected, fetchMessages, markMessagesAsRead, acceptInvite, declineInvite, blockUser, blockedIds, postedActivities, activityParticipants, fetchParticipants, acceptJoinRequest, declineJoinRequest, ignoreJoinRequest, setActiveChatId } = useApp();
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const [otherUser, setOtherUser] = useState<any>(null);
  const [otherTyping, setOtherTyping] = useState(false);
  const [reactions, setReactions] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [loadingOlder, setLoadingOlder] = useState(false);
  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);
  const [activeSession, setActiveSession] = useState<any>(null);
  const [showEmojiPicker, setShowEmojiPicker] = useState(false);
  const [proposals, setProposals] = useState<Proposal[]>([]);
  const [showBlockConfirm, setShowBlockConfirm] = useState(false);
  const [showHeaderMenu, setShowHeaderMenu] = useState(false);
  const bottomRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const scrollContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const typingTimeout = useRef<any>(null);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const connected = isConnected(id || '');
  const isBlocked = blockedIds.includes(id || '');

  const handleBlock = async () => {
    if (!id) return;
    await blockUser(id);
    setShowBlockConfirm(false);
    setShowHeaderMenu(false);
  };

  const handleUnblock = async () => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    await supabase.from('blocks').delete().eq('blocker_id', authUser.id).eq('blocked_id', id);
    // Remove from local blocked list - trigger re-fetch
    window.location.reload();
  };

  // Track active chat for banner suppression
  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) setActiveChatId(id);
    return () => setActiveChatId(null);
  }, [id, setActiveChatId]);

  // Fetch other user profile + messages
  useEffect(() => {
    if (id) {
      supabase.from('profiles').select('*').eq('id', id).single().then(({ data }) => {
        if (data) setOtherUser(data);
      });
      if (connected) {
        fetchMessages(id, MSG_PAGE_SIZE, 0);
        setHasMore(true);
      }
    }
  }, [id, connected]);

  // Fetch proposals
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    const fetchProposals = async () => {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('meeting_proposals').select('*')
        .or(`and(sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${id}),and(sender_id.eq.${id},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id})`)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: true });
      if (data) setProposals(data as any);
    };
    fetchProposals();

    // Realtime proposals
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`proposals-${authUser.id}-${id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'meeting_proposals' }, (payload) => {
        const p = payload.new as any;
        if (!p) return;
        const isRelevant = (p.sender_id === authUser.id && p.receiver_id === id) ||
                           (p.sender_id === id && p.receiver_id === authUser.id);
        if (!isRelevant) return;
        if (payload.eventType === 'INSERT') {
          setProposals(prev => prev.some(x => x.id === p.id) ? prev : [...prev, p]);
        } else if (payload.eventType === 'UPDATE') {
          setProposals(prev => prev.map(x => x.id === p.id ? { ...x, ...p } : x));
        }
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [id, authUser]);

  // Fetch activity participants relevant to this chat
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    // Fetch participants for activities owned by me or by the other user
    const relevantActivities = postedActivities.filter(
      a => a.user_id === authUser.id || a.user_id === id
    );
    relevantActivities.forEach(a => fetchParticipants(a.id));
  }, [id, authUser, postedActivities, fetchParticipants]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    const fetchSession = async () => {
      const { data } = await supabase.from('sessions').select('*')
        .or(`and(user_a.eq.${authUser.id},user_b.eq.${id}),and(user_a.eq.${id},user_b.eq.${authUser.id})`)
        .in('status', ['pending', 'awaiting_arrival', 'active'])
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();
      setActiveSession(data);
    };
    fetchSession();
    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`chat-session-${authUser.id}-${id}`)
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'sessions' }, (payload) => {
        const s = payload.new as any;
        if ((s.user_a === authUser.id && s.user_b === id) || (s.user_a === id && s.user_b === authUser.id)) {
          if (['pending', 'awaiting_arrival', 'active'].includes(s.status)) {
            setActiveSession(s);
          } else {
            setActiveSession(null);
          }
        }
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [id, authUser]);

  // Mark messages as seen
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser || !connected) return;
    markMessagesAsRead(id);
  }, [messages, id, authUser, connected, markMessagesAsRead]);

  // Typing indicator
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser || !connected) return;
    const channelName = `typing-${[authUser.id, id].sort().join('-')}`;
    const channel = supabase.channel(channelName)
      .on('broadcast', { event: 'typing' }, (payload) => {
        if (payload.payload?.user_id === id) {
          setOtherTyping(true);
          setTimeout(() => setOtherTyping(false), 3000);
        }
      })
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [id, authUser, connected]);

  const broadcastTyping = useCallback(() => {
    if (!id || !authUser) return;
    const channelName = `typing-${[authUser.id, id].sort().join('-')}`;
    supabase.channel(channelName).send({ type: 'broadcast', event: 'typing', payload: { user_id: authUser.id } });
  }, [id, authUser]);

  const handleTextChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    setText(e.target.value);
    if (typingTimeout.current) clearTimeout(typingTimeout.current);
    broadcastTyping();
    typingTimeout.current = setTimeout(() => {}, 2000);
  };

  // Merge messages, invites, and proposals into timeline
  const chatItems: ChatItem[] = useMemo(() => {
    const items: ChatItem[] = [];
    messages.forEach(m => {
      if ((m.sender_id === id && m.receiver_id === authUser?.id) || (m.sender_id === authUser?.id && m.receiver_id === id)) {
        items.push({ kind: 'message', ts: new Date(m.created_at || 0).getTime(), msg: m });
      }
    });
    const seenInviteIds = new Set<string>();
    // Only show invites that DON'T have proposals (proposals replace invite cards)
    const inviteIdsWithProposals = new Set(proposals.map(p => p.invite_id).filter(Boolean));
    invites.forEach(inv => {
      if (seenInviteIds.has(inv.id)) return;
      if (inviteIdsWithProposals.has(inv.id)) return; // skip - shown as proposal card instead
      if ((inv.sender_id === id && inv.receiver_id === authUser?.id) || (inv.sender_id === authUser?.id && inv.receiver_id === id)) {
        seenInviteIds.add(inv.id);
        items.push({ kind: 'invite', ts: new Date(inv.created_at || 0).getTime(), invite: inv });
      }
    });
    // Show proposals — mark superseded ones
    const supersededIds = new Set(proposals.filter(p => p.parent_proposal_id).map(p => p.parent_proposal_id!));
    proposals.forEach(p => {
      items.push({ kind: 'proposal', ts: new Date(p.created_at || 0).getTime(), proposal: p, superseded: supersededIds.has(p.id) });
    });
    // Show activity join requests between these two users
    for (const [actId, parts] of Object.entries(activityParticipants)) {
      const activity = postedActivities.find(a => a.id === actId);
      if (!activity) continue;
      parts.forEach(p => {
        const isRelevant = (activity.user_id === authUser?.id && p.user_id === id) ||
                           (activity.user_id === id && p.user_id === authUser?.id);
        if (isRelevant) {
          items.push({ kind: 'activity_join', ts: new Date(p.created_at || 0).getTime(), participant: p, activity });
        }
      });
    }
    items.sort((a, b) => a.ts - b.ts);
    return items;
  }, [messages, invites, proposals, id, authUser?.id, activityParticipants, postedActivities]);

  useEffect(() => {
    bottomRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
  }, [chatItems.length, activeSession]);

  const handleReaction = (msgId: string, emoji: string) => {
    setReactions(prev => ({ ...prev, [msgId]: prev[msgId] === emoji ? '' : emoji }));
  };

  const acceptedInviteForPlace = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeSession || activeSession.meetup_status !== 'choosing_place') return null;
    return invites.find(i => i.id === activeSession.invite_id && i.status === 'accepted') || null;
  }, [invites, activeSession]);

  const acceptedInviteWithPendingSession = useMemo(() => {
    if (!activeSession || activeSession.meetup_status !== 'planning') return null;
    return invites.find(i => i.id === activeSession.invite_id && i.status === 'accepted') || null;
  }, [invites, activeSession]);

  const handleMeetupTimeSelect = async (minutes: number) => {
    if (!activeSession) return;
    const meetupTime = new Date(Date.now() + minutes * 60000).toISOString();
    await supabase.from('sessions').update({
      meetup_time: meetupTime, meetup_status: 'approaching', status: 'awaiting_arrival',
    } as any).eq('id', activeSession.id);
  };

  const lastSeen = otherUser?.last_active_at
    ? (() => {
        const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(otherUser.last_active_at).getTime()) / 60000);
        if (diff < 1) return 'Just now';
        if (diff < 60) return `${diff}m ago`;
        if (diff < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}h ago`;
        return `${Math.floor(diff / 1440)}d ago`;
      })()
    : 'Unknown';

  const handleEmojiSelect = (emoji: string) => {
    setText(prev => prev + emoji);
    setShowEmojiPicker(false);
    inputRef.current?.focus();
  };

  if (!connected) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-background flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6">
        <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.9, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="text-center">
          <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-5">
            <Lock className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Chat Locked</h2>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-3 max-w-xs mx-auto leading-relaxed">
            You need an accepted connection to chat. Messages are free & unlimited once connected.
          </p>
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
            className="mt-8 px-8 py-3 rounded-xl bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold btn-press"
          >
            Go Back
          </motion.button>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const handleSend = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!text.trim() || !id) return;
    await sendMessage(id, text.trim());
    setText('');
    setShowEmojiPicker(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-screen flex flex-col bg-background">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 z-10 blue-header shadow-md">
        <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate('/chats')} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-[18px] h-[18px] text-white" />
        </motion.button>
        <div className="relative cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${id}`)}>
          {otherUser?.avatar ? (
            <img src={otherUser.avatar} alt={otherUser.name} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover ring-2 ring-white/20" />
          ) : (
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white/20 flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {otherUser?.name?.charAt(0) || '?'}
            </div>
          )}
          {otherUser?.is_online && (
            <div className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-[hsl(var(--status-available))] border-2 border-primary" />
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${id}`)}>
          <p className="font-semibold text-white text-[14px] leading-tight">{otherUser?.name || 'Loading...'}</p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-white/60 flex items-center gap-1 mt-0.5">
            {otherTyping ? (
              <motion.span initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="text-white font-semibold">typing...</motion.span>
            ) : otherUser?.is_online ? (
              <span className="text-white/80 font-medium">Online</span>
            ) : (
              `Last seen ${lastSeen}`
            )}
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* 3-dot menu */}
        <div className="relative">
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }}
            onClick={() => setShowHeaderMenu(p => !p)}
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors"
          >
            <MoreVertical className="w-[18px] h-[18px] text-muted-foreground" />
          </motion.button>
          <AnimatePresence>
            {showHeaderMenu && (
              <>
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                  className="fixed inset-0 z-20"
                  onClick={() => setShowHeaderMenu(false)}
                />
                <motion.div
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: -4 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
                  exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: -4 }}
                  className="absolute right-0 top-full mt-1 z-30 w-44 rounded-xl bg-card border border-border shadow-lg overflow-hidden"
                >
                  {isBlocked ? (
                    <button
                      onClick={handleUnblock}
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] font-medium text-foreground flex items-center gap-2.5 hover:bg-secondary transition-colors"
                    >
                      <ShieldOff className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                      Unblock user
                    </button>
                  ) : (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => { setShowBlockConfirm(true); setShowHeaderMenu(false); }}
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 text-left text-[13px] font-medium text-destructive flex items-center gap-2.5 hover:bg-destructive/10 transition-colors"
                    >
                      <Ban className="w-4 h-4" />
                      Block user
                    </button>
                  )}
                </motion.div>
              </>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        </div>
      </header>

      {/* Block confirmation dialog */}
      <AlertDialog open={showBlockConfirm} onOpenChange={setShowBlockConfirm}>
        <AlertDialogContent className="bg-card border-border rounded-2xl max-w-sm">
          <AlertDialogHeader>
            <AlertDialogTitle className="text-foreground">Block this user?</AlertDialogTitle>
            <AlertDialogDescription className="text-muted-foreground">
              You will stop all contact with this person. They won't be able to message you or send invites.
            </AlertDialogDescription>
          </AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogFooter>
            <AlertDialogCancel className="rounded-xl">Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
            <AlertDialogAction onClick={handleBlock} className="rounded-xl bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90">
              Block
            </AlertDialogAction>
          </AlertDialogFooter>
        </AlertDialogContent>
      </AlertDialog>

      {/* Messages Timeline */}
      <div
        ref={scrollContainerRef}
        className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-4 py-4 space-y-3"
        onScroll={(e) => {
          const el = e.currentTarget;
          if (el.scrollTop < 60 && hasMore && !loadingOlder && chatItems.length >= MSG_PAGE_SIZE) {
            setLoadingOlder(true);
            fetchMessages(id!, MSG_PAGE_SIZE, messages.filter(m =>
              (m.sender_id === id && m.receiver_id === authUser?.id) ||
              (m.sender_id === authUser?.id && m.receiver_id === id)
            ).length).then(() => setLoadingOlder(false));
          }
        }}
      >
        {loadingOlder && (
          <div className="flex justify-center py-2">
            <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
          </div>
        )}

        {chatItems.length === 0 && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} className="text-center py-20">
            <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-primary/10 border border-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-7 h-7 text-primary" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-sm text-foreground font-medium">You're connected!</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground/60 mt-1">Messages are free & unlimited ✨</p>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {chatItems.map((item, i) => {
          if (item.kind === 'message') {
            const isMine = item.msg.sender_id === authUser?.id;

            // Check for delay update message
            const delayData = parseDelayMessage(item.msg.text);
            if (delayData) {
              return (
                <DelayUpdateCard
                  key={`delay-${item.msg.id}`}
                  messageId={item.msg.id}
                  delayData={delayData as any}
                  isMine={isMine}
                  senderName={isMine ? 'You' : (otherUser?.name || 'User')}
                />
              );
            }

            const nextItem = chatItems[i + 1];
            const isLastInGroup = !nextItem || nextItem.kind !== 'message' || nextItem.msg.sender_id !== authUser?.id;
            const showStatus = isMine && isLastInGroup;
            const isLastSeen = showStatus && !!item.msg.seen_at;
            return (
              <ChatMessage
                key={`msg-${item.msg.id}`}
                id={item.msg.id}
                text={item.msg.text}
                isMine={isMine}
                createdAt={item.msg.created_at}
                seenAt={item.msg.seen_at}
                reaction={reactions[item.msg.id]}
                onReact={handleReaction}
                delay={i}
                showStatus={showStatus}
                seenAvatar={isLastSeen ? otherUser?.avatar : null}
              />
            );
          }
          if (item.kind === 'proposal') {
            const prev = proposals.find(p => p.id === item.proposal.parent_proposal_id) || null;
            return (
              <ProposalCard
                key={`prop-${item.proposal.id}`}
                proposal={item.proposal}
                previousProposal={prev}
                isMine={item.proposal.sender_id === authUser?.id}
                otherName={otherUser?.name || 'User'}
                isOtherOnline={!!otherUser?.is_online}
                isSuperseded={!!item.superseded}
              />
            );
          }
          if (item.kind === 'activity_join') {
            const isOwner = item.activity.user_id === authUser?.id;
            return (
              <ActivityJoinCard
                key={`join-${item.participant.id}`}
                participant={item.participant}
                activity={item.activity}
                isOwner={isOwner}
                requesterName={isOwner ? (otherUser?.name || 'User') : 'You'}
                ownerName={isOwner ? 'You' : (otherUser?.name || 'User')}
                onAccept={acceptJoinRequest}
                onDecline={declineJoinRequest}
                onIgnore={ignoreJoinRequest}
              />
            );
          }
          if (item.kind === 'invite') {
            return (
              <InviteCard
                key={`inv-${item.invite.id}`}
                invite={item.invite}
                isMine={item.invite.sender_id === authUser?.id}
                otherName={otherUser?.name || 'User'}
                isOtherOnline={!!otherUser?.is_online}
                onAccept={acceptInvite}
                onIgnore={async (invId) => {
                  await supabase.from('invites').update({ status: 'ignored' } as any).eq('id', invId);
                }}
                onChange={(inv) => {
                  if (!authUser) return;
                  supabase.from('meeting_proposals').insert({
                    invite_id: inv.id,
                    sender_id: authUser.id,
                    receiver_id: inv.sender_id === authUser.id ? inv.receiver_id : inv.sender_id,
                    activity_type: inv.type,
                    proposed_time: new Date().toISOString(),
                    duration_minutes: inv.duration_minutes || 30,
                    status: 'pending',
                    payment_preference: 'split',
                  } as any).then(() => {
                    supabase.from('invites').update({ status: 'countered' } as any).eq('id', inv.id);
                    toast.success('Counter proposal created!');
                  });
                }}
              />
            );
          }
          return null;
        })}

        {acceptedInviteForPlace && activeSession && (
          <MeetupPlaceCard session={activeSession} inviteType={acceptedInviteForPlace.type} otherUser={otherUser} isSender={acceptedInviteForPlace.sender_id === authUser?.id} />
        )}
        {acceptedInviteWithPendingSession && activeSession && (
          <MeetupPlanCard onSelect={handleMeetupTimeSelect} selectedTime={activeSession.meetup_time} isMine={acceptedInviteWithPendingSession.receiver_id === authUser?.id} otherName={otherUser?.name || 'User'} sessionId={activeSession.id} otherId={id} />
        )}
        {activeSession && activeSession.meetup_status && !['planning', 'choosing_place'].includes(activeSession.meetup_status) && (
          <MeetupStatusCard session={activeSession} otherUser={otherUser} />
        )}

        {/* Typing indicator */}
        <AnimatePresence>
          {otherTyping && (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 4 }} className="flex justify-start">
              <div className="bg-secondary rounded-2xl rounded-bl-md px-4 py-3 border border-border">
                <div className="flex gap-1">
                  {[0, 1, 2].map(i => (
                    <motion.div
                      key={i}
                      className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted-foreground/50"
                      animate={{ y: [0, -3, 0], opacity: [0.4, 1, 0.4] }}
                      transition={{ repeat: Infinity, duration: 0.8, delay: i * 0.15 }}
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </motion.div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        <div ref={bottomRef} />
      </div>

      {/* Input Area */}
      {isBlocked ? (
        <div className="px-4 py-4 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border text-center">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mb-2">
            <Ban className="w-4 h-4 text-destructive" />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-destructive">User blocked</span>
          </div>
          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
            onClick={handleUnblock}
            className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-[13px] font-semibold text-primary border border-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/10 transition-colors"
          >
            Unblock
          </motion.button>
        </div>
      ) : (
      <div className="relative">
        <AnimatePresence>
          {showEmojiPicker && (
            <div className="absolute bottom-full left-0 right-0 px-3 pb-2">
              <EmojiPicker isOpen={showEmojiPicker} onSelect={handleEmojiSelect} onClose={() => setShowEmojiPicker(false)} />
            </div>
          )}
        </AnimatePresence>

        <form onSubmit={handleSend} className="px-3 py-2.5 flex items-end gap-1.5 bg-card/95 backdrop-blur-lg border-t border-border">
          <QuickActions receiverId={id || ''} />

          <motion.button
            type="button"
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }}
            onClick={() => setShowEmojiPicker(p => !p)}
            className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
              showEmojiPicker ? 'text-primary' : 'text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground'
            }`}
          >
            <Smile className="w-5 h-5" />
          </motion.button>

          <div className="flex-1 relative">
            <input
              ref={inputRef}
              value={text}
              onChange={handleTextChange}
              placeholder="Message..."
              className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full bg-secondary text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground/50 text-[14px] outline-none border border-border focus:border-primary/50 transition-all"
            />
          </div>

          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }}
            type="submit"
            disabled={!text.trim()}
            className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center transition-all ${
              text.trim()
                ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground'
                : 'text-muted-foreground/30'
            }`}
          >
            <Send className="w-[18px] h-[18px]" />
          </motion.button>
        </form>
      </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Chat;

FILE: src/pages/Chats.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import BottomNav from '@/components/BottomNav';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { MessageCircle } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';

const Chats = () => {
  const { contacts, authUser, messages, invites, getUnreadCount } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [lastMessages, setLastMessages] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  const connected = contacts.filter(r => r.status === 'accepted');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser || connected.length === 0) { setLoading(false); return; }
    const otherIds = connected.map(r => r.sender_id === authUser.id ? r.receiver_id : r.sender_id);

    supabase.from('profiles').select('*').in('id', otherIds).then(({ data }) => {
      if (data) {
        const map: Record<string, any> = {};
        data.forEach(p => { map[p.id] = p; });
        setProfiles(map);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });

    if (otherIds.length > 0) {
      const orFilters = otherIds.map(otherId =>
        `and(sender_id.eq.${authUser.id},receiver_id.eq.${otherId}),and(sender_id.eq.${otherId},receiver_id.eq.${authUser.id})`
      ).join(',');

      supabase
        .from('messages')
        .select('*')
        .or(orFilters)
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(otherIds.length * 2)
        .then(({ data }) => {
          if (data) {
            const lastMsgMap: Record<string, any> = {};
            data.forEach(msg => {
              const otherId = msg.sender_id === authUser.id ? msg.receiver_id : msg.sender_id;
              if (!lastMsgMap[otherId]) lastMsgMap[otherId] = msg;
            });
            setLastMessages(lastMsgMap);
          }
        });
    }
  }, [connected.length, authUser]);

  const getUnread = (otherId: string) => {
    const msgUnread = getUnreadCount(otherId);
    // Count pending/delayed invites from this user as unread
    const inviteUnread = invites.filter(
      i => i.sender_id === otherId && i.receiver_id === authUser?.id && (i.status === 'pending' || i.status === 'delayed')
    ).length;
    return msgUnread + inviteUnread;
  };

  const getPreview = (otherId: string, lastMsg: any) => {
    // Check for pending invites from this person
    const pendingInvite = invites.find(
      i => i.sender_id === otherId && i.receiver_id === authUser?.id && (i.status === 'pending' || i.status === 'delayed')
    );
    if (pendingInvite) {
      const typeEmoji: Record<string, string> = { coffee: '☕', walk: '🚶', drink: '🍸', premium: '✨' };
      return `${typeEmoji[pendingInvite.type] || '📩'} Sent you an invite`;
    }
    if (lastMsg) {
      return lastMsg.sender_id === authUser?.id ? `You: ${lastMsg.text}` : lastMsg.text;
    }
    return 'Start chatting';
  };

  const timeAgo = (ts: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(ts).getTime()) / 60000);
    if (diff < 1) return 'Now';
    if (diff < 60) return `${diff}m`;
    if (diff < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}h`;
    return `${Math.floor(diff / 1440)}d`;
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background pb-24">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 blue-header px-5 py-4 shadow-md">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-white">Chats</h1>
        <p className="text-[12px] text-white/70 mt-0.5">{connected.length} connections</p>
      </header>

      <div className="px-4 mt-3">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3 bg-card border border-border">
                <Skeleton className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full" />
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" />
                  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-2/3" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : connected.length === 0 ? (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0 }} animate={{ opacity: 1 }} className="text-center py-24">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4">
              <MessageCircle className="w-7 h-7 text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-foreground font-bold text-lg">No chats yet</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1.5">Connect with people nearby to start chatting</p>
          </motion.div>
        ) : (
          <div className="space-y-2">
            {connected.map((req, i) => {
              const otherId = req.sender_id === authUser?.id ? req.receiver_id : req.sender_id;
              const user = profiles[otherId];
              if (!user) return null;
              const lastMsg = lastMessages[otherId];
              const unread = getUnread(otherId);

              return (
                <motion.button
                  key={req.id}
                  initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }}
                  animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                  transition={{ delay: i * 0.03 }}
                  whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
                  onClick={() => navigate(`/chat/${otherId}`)}
                  className="w-full rounded-2xl p-3.5 flex items-center gap-3 text-left bg-card border border-border shadow-card"
                >
                  <div className="relative">
                    {user.avatar ? (
                      <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-full bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-base font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                        {user.name?.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {user.is_online && (
                      <div className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 w-3 h-3 rounded-full border-2 border-card bg-[hsl(var(--status-available))]" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-sm text-foreground">{user.name}</p>
                      {lastMsg && (
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                          {lastMsg.created_at ? timeAgo(lastMsg.created_at) : ''}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between mt-0.5">
                      <p className={`text-[12px] truncate pr-2 ${unread > 0 ? 'text-foreground font-medium' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                        {getPreview(otherId, lastMsg)}
                      </p>
                      {unread > 0 && (
                        <span className="flex-shrink-0 w-5 h-5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center text-primary-foreground bg-primary">
                          {unread}
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </motion.button>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Chats;

FILE: src/pages/Encounters.tsx

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import BottomNav from '@/components/BottomNav';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Radio, ArrowLeft, Clock, Zap, Navigation, UserPlus, Sparkles } from 'lucide-react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';

const stateConfig: Record<string, { text: string; icon: typeof Radio; color: string; bgClass: string }> = {
  nearby: {
    text: 'Nearby',
    icon: Navigation,
    color: 'text-primary',
    bgClass: 'bg-primary/15 border-primary/20',
  },
  very_close: {
    text: 'Very Close',
    icon: Sparkles,
    color: 'text-accent',
    bgClass: 'bg-accent/15 border-accent/20',
  },
  just_passed: {
    text: 'Crossed Paths',
    icon: Clock,
    color: 'text-amber-400',
    bgClass: 'bg-amber-500/15 border-amber-500/20',
  },
};

const Encounters = () => {
  const { authUser, sendRequest, getRequestStatus, isCompatible } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [encounters, setEncounters] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<string>('all');

  const loadEncounters = async () => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const { data } = await supabase
      .from('encounters')
      .select('*')
      .or(`user1_id.eq.${authUser.id},user2_id.eq.${authUser.id}`)
      .order('timestamp', { ascending: false })
      .limit(50);

    if (data) {
      setEncounters(data);
      const ids = new Set<string>();
      data.forEach(e => ids.add(e.user1_id === authUser.id ? e.user2_id : e.user1_id));
      if (ids.size > 0) {
        const { data: p } = await supabase.from('profiles').select('*').in('id', Array.from(ids));
        if (p) {
          const map: Record<string, any> = {};
          p.forEach(pr => { map[pr.id] = pr; });
          setProfiles(map);
        }
      }
    }
    setLoading(false);
  };

  useEffect(() => { loadEncounters(); }, [authUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const channel = supabase
      .channel('encounters-page-rt')
      .on('postgres_changes', { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'encounters' }, () => loadEncounters())
      .subscribe();
    return () => { supabase.removeChannel(channel); };
  }, [authUser]);

  const timeAgo = (ts: string) => {
    const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(ts).getTime()) / 1000);
    if (diff < 60) return 'Just now';
    if (diff < 3600) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}m ago`;
    if (diff < 86400) return `${Math.floor(diff / 3600)}h ago`;
    return `${Math.floor(diff / 86400)}d ago`;
  };

  const filteredEncounters = filter === 'all'
    ? encounters
    : encounters.filter(e => e.proximity_state === filter);

  const filters = [
    { value: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { value: 'very_close', label: 'Very Close' },
    { value: 'just_passed', label: 'Crossed' },
    { value: 'nearby', label: 'Nearby' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface pb-24">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 glass px-5 py-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center btn-press">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-foreground" />
          </motion.button>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight">Encounters</h1>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">{encounters.length} recent encounters</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filter pills */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">
          {filters.map(f => (
            <motion.button
              key={f.value}
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }}
              onClick={() => setFilter(f.value)}
              className={`px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-all duration-300 btn-press ${
                filter === f.value
                  ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(var(--primary-rgb,139,92,246),0.3)]'
                  : 'glass-card text-secondary-foreground'
              }`}
            >
              {f.label}
            </motion.button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="px-4 mt-4 space-y-3">
        <AnimatePresence mode="popLayout">
          {loading ? (
            [1, 2, 3, 4].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                <Skeleton className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl skeleton-shimmer" />
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                  <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/3 skeleton-shimmer" />
                  <Skeleton className="h-3 w-1/2 skeleton-shimmer" />
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          ) : filteredEncounters.length === 0 ? (
            <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }} className="text-center py-24">
              <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-3xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-4 animate-float">
                <Radio className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground" />
              </div>
              <p className="text-foreground font-display font-semibold text-lg">No encounters yet</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">Go out and explore to cross paths</p>
            </motion.div>
          ) : filteredEncounters.map((enc, i) => {
            const otherId = enc.user1_id === authUser?.id ? enc.user2_id : enc.user1_id;
            const user = profiles[otherId];
            if (!user) return null;

            const state = stateConfig[enc.proximity_state] || stateConfig.nearby;
            const StateIcon = state.icon;
            const reqStatus = getRequestStatus(otherId);
            const compatible = isCompatible({ gender: user.gender, interested_in: user.interested_in || 'everyone' });

            return (
              <motion.div
                key={enc.id}
                initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 16 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -40 }}
                transition={{ delay: i * 0.03, type: 'spring', stiffness: 350, damping: 28 }}
                className="glass-card rounded-3xl overflow-hidden border border-border/30"
              >
                <div className="p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <div className="relative" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${otherId}`)}>
                    {user.avatar ? (
                      <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-base font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                        {user.name?.charAt(0)}
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {user.is_online && (
                      <div className="absolute -top-1 -right-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 border-2 border-card" />
                    )}
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex-1 min-w-0" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${otherId}`)}>
                    <p className="font-display font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{user.name}{user.age ? `, ${user.age}` : ''}</p>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
                      <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold border ${state.bgClass} ${state.color}`}>
                        <StateIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {state.text}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">~{enc.distance_estimate || 0}m</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="text-right flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                      {enc.timestamp ? timeAgo(enc.timestamp) : ''}
                    </span>
                    {compatible && !reqStatus && (
                      <motion.button
                        whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                        onClick={() => sendRequest(otherId)}
                        className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-primary/15 flex items-center justify-center text-primary btn-press"
                      >
                        <UserPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                      </motion.button>
                    )}
                    {reqStatus && (
                      <span className={`text-[9px] font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${
                        reqStatus.status === 'accepted' ? 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground'
                      }`}>
                        {reqStatus.status === 'accepted' ? 'Connected' : 'Pending'}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </motion.div>
            );
          })}
        </AnimatePresence>
      </div>

      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Encounters;
