import { useState, useMemo, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Bell, ArrowLeft, CheckCheck, Coffee, Footprints, Wine, Gift, Star, Clock, MessageSquare, UserCheck, AlertTriangle, Zap } from 'lucide-react';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import BottomNav from '@/components/BottomNav';

const typeConfig: Record<string, { icon: React.ReactNode; emoji: string; color: string }> = {
  invite_received: { icon: <Coffee className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '☕', color: 'text-amber-400' },
  invite_accepted: { icon: <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '✅', color: 'text-emerald-400' },
  invite_expired: { icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '⏰', color: 'text-muted-foreground' },
  invite_changed: { icon: <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '🔄', color: 'text-primary' },
  delay_request: { icon: <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '⏱️', color: 'text-amber-400' },
  new_message: { icon: <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '💬', color: 'text-blue-400' },
  gift_received: { icon: <Gift className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '🎁', color: 'text-pink-400' },
  session_started: { icon: <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '🟢', color: 'text-emerald-400' },
  session_completed: { icon: <Star className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '⭐', color: 'text-primary' },
  request_received: { icon: <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '🤝', color: 'text-primary' },
  request_accepted: { icon: <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '✅', color: 'text-emerald-400' },
};

const timeAgo = (dateStr: string) => {
  const diff = Math.floor((Date.now() - new Date(dateStr).getTime()) / 60000);
  if (diff < 1) return 'just now';
  if (diff < 60) return `${diff}m ago`;
  if (diff < 1440) return `${Math.floor(diff / 60)}h ago`;
  return `${Math.floor(diff / 1440)}d ago`;
};

const isToday = (dateStr: string) => {
  const d = new Date(dateStr);
  const now = new Date();
  return d.getDate() === now.getDate() && d.getMonth() === now.getMonth() && d.getFullYear() === now.getFullYear();
};

const Notifications = () => {
  const { notifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead, clearNotifications, acceptInvite, authUser } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [acting, setActing] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.is_read).length;

  // Auto-mark all notifications as read when opening this screen
  useEffect(() => {
    if (unread > 0) {
      markAllNotificationsRead();
    }
  }, []); // only on mount

  const grouped = useMemo(() => {
    const today = notifications.filter(n => isToday(n.created_at));
    const earlier = notifications.filter(n => !isToday(n.created_at));
    return { today, earlier };
  }, [notifications]);

  const handleAcceptInvite = async (notif: any) => {
    if (acting) return;
    setActing(notif.id);
    // Try to find invite ID from action_url pattern /chat/userId
    // We need to find the pending invite for this sender
    const senderId = notif.action_url?.replace('/chat/', '');
    if (senderId && authUser) {
      const { data: inv } = await supabase
        .from('invites')
        .select('id')
        .eq('sender_id', senderId)
        .eq('receiver_id', authUser.id)
        .eq('status', 'pending')
        .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
        .limit(1)
        .maybeSingle();
      if (inv) {
        await acceptInvite(inv.id);
        toast.success('Invite accepted!');
        markNotificationRead(notif.id);
        navigate(`/chat/${senderId}`);
      } else {
        toast.error('Invite no longer available');
      }
    }
    setActing(null);
  };

  const handleChange = (notif: any) => {
    markNotificationRead(notif.id);
    if (notif.action_url) navigate(notif.action_url);
  };

  const handleIgnore = (notif: any) => {
    markNotificationRead(notif.id);
  };

  const renderNotification = (n: any, i: number) => {
    const cfg = typeConfig[n.type] || { icon: <Bell className="w-4 h-4" />, emoji: '🔔', color: 'text-muted-foreground' };
    const isInvite = n.type === 'invite_received';

    return (
      <motion.div
        key={n.id}
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ delay: i * 0.02 }}
        className={`rounded-2xl p-3.5 transition-colors ${
          !n.is_read
            ? 'bg-primary/5 border border-primary/10'
            : 'glass-card'
        }`}
      >
        <button
          onClick={() => {
            markNotificationRead(n.id);
            if (n.action_url) navigate(n.action_url);
          }}
          className="w-full text-left flex items-start gap-3"
        >
          {/* Icon */}
          <div className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
            !n.is_read ? 'bg-primary/15' : 'bg-card/60'
          }`}>
            {n.avatar_url ? (
              <img src={n.avatar_url} alt="" className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl object-cover" />
            ) : (
              <span className="text-lg">{cfg.emoji}</span>
            )}
          </div>

          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <p className={`text-[13px] font-semibold ${!n.is_read ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-foreground/80'}`}>
                {n.title}
              </p>
              {!n.is_read && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-primary shrink-0 mt-1.5 shadow-glow-sm" />}
            </div>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5 line-clamp-2">{n.message}</p>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/50 mt-1">{timeAgo(n.created_at)}</p>
          </div>
        </button>

        {/* Quick actions for invite notifications */}
        {isInvite && !n.is_read && (
          <div className="flex gap-1.5 mt-2.5 ml-[52px]">
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
              disabled={acting === n.id}
              onClick={() => handleAcceptInvite(n)}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl gradient-glow text-primary-foreground text-[10px] font-bold shadow-glow-sm btn-press disabled:opacity-50"
            >
              {acting === n.id ? '...' : 'Accept'}
            </motion.button>
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
              onClick={() => handleChange(n)}
              className="px-4 py-1.5 rounded-xl glass-card text-foreground text-[10px] font-semibold border border-border/20"
            >
              Change
            </motion.button>
            <motion.button
              whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}
              onClick={() => handleIgnore(n)}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-[10px] font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground transition-colors"
            >
              Ignore
            </motion.button>
          </div>
        )}
      </motion.div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="blue-header px-4 pt-4 pb-3 shadow-md">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate(-1)}
            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-white/15 border border-white/20 flex items-center justify-center">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
          </motion.button>
          <div className="flex-1">
            <h1 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-white">Notification Center</h1>
            {unread > 0 && (
              <p className="text-[11px] text-white/70 font-medium">{unread} unread</p>
            )}
          </div>
          {unread > 0 && (
            <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={markAllNotificationsRead}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl bg-white/15 border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
              <span className="text-[10px] font-semibold text-white">Read all</span>
            </motion.button>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 pb-24 mt-2 space-y-4">
        {notifications.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-20">
            <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-3xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
              <Bell className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground" />
            </div>
            <p className="text-foreground font-display font-semibold text-sm">No notifications</p>
            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">You're all caught up!</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Today */}
            {grouped.today.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 px-1">Today</p>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {grouped.today.map((n, i) => renderNotification(n, i))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Earlier */}
            {grouped.earlier.length > 0 && (
              <div>
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider mb-2 px-1">Earlier</p>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {grouped.earlier.map((n, i) => renderNotification(n, i))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Notifications;

import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import BottomNav from '@/components/BottomNav';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { Star, Shield, LogOut, History, Settings, ChevronRight, BadgeCheck, Award, Sparkles, Pencil, Heart, ImageIcon, Wallet } from 'lucide-react';
import RecentInteractions from '@/components/profile/RecentInteractions';

const lookingForLabels: Record<string, string> = {
  friendship: '🤝 Friendship',
  coffee_buddy: '☕ Coffee Buddy',
  dating: '❤️ Dating',
  networking: '💼 Networking',
  adventure: '🌍 Adventure',
};

const activityEmoji: Record<string, string> = {
  coffee: '☕️', walk: '🚶', drink: '🍸', chat: '💬', hangout: '✨',
};

const Profile = () => {
  const { currentUser, logout } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  if (!currentUser) return null;

  const trustPercent = currentUser.trust_score || 50;
  const isLive = (currentUser as any).is_available && (currentUser as any).available_until && new Date((currentUser as any).available_until) > new Date();
  const photos = (currentUser as any)?.photos || [];
  const lookingFor = (currentUser as any)?.looking_for;

  const badges = [
    ...(trustPercent >= 70 ? [{ icon: BadgeCheck, label: 'Verified', color: 'text-primary' }] : []),
    ...(trustPercent >= 85 ? [{ icon: Shield, label: 'Reliable', color: 'text-emerald-400' }] : []),
    ...(currentUser.avg_rating >= 4.5 ? [{ icon: Award, label: 'Top Rated', color: 'text-amber-400' }] : []),
  ];

  const menuItems = [
    { icon: Pencil, label: 'Edit Profile', action: () => navigate('/profile/edit') },
    { icon: Wallet, label: 'Wallet', action: () => navigate('/wallet') },
    { icon: History, label: 'Encounter History', action: () => navigate('/encounters') },
    { icon: Settings, label: 'Settings', action: () => navigate('/settings') },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-background pb-24">
      {/* Blue profile header */}
      <div className="blue-header px-6 pt-10 pb-6 text-center rounded-b-3xl shadow-md">
        <motion.div
          initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }}
          transition={{ type: 'spring', stiffness: 200, damping: 20 }}
          className="relative w-28 h-28 mx-auto"
        >
          <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-full bg-white/20 blur-lg animate-pulse-glow" />
          <div className={`relative w-28 h-28 rounded-full p-[3px] ${isLive ? 'bg-gradient-to-br from-emerald-400 to-emerald-600' : 'bg-white/30'}`}>
            {currentUser.avatar ? (
              <img src={currentUser.avatar} alt={currentUser.name} className="w-full h-full rounded-full object-cover" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-full h-full rounded-full bg-card flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-display text-muted-foreground">
                {currentUser.name?.charAt(0)}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
          {isLive && (
            <div className="absolute -bottom-1 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 px-3 py-1 rounded-full bg-emerald-500/20 border border-emerald-500/30 backdrop-blur-xl">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-400 flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-400 animate-pulse" />
                {activityEmoji[(currentUser as any).activity_type || ''] || '⚡'} Live
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.15 }}>
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-white mt-5">{currentUser.name}{currentUser.age ? `, ${currentUser.age}` : ''}</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-white/70">@{currentUser.username}</p>
          {currentUser.bio && <p className="text-sm text-white/70 mt-1.5 max-w-xs mx-auto">{currentUser.bio}</p>}
        </motion.div>

        {lookingFor && lookingForLabels[lookingFor] && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}
            className="flex justify-center mt-3">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white/15 border border-white/20 px-4 py-2 rounded-full">
              <Heart className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-pink-300" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-white">{lookingForLabels[lookingFor]}</span>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {badges.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.25 }}
            className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 mt-3">
            {badges.map(({ icon: Icon, label, color }) => (
              <div key={label} className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white/15 border border-white/20 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full">
                <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-white" />
                <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-white">{label}</span>
              </div>
            ))}
          </motion.div>
        )}

        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 8 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.3 }}
          className="flex items-center justify-center gap-5 mt-5">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Star className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-300 fill-amber-300" />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{currentUser.avg_rating}</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Shield className="w-4 h-4 text-white/80" />
            <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{trustPercent}%</span>
          </div>
        </motion.div>
      </div>

      <div className="px-4">
        {photos.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.32 }}
            className="mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-2">
              <ImageIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Photos</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto scrollbar-none">
              {photos.map((photo: string, i: number) => (
                <img key={i} src={photo} alt={`Photo ${i + 1}`} className="w-28 h-28 rounded-2xl object-cover border border-border/20 shrink-0" />
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        {currentUser.interests?.length > 0 && (
          <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.33 }}
            className="mb-4">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">Interests</span>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {currentUser.interests.map((i: string) => (
                <span key={i} className="px-3 py-1.5 glass-card text-secondary-foreground rounded-full text-[11px] font-semibold">{i}</span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}

        <RecentInteractions />

        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.35 }}
          className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 mb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" /> Trust Score
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary">{trustPercent}%</span>
          </div>
          <div className="h-2 rounded-full bg-muted overflow-hidden">
            <motion.div initial={{ width: 0 }} animate={{ width: `${trustPercent}%` }}
              transition={{ duration: 1, delay: 0.5, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
              className="h-full rounded-full gradient-glow" />
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.4 }}
          className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3">
          {[
            { val: currentUser.sessions_completed, label: 'Sessions' },
            { val: trustPercent + '%', label: 'Trust' },
            { val: currentUser.avg_rating, label: 'Rating' },
          ].map(({ val, label }) => (
            <div key={label} className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 text-center hover-glow transition-all duration-300">
              <p className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-foreground">{val}</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{label}</p>
            </div>
          ))}
        </motion.div>

        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.5 }}
          className="mt-5 space-y-2">
          {menuItems.map(({ icon: Icon, label, action }) => (
            <motion.button key={label} whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }} onClick={action}
              className="w-full glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3 hover-glow transition-all duration-300">
              <Icon className="w-5 h-5 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="flex-1 text-sm text-foreground text-left font-medium">{label}</span>
              <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            </motion.button>
          ))}
        </motion.div>

        <motion.button
          initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.6 }}
          whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
          onClick={async () => { await logout(); navigate('/'); }}
          className="w-full mt-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-destructive/10 text-destructive font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 btn-press"
        >
          <LogOut className="w-4 h-4" /> Sign Out
        </motion.button>
      </div>

      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Profile;


========================================
FILE: src/pages/ProfileEdit.tsx

import { useState, useRef, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { ArrowLeft, Camera, Save, Loader2, X, ImagePlus } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Progress } from '@/components/ui/progress';

const interestOptions = [
  '☕ Coffee', '✈️ Travel', '💪 Gym', '🎵 Music', '🍕 Food', '🚶 Walking',
  '🌙 Nightlife', '📚 Books', '🎬 Movies', '🎮 Gaming', '📸 Photography',
  '🧘 Yoga', '🎨 Art', '💻 Tech', '🌿 Nature', '👗 Fashion', '🍳 Cooking',
  '🐕 Pets', '⚽ Sports', '🎤 Karaoke',
];

const lookingForOptions = [
  { value: 'friendship', label: '🤝 Friendship' },
  { value: 'coffee_buddy', label: '☕ Coffee Buddy' },
  { value: 'dating', label: '❤️ Dating' },
  { value: 'networking', label: '💼 Networking' },
  { value: 'adventure', label: '🌍 Adventure' },
];

const ProfileEdit = () => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { currentUser, updateProfile, authUser } = useApp();
  const [name, setName] = useState(currentUser?.name || '');
  const [bio, setBio] = useState(currentUser?.bio || '');
  const [age, setAge] = useState(currentUser?.age?.toString() || '');
  const [city, setCity] = useState(currentUser?.city || '');
  const [avatar, setAvatar] = useState(currentUser?.avatar || '');
  const [gender, setGender] = useState(currentUser?.gender || '');
  const [interestedIn, setInterestedIn] = useState(currentUser?.interested_in || 'everyone');
  const [interests, setInterests] = useState<string[]>(currentUser?.interests || []);
  const [lookingFor, setLookingFor] = useState((currentUser as any)?.looking_for || '');
  const [photos, setPhotos] = useState<string[]>((currentUser as any)?.photos || []);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadingPhoto, setUploadingPhoto] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const photoInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const completionPct = useMemo(() => {
    let filled = 0;
    const total = 7;
    if (name.trim()) filled++;
    if (avatar.trim()) filled++;
    if (age && parseInt(age) >= 18) filled++;
    if (bio.trim()) filled++;
    if (city.trim()) filled++;
    if (gender) filled++;
    if (interests.length >= 3) filled++;
    return Math.round((filled / total) * 100);
  }, [name, avatar, age, bio, city, gender, interests]);

  const handleAvatarUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !authUser) return;
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { toast.error('Image must be under 5MB'); return; }
    setUploading(true);
    const ext = file.name.split('.').pop();
    const path = `${authUser.id}/avatar.${ext}`;
    const { error } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, file, { upsert: true });
    if (error) { toast.error('Upload failed'); setUploading(false); return; }
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
    setAvatar(publicUrl + '?t=' + Date.now());
    setUploading(false);
    toast.success('Photo uploaded!');
  };

  const handlePhotoUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !authUser) return;
    if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) { toast.error('Image must be under 5MB'); return; }
    if (photos.length >= 3) { toast.error('Maximum 3 photos'); return; }
    setUploadingPhoto(true);
    const ext = file.name.split('.').pop();
    const path = `${authUser.id}/photo_${Date.now()}.${ext}`;
    const { error } = await supabase.storage.from('avatars').upload(path, file, { upsert: true });
    if (error) { toast.error('Upload failed'); setUploadingPhoto(false); return; }
    const { data: { publicUrl } } = supabase.storage.from('avatars').getPublicUrl(path);
    setPhotos(prev => [...prev, publicUrl + '?t=' + Date.now()]);
    setUploadingPhoto(false);
    toast.success('Photo added!');
  };

  const removePhoto = (index: number) => setPhotos(prev => prev.filter((_, i) => i !== index));

  const toggleInterest = (interest: string) => {
    setInterests(prev =>
      prev.includes(interest) ? prev.filter(i => i !== interest) : prev.length < 8 ? [...prev, interest] : prev
    );
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!name.trim()) { toast.error('Name is required'); return; }
    if (!gender) { toast.error('Please select your gender'); return; }
    if (!age || parseInt(age) < 18 || parseInt(age) > 99) { toast.error('Please enter a valid age (18-99)'); return; }
    if (!bio.trim()) { toast.error('Bio is required'); return; }
    if (!city.trim()) { toast.error('City is required'); return; }
    if (interests.length < 3) { toast.error('Select at least 3 interests'); return; }

    setSaving(true);
    const result = await updateProfile({
      name: name.trim(),
      bio: bio.trim(),
      age: parseInt(age),
      city: city.trim(),
      avatar: avatar.trim(),
      gender: gender || null,
      interested_in: interestedIn,
      interests,
    } as any);

    if (authUser) {
      await supabase.from('profiles').update({ looking_for: lookingFor, photos } as any).eq('id', authUser.id);
    }

    setSaving(false);
    if (result.error) {
      toast.error(result.error);
    } else {
      toast.success('Profile updated!');
      navigate('/profile');
    }
  };

  const inputClass = "w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-2xl bg-secondary/50 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground text-sm outline-none border border-border/30 focus:border-primary/50 transition-all";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface pb-8">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 glass px-4 py-3 flex items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-4 h-4 text-foreground" />
          </motion.button>
          <h1 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-foreground">Edit Profile</h1>
        </div>
        <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}
          className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl gradient-primary text-primary-foreground text-sm font-semibold shadow-glow btn-press">
          {saving ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <><Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 inline mr-1" />Save</>}
        </motion.button>
      </header>

      <div className="px-4 mt-4 space-y-5">
        {/* Completion Progress */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
          className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">Profile Completion</span>
            <span className={`text-xs font-bold ${completionPct === 100 ? 'text-emerald-400' : 'text-primary'}`}>{completionPct}%</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={completionPct} className="h-2" />
          {completionPct < 100 && (
            <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              Complete all fields to unlock full features
            </p>
          )}
        </motion.div>

        {/* Avatar Upload */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.02 }} className="text-center">
          <div className="relative w-24 h-24 mx-auto cursor-pointer" onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}>
            {avatar ? (
              <img src={avatar} alt="Avatar" className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full object-cover border-2 border-primary/30" />
            ) : (
              <div className="w-24 h-24 rounded-full bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-3xl font-display text-muted-foreground border-2 border-border/30">
                {name?.charAt(0) || '?'}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="absolute -bottom-1 -right-1 w-8 h-8 rounded-full gradient-primary flex items-center justify-center shadow-glow-sm">
              {uploading ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary-foreground animate-spin" /> : <Camera className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary-foreground" />}
            </div>
          </div>
          <input ref={fileInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handleAvatarUpload} className="hidden" />
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-2">Tap to upload avatar</p>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Photo Gallery */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.04 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">Gallery (up to 3 photos)</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {photos.map((photo, i) => (
              <div key={i} className="relative w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-border/30">
                <img src={photo} alt="" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
                <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.8 }} onClick={() => removePhoto(i)}
                  className="absolute top-1 right-1 w-6 h-6 rounded-full bg-destructive/80 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <X className="w-3 h-3 text-destructive-foreground" />
                </motion.button>
              </div>
            ))}
            {photos.length < 3 && (
              <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }} onClick={() => photoInputRef.current?.click()}
                className="w-24 h-24 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-border/50 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 text-muted-foreground hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors">
                {uploadingPhoto ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : <ImagePlus className="w-5 h-5" />}
                <span className="text-[9px] font-semibold">Add</span>
              </motion.button>
            )}
          </div>
          <input ref={photoInputRef} type="file" accept="image/*" onChange={handlePhotoUpload} className="hidden" />
        </motion.div>

        {/* Name */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.06 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Name *</label>
          <input value={name} onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)} placeholder="Your name" maxLength={50} className={inputClass} />
        </motion.div>

        {/* Bio */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.08 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Bio *</label>
          <textarea value={bio} onChange={e => setBio(e.target.value)} placeholder="Tell people about yourself..." rows={3} className={inputClass + ' resize-none'} maxLength={200} />
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-right">{bio.length}/200</p>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Age */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.1 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Age *</label>
          <input type="number" value={age} onChange={e => setAge(e.target.value)} placeholder="25" min={18} max={99} className={inputClass} />
        </motion.div>

        {/* City */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.12 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">City *</label>
          <input value={city} onChange={e => setCity(e.target.value)} placeholder="Paris" maxLength={50} className={inputClass} />
        </motion.div>

        {/* Gender */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.14 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Gender *</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {['male', 'female'].map(g => (
              <button key={g} type="button" onClick={() => setGender(g)}
                className={`flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm font-semibold transition-all ${gender === g ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'}`}>
                {g === 'male' ? '👨 Male' : '👩 Female'}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Interested In */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.16 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1.5 block">Interested in</label>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            {[{ val: 'men', label: 'Men' }, { val: 'women', label: 'Women' }, { val: 'everyone', label: 'Everyone' }].map(o => (
              <button key={o.val} type="button" onClick={() => setInterestedIn(o.val)}
                className={`flex-1 py-3 rounded-2xl text-sm font-semibold transition-all ${interestedIn === o.val ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'}`}>
                {o.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Looking For */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.18 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">Looking for</label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {lookingForOptions.map(o => (
              <button key={o.value} type="button" onClick={() => setLookingFor(o.value)}
                className={`px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${lookingFor === o.value ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'}`}>
                {o.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </motion.div>

        {/* Interests */}
        <motion.div initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 12 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition={{ delay: 0.2 }}>
          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-2 block">
            Interests * <span className="text-muted-foreground/60">(min 3, max 8)</span>
          </label>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {interestOptions.map(interest => (
              <button key={interest} type="button" onClick={() => toggleInterest(interest)}
                className={`px-3 py-2 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${interests.includes(interest) ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30'}`}>
                {interest}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">{interests.length} selected</p>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ProfileEdit;

FILE: src/pages/RatingScreen.tsx
========================================
import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { useParams, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { ArrowLeft, Star } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const sliders = [
  { key: 'presence', label: 'Presence', desc: 'Were they fully there?' },
  { key: 'respect', label: 'Respect', desc: 'Were they respectful?' },
  { key: 'communication', label: 'Communication', desc: 'Good conversation?' },
];

const RatingScreen = () => {
  const { sessionId } = useParams();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const { authUser } = useApp();
  const [stars, setStars] = useState(0);
  const [scores, setScores] = useState({ presence: 3, respect: 3, communication: 3 });
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [session, setSession] = useState<any>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (sessionId) {
      supabase.from('sessions').select('*').eq('id', sessionId).single().then(({ data }) => {
        if (data) setSession(data);
      });
    }
  }, [sessionId]);

  const handleSubmit = async () => {
    if (stars === 0 || !authUser || !session) return;
    const toUser = session.user_a === authUser.id ? session.user_b : session.user_a;

    setSubmitting(true);
    const { error } = await supabase.from('ratings').insert({
      session_id: session.id,
      from_user: authUser.id,
      to_user: toUser,
      stars,
      presence_score: scores.presence,
      respect_score: scores.respect,
      communication_score: scores.communication,
    });
    setSubmitting(false);

    if (error) {
      toast.error('Failed to submit rating');
    } else {
      setSubmitted(true);
    }
  };

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface flex items-center justify-center">
        <motion.div initial={{ scale: 0.8, opacity: 0 }} animate={{ scale: 1, opacity: 1 }} className="text-center">
          <div className="text-6xl mb-4">⭐</div>
          <h2 className="font-display text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">Thanks!</h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2">Your feedback helps build trust</p>
          <button onClick={() => navigate(`/gift/${sessionId}`)} className="mt-6 px-8 py-3 rounded-xl gradient-primary text-primary-foreground font-semibold shadow-glow">
            Send a Gift
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => navigate('/nearby')} className="mt-3 block mx-auto text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            Skip
          </button>
        </motion.div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface px-4">
      <header className="flex items-center gap-3 py-4">
        <button onClick={() => navigate(-1)} className="text-muted-foreground"><ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5" /></button>
        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-foreground">Rate Experience</h1>
      </header>

      <div className="text-center mt-6">
        <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-3">How was the experience overall?</p>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(n => (
            <motion.button key={n} whileTap={{ scale: 0.8 }} onClick={() => setStars(n)}>
              <Star className={`w-10 h-10 transition-colors ${n <= stars ? 'text-amber-400 fill-amber-400' : 'text-muted'}`} />
            </motion.button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8 space-y-5">
        {sliders.map(({ key, label, desc }) => (
          <div key={key}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">{label}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{desc}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="text-sm font-display font-bold text-foreground">
                {scores[key as keyof typeof scores]}/5
              </span>
            </div>
            <input
              type="range" min={1} max={5} step={1}
              value={scores[key as keyof typeof scores]}
              onChange={e => setScores({ ...scores, [key]: parseInt(e.target.value) })}
              className="w-full accent-primary h-1.5"
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>

      <motion.button
        whileTap={{ scale: 0.97 }}
        onClick={handleSubmit}
        disabled={stars === 0 || submitting}
        className={`w-full mt-8 py-3.5 rounded-xl font-semibold transition-all ${
          stars > 0 ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow' : 'bg-muted text-muted-foreground cursor-not-allowed'
        }`}
      >
        {submitting ? 'Submitting...' : 'Submit Rating'}
      </motion.button>
    </div>
  );
};

export default RatingScreen;

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { motion } from 'framer-motion';
import { ArrowLeft } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const Register = () => {
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [gender, setGender] = useState('');
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const { register, updateProfile } = useApp();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setSubmitting(true);
    const result = await register(name, email, password);
    setSubmitting(false);
    if (result.error) {
      toast.error(result.error);
    } else {
      // Update gender after registration
      if (gender) {
        await updateProfile({ gender } as any);
      }
      toast.success('Account created! You can now sign in.');
      navigate('/nearby');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface flex flex-col px-6">
      <header className="flex items-center py-5">
        <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate('/')} className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center">
          <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-foreground" />
        </motion.button>
      </header>

      <motion.div
        initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 24 }}
        animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
        transition={{ duration: 0.5, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] }}
        className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-center max-w-md mx-auto w-full"
      >
        <h1 className="font-display text-3xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight">Create account</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-2">Start crossing paths</p>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-4">
          {[
            { label: 'Name', type: 'text', value: name, onChange: setName, placeholder: 'Your name' },
            { label: 'Email', type: 'email', value: email, onChange: setEmail, placeholder: 'your@email.com' },
            { label: 'Password', type: 'password', value: password, onChange: setPassword, placeholder: '••••••••', minLength: 8 },
          ].map(({ label, type, value, onChange, placeholder, minLength }) => (
            <div key={label}>
              <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">{label}</label>
              <input
                type={type}
                value={value}
                onChange={e => onChange(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full mt-2 px-4 py-3.5 rounded-2xl bg-secondary/50 text-foreground placeholder:text-muted-foreground border border-border/50 focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary/50 outline-none transition-all"
                placeholder={placeholder}
                required
                minLength={minLength}
              />
            </div>
          ))}

          <div>
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider">Gender</label>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mt-2">
              {['male', 'female'].map(g => (
                <button key={g} type="button" onClick={() => setGender(g)}
                  className={`flex-1 py-3.5 rounded-2xl text-sm font-semibold transition-all ${gender === g ? 'gradient-glow text-primary-foreground shadow-glow' : 'bg-secondary/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/50'}`}>
                  {g === 'male' ? '👨 Male' : '👩 Female'}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <motion.button
            whileTap={{ scale: 0.96 }}
            type="submit"
            disabled={submitting}
            className="w-full py-4 rounded-2xl gradient-glow text-primary-foreground font-bold shadow-glow mt-6 disabled:opacity-50 btn-press"
          >
            {submitting ? 'Creating...' : 'Create Account'}
          </motion.button>
        </form>

        <p className="text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-8">
          Already have an account?{' '}
          <button onClick={() => navigate('/login')} className="text-primary font-semibold">
            Sign In
          </button>
        </p>
      </motion.div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default Register;

FILE: src/pages/Requests.tsx
========================================
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useApp } from '@/context/AppContext';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
import BottomNav from '@/components/BottomNav';
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from 'framer-motion';
import { Check, X, Users, Bell, Clock, Send, XCircle, Ban } from 'lucide-react';
import { Skeleton } from '@/components/ui/skeleton';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

const statusConfig: Record<string, { label: string; className: string }> = {
  pending: { label: 'Pending approval', className: 'bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-400' },
  confirmed: { label: 'Confirmed', className: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400' },
  accepted: { label: 'Accepted', className: 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-400' },
  declined: { label: 'Declined', className: 'bg-destructive/15 text-destructive' },
  ignored: { label: 'Ignored', className: 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground' },
  cancelled: { label: 'Cancelled', className: 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground' },
  expired: { label: 'Expired', className: 'bg-muted/30 text-muted-foreground' },
};

const Requests = () => {
  const { contacts, authUser, acceptRequest, declineRequest, cancelRequest, acceptJoinRequest, declineJoinRequest, ignoreJoinRequest, postedActivities, activityParticipants, fetchParticipants, fetchActivities } = useApp();
  const [profiles, setProfiles] = useState<Record<string, any>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<'incoming' | 'sent'>('incoming');
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // Fetch all participants for my activities
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    fetchActivities();
  }, [authUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!authUser) return;
    const myActivities = postedActivities.filter(a => a.user_id === authUser.id);
    myActivities.forEach(a => fetchParticipants(a.id));
  }, [authUser, postedActivities, fetchParticipants]);

  // Incoming: join requests on MY activities (I'm the owner)
  const incomingJoins: { participantId: string; userId: string; activityId: string; activityType: string; status: string; createdAt: string }[] = [];
  if (authUser) {
    const myActivities = postedActivities.filter(a => a.user_id === authUser.id);
    for (const act of myActivities) {
      const parts = activityParticipants[act.id] || [];
      for (const p of parts) {
        if (p.user_id !== authUser.id) {
          incomingJoins.push({
            participantId: p.id,
            userId: p.user_id,
            activityId: act.id,
            activityType: act.activityType,
            status: p.status,
            createdAt: p.created_at,
          });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // Sent: my join requests on OTHER people's activities
  const sentJoins: { participantId: string; ownerId: string; activityId: string; activityType: string; status: string; createdAt: string }[] = [];
  if (authUser) {
    const otherActivities = postedActivities.filter(a => a.user_id !== authUser.id);
    for (const act of otherActivities) {
      const parts = activityParticipants[act.id] || [];
      const myPart = parts.find(p => p.user_id === authUser.id);
      if (myPart) {
        sentJoins.push({
          participantId: myPart.id,
          ownerId: act.user_id,
          activityId: act.id,
          activityType: act.activityType,
          status: myPart.status,
          createdAt: myPart.created_at,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  // Contact requests
  const incomingContacts = contacts.filter(r => r.receiver_id === authUser?.id && r.status === 'pending');
  const sentContacts = contacts.filter(r => r.sender_id === authUser?.id);

  const incomingAll = [
    ...incomingContacts.map(c => ({ ...c, _kind: 'contact' as const })),
    ...incomingJoins.filter(j => j.status === 'pending').map(j => ({ ...j, _kind: 'join_incoming' as const })),
  ];

  const sentAll = [
    ...sentContacts.map(c => ({ ...c, _kind: 'contact' as const })),
    ...sentJoins.map(j => ({ ...j, _kind: 'join_sent' as const })),
  ];

  // Fetch profiles for all involved user IDs
  useEffect(() => {
    const ids = new Set<string>();
    contacts.forEach(r => { ids.add(r.sender_id); ids.add(r.receiver_id); });
    incomingJoins.forEach(j => ids.add(j.userId));
    sentJoins.forEach(j => ids.add(j.ownerId));
    const idsArr = Array.from(ids).filter(id => id !== authUser?.id);
    if (idsArr.length === 0) { setLoading(false); return; }

    supabase.from('profiles').select('*').in('id', idsArr).then(({ data }) => {
      if (data) {
        const map: Record<string, any> = {};
        data.forEach(p => { map[p.id] = p; });
        setProfiles(map);
      }
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, [contacts, authUser, incomingJoins.length, sentJoins.length]);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen gradient-surface pb-24">
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 glass px-5 py-4">
        <h1 className="font-display text-xl font-bold text-foreground tracking-tight">Requests</h1>
        {incomingAll.length > 0 && (
          <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-primary font-semibold mt-1">
            <Bell className="w-3 h-3" /> {incomingAll.length} pending
          </span>
        )}
      </header>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="px-4 mt-3 flex gap-2">
        {([
          { key: 'incoming' as const, label: 'Incoming', icon: Bell, count: incomingAll.length },
          { key: 'sent' as const, label: 'Sent', icon: Send, count: sentAll.length },
        ]).map(t => (
          <motion.button key={t.key} whileTap={{ scale: 0.93 }} onClick={() => setTab(t.key)}
            className={`flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-center gap-2 transition-all btn-press ${
              tab === t.key ? 'gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm' : 'glass-card text-muted-foreground'
            }`}>
            <t.icon className="w-4 h-4" />
            {t.label}
            {t.count > 0 && (
              <span className={`min-w-[18px] h-[18px] rounded-full text-[10px] font-bold flex items-center justify-center px-1 ${
                tab === t.key ? 'bg-primary-foreground/20 text-primary-foreground' : 'bg-primary/15 text-primary'
              }`}>{t.count}</span>
            )}
          </motion.button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <div className="px-4 mt-4">
        {loading ? (
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {[1, 2, 3].map(i => (
              <div key={i} className="glass-card rounded-3xl p-4 flex items-center gap-4">
                <Skeleton className="w-14 h-14 rounded-2xl" />
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-2"><Skeleton className="h-4 w-2/3" /><Skeleton className="h-3 w-1/2" /></div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        ) : (
          <AnimatePresence mode="wait">
            {tab === 'incoming' ? (
              <motion.div key="incoming" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }}>
                {incomingAll.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-16">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-3xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                      <Bell className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground font-display font-semibold">No pending requests</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">When someone wants to join your activity, it will appear here</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    {incomingAll.map((req, i) => {
                      if (req._kind === 'contact') {
                        const user = profiles[req.sender_id];
                        if (!user) return null;
                        return (
                          <motion.div key={req.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                            transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${user.id}`)}>
                              {user.avatar ? (
                                <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold text-muted-foreground">{user.name?.charAt(0)}</div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-foreground text-sm">{user.name}</p>
                              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">Wants to connect</p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex gap-2">
                              <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }} onClick={() => acceptRequest(req.id)}
                                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl gradient-primary flex items-center justify-center shadow-glow-sm">
                                <Check className="w-4 h-4 text-primary-foreground" />
                              </motion.button>
                              <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }} onClick={() => declineRequest(req.id)}
                                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-muted flex items-center justify-center">
                                <X className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                              </motion.button>
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        );
                      }

                      // Join request on my activity
                      const joinReq = req as typeof incomingJoins[0] & { _kind: string };
                      const user = profiles[joinReq.userId];
                      if (!user) return null;
                      return (
                        <motion.div key={joinReq.participantId} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                          transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${user.id}`)}>
                              {user.avatar ? (
                                <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold text-muted-foreground">{user.name?.charAt(0)}</div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-foreground text-sm">{user.name}</p>
                              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                Wants to join your {joinReq.activityType} activity
                              </p>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          {/* Owner actions: Accept / Decline / Ignore */}
                          <div className="flex gap-2 mt-3">
                            <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                              onClick={() => acceptJoinRequest(joinReq.participantId)}
                              className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold gradient-primary text-primary-foreground shadow-glow-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Accept
                            </motion.button>
                            <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                              onClick={() => ignoreJoinRequest(joinReq.participantId)}
                              className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground border border-border/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                              <Ban className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Ignore
                            </motion.button>
                            <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }}
                              onClick={() => declineJoinRequest(joinReq.participantId)}
                              className="flex-1 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> Decline
                            </motion.button>
                          </div>
                        </motion.div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            ) : (
              <motion.div key="sent" initial={{ opacity: 0, x: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -20 }}>
                {sentAll.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-16">
                    <div className="w-16 h-16 rounded-3xl glass-card flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3">
                      <Users className="w-8 h-8 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-sm text-foreground font-display font-semibold">No requests sent</p>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-1">Discover activities nearby and send a join request</p>
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    {sentAll.map((req, i) => {
                      if (req._kind === 'contact') {
                        const user = profiles[req.receiver_id];
                        if (!user) return null;
                        const status = statusConfig[req.status] || statusConfig.pending;
                        return (
                          <motion.div key={req.id} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                            transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${user.id}`)}>
                              {user.avatar ? (
                                <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold text-muted-foreground">{user.name?.charAt(0)}</div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-foreground text-sm">{user.name}</p>
                              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                Connection request
                                {req.created_at ? ` · ${new Date(req.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}` : ''}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full capitalize ${status.className}`}>
                                {status.label}
                              </span>
                              {req.status === 'pending' && (
                                <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.85 }} onClick={() => cancelRequest(req.id)}
                                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-destructive/10 flex items-center justify-center">
                                  <XCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-destructive" />
                                </motion.button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        );
                      }

                      // Sent join request
                      const joinReq = req as typeof sentJoins[0] & { _kind: string };
                      const user = profiles[joinReq.ownerId];
                      if (!user) return null;
                        const status = statusConfig[joinReq.status] || statusConfig.pending;
                        return (
                          <motion.div key={joinReq.participantId} initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                            transition={{ delay: i * 0.05 }} className="glass-card rounded-2xl p-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                            <div className="cursor-pointer" onClick={() => navigate(`/user/${user.id}`)}>
                              {user.avatar ? (
                                <img src={user.avatar} alt={user.name} className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                              ) : (
                                <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-secondary flex items-center justify-center text-lg font-bold text-muted-foreground">{user.name?.charAt(0)}</div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                              <p className="font-display font-semibold text-foreground text-sm">{user.name}</p>
                              <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                {joinReq.activityType} join request
                                {joinReq.createdAt ? ` · ${new Date(joinReq.createdAt).toLocaleDateString()}` : ''}
                              </p>
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                              <span className={`text-[11px] font-bold px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full capitalize ${status.className}`}>
                                {status.label}
                              </span>
                              {joinReq.status === 'confirmed' && (
                                <motion.button whileTap={{ scale: 0.9 }} onClick={() => navigate(`/activity-detail/${joinReq.activityId}`)}
                                  className="px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-primary/15 text-primary text-[10px] font-bold">
                                  View
                                </motion.button>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </motion.div>
                        );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>
        )}
      </div>

      <BottomNav />
    </div>
  );
};

export default Requests;


========================================
FILE: src/pages/SessionScreen.tsx
